  242:   async function updateTeacherStatus(action: "suspend" | "restore") {
  243:     if (!user || !teacher) {
  244:       toast.error("Unable to update this teacher account.");
  245:       return;
  246:     }
  247: 
  248:     setProcessing(true);
  249: 
  250:     try {
  251:       const adminIdToken = await user.getIdToken(true);
  252: 
  253:       const response = await fetch(`/api/admin/teachers/${teacher.id}/status`, {
  254:         method: "POST",
  255:         headers: {
  256:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  257:         },
  258:         body: JSON.stringify({
  259:           action,
  260:           adminIdToken,
  261:         }),
  262:       });
  263: 
  264:       const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  265: 
  266:       if (!contentType.includes("application/json")) {
  267:         const responseText = await response.text();

  269:         console.error(
  270:           "Teacher status API returned non-JSON:",
  271:           response.status,
  272:           responseText,
  273:         );
  274:

  276:           `The server returned an unexpected response (${response.status}). Check the API route and terminal.`,
  277:         );

  281:         success?: boolean;
  282:         status?: "active" | "suspended";
  283:         error?: string;
  284:       };

  296:             }
  297:           : current,

  303:           : "Teacher restored successfully.",
  304:       );
  305:     } catch (error) {

  309:         error instanceof Error
  310:           ? error.message
  311:           : "Something went wrong updating the teacher.",
  312:       );
  313:     } finally {
  314:       setProcessing(false);
  315:     }
  316:   }

   16: function isValidBody(value: unknown): value is TeacherRequestAction {
   17:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
   18:     return false;
   19:   }
   20: 
   21:   const body = value as Partial<TeacherRequestAction>;
   22: 
   23:   return (
   24:     (body.action === "approve" || body.action === "reject") &&
   25:     typeof body.adminIdToken === "string" &&
   26:     body.adminIdToken.length > 0
   27:   );
   28: }
   29: 
   30: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, context: RouteContext) {
   31:   try {
   32:     const { requestedId } = await context.params;
   33:     const body: unknown = await request.json();
   34: 
   35:     if (!isValidBody(body)) {
   36:       return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid request." }, { status: 400 });
   37:     }
   38: 
   39:     const decodedToken = await adminAuth.verifyIdToken(body.adminIdToken);
   40: 
   41:     const adminUserSnapshot = await adminDb
   42:       .collection("users")
   43:       .doc(decodedToken.uid)
   44:       .get();
   45: 
   46:     if (!adminUserSnapshot.exists) {
   47:       return NextResponse.json(
   48:         { error: "Admin profile not found." },
   49:         { status: 403 },
   50:       );
   51:     }
   52: 
   53:     const adminUser = adminUserSnapshot.data();
   54: 
   55:     if (adminUser?.role !== "admin") {
   56:       return NextResponse.json(
   57:         { error: "Admin access required." },
   58:         { status: 403 },
   59:       );
   60:     }
   61: 
   62:     const teacherRequestReference = adminDb
   63:       .collection("teacherRequests")
   64:       .doc(requestedId);
   65: 
   66:     const teacherRequestSnapshot = await teacherRequestReference.get();
   67: 
   68:     if (!teacherRequestSnapshot.exists) {
   69:       return NextResponse.json(
   70:         { error: "Teacher request not found." },
   71:         { status: 404 },
   72:       );
   73:     }
   74: 
   75:     const teacherRequest = teacherRequestSnapshot.data();
   76: 
   77:     if (!teacherRequest?.userId) {
   78:       return NextResponse.json(
   79:         { error: "Teacher request is missing a user ID." },
   80:         { status: 400 },
   81:       );
   82:     }
   83: 
   84:     if (teacherRequest.status !== "pending") {
   85:       return NextResponse.json(
   86:         { error: "This request has already been reviewed." },
   87:         { status: 409 },
   88:       );
   89:     }
   90: 
   91:     const requestedUserId = teacherRequest.userId as string;
   92: 
   93:     if (body.action === "approve") {
   94:       await adminAuth.setCustomUserClaims(requestedUserId, {
   95:         role: "teacher",
   96:       });
   97: 
   98:       await adminDb.runTransaction(async (transaction) => {
   99:         const userReference = adminDb.collection("users").doc(requestedUserId);
  100: 
  101:         transaction.update(userReference, {
  102:           role: "teacher",
  103:           teacherApprovedAt: new Date(),
  104:           teacherApprovedBy: decodedToken.uid,
  105:           updatedAt: new Date(),
  106:         });
  107: 
  108:         transaction.update(teacherRequestReference, {
  109:           status: "approved",
  110:           reviewedBy: decodedToken.uid,
  111:           reviewedAt: new Date(),
  112:           updatedAt: new Date(),
  113:         });
  114:       });
  115: 
  116:       return NextResponse.json({
  117:         success: true,
  118:         status: "approved",
  119:       });
  120:     }
  121: 
  122:     await teacherRequestReference.update({
  123:       status: "rejected",
  124:       reviewedBy: decodedToken.uid,
  125:       reviewedAt: new Date(),
  126:       updatedAt: new Date(),
  127:     });
  128: 
  129:     return NextResponse.json({
  130:       success: true,
  131:       status: "rejected",
  132:     });
  133:   } catch (error) {
  134:     console.error("Teacher request review error:", error);
  135: 
  136:     return NextResponse.json(
  137:       {
  138:         error:
  139:           error instanceof Error
  140:             ? error.message
  141:             : "The request could not be reviewed.",
  142:       },
  143:       { status: 500 },
  144:     );
  145:   }
  146: }

   10: export async function POST(request: NextRequest, context: RouteContext) {

   12:     const { teacherId } = await context.params;
   13: 
   14:     const { action, adminIdToken } = await request.json();
   15: 
   16:     if (action !== "suspend" && action !== "restore") {
   17:       return NextResponse.json({ error: "Invalid action." }, { status: 400 });
   18:     }
   19: 
   20:     const decoded = await adminAuth.verifyIdToken(adminIdToken);
   21: 
   22:     const adminDoc = await adminDb.collection("users").doc(decoded.uid).get();

   25:       return NextResponse.json({ error: "Admin not found." }, { status: 403 });

   27:

   29:       return NextResponse.json(
   30:         { error: "Admin access required." },
   31:         { status: 403 },
   32:       );
   33:     }
   34: 
   35:     const teacherRef = adminDb.collection("users").doc(teacherId);
   36:

  364:     } finally {
  365:       setCreating(false);
  366:     }
  367:   }
  368: 
  369:   async function generateJoinCode(
  370:     role: SchoolInviteRole,
  371:   ) {
  372:     if (
  373:       !user?.uid ||
  374:       !schoolId
  375:     ) {
  376:       return;
  377:     }
  378: 
  379:     try {
  380:       setGeneratingRole(
  381:         role,
  382:       );
  383: 
  384:       const code =
  385:         await createSchoolInvite({
  386:           schoolId,
  387:           createdBy:
  388:             user.uid,
  389:           role,
  390:         });
  391: 
  392:       setLatestCode({
  393:         role,
  394:         code,
  395:       });
  396: 
  397:       toast.success(
  398:         `${
  399:           role === "student"
  400:             ? "Student"
  401:             : "Teacher"
  402:         } join code created.`,
  403:       );
  404:     } catch (error) {
  405:       console.error(
  406:         "Unable to create join code:",
  407:         error,
  408:       );
  409: 
  410:       toast.error(
  411:         error instanceof Error
  412:           ? error.message
  413:           : "A join code could not be created.",
  414:       );
  415:     } finally {
  416:       setGeneratingRole(
  417:         null,
  418:       );
  419:     }
  420:   }
  421: 
  422:   async function copyCode(
  423:     code:
  424:       string = latestCode?.code ||
  425:       "",
  426:   ) {
  427:     if (!code) {
  428:       return;
  429:     }
  430: 
  431:     try {
  432:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(
  433:         code,
  434:       );
  435: 
  436:       toast.success(
  437:         "Join code copied.",
  438:       );
  439:     } catch {
  440:       toast.error(
  441:         "Copy the code manually.",
  442:       );
  443:     }
  444:   }
  445: 
  446:   if (
  447:     authLoading ||
  448:     !profileReady ||
  449:     loading
  450:   ) {
  451:     return (
  452:       <div className="space-y-6">
  453:         <Skeleton className="h-52 rounded-3xl" />
  454: 
  455:         <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
  456:           <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-3xl" />
  457:           <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-3xl" />
  458:           <Skeleton className="h-40 rounded-3xl" />
  459:         </div>
  460: 
  461:         <Skeleton className="h-96 rounded-3xl" />
  462:       </div>
  463:     );
  464:   }
  465: 
  466:   if (
  467:     profile?.role !==
  468:       "teacher" &&
  469:     profile?.role !==
  470:       "admin"
  471:   ) {
  472:     return (
  473:       <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-7">
  474:         <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-red-950">
  475:           Teacher access required
  476:         </h1>
  477: 
  478:         <p className="mt-3 text-red-700">
  479:           School administration is available to teacher and administrator accounts.
  480:         </p>
  481:       </Card>
  482:     );
  483:   }
  484: 
  485:   if (
  486:     !schoolId ||
  487:     !school
  488:   ) {
  489:     return (
  490:       <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-6">
  491:         <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-teal-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-50 to-cyan-50 p-8">
  492:           <p className="text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-teal-700">
  493:             School setup
  494:           </p>
  495: 
  496:           <h1 className="mt-3 text-3xl font-black text-slate-950">
  497:             Create your school organisation
  498:           </h1>
  499: 
  500:           <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl leading-7 text-slate-600">
  501:             Creating a school separates your teachers and students from every
  502:             other organisation in CS Master. Student directories and class
  503:             enrolment will be scoped to this school.
  504:           </p>
  505:         </Card>
  506: 
  507:         <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 p-7">
  508:           <label className="block">
  509:             <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
  510:               School name
  511:             </span>
  512: 
  513:             <input
  514:               type="text"
  515:               value={
  516:                 schoolName
  517:               }
  518:               onChange={(
  519:                 event,
  520:               ) =>
  521:                 setSchoolName(
  522:                   event
  523:                     .target
  524:                     .value,
  525:                 )
  526:               }
  527:               placeholder="e.g. The Norwood School"
  528:               className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-300 px-4 py-3 outline-none transition focus:border-teal-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-100"
  529:             />
  530:           </label>
  531: 
  532:           <button
  533:             type="button"
  534:             onClick={() =>
  535:               void handleCreateSchool()
  536:             }
  537:             disabled={
  538:               creating ||
  539:               !schoolName.trim()
  540:             }
  541:             className="mt-5 rounded-xl bg-teal-600 px-6 py-3 font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-teal-700 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
  542:           >
  543:             {creating
  544:               ? "Creating school..."
  545:               : "Create school"}
  546:           </button>
  547:         </Card>
  548:       </div>
  549:     );
  550:   }
  551: 
  552:   return (
  553:     <div className="space-y-8">
  554:       <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-teal-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-50 to-cyan-50 p-8">

  556:           School organisation
  557:         </p>
  558: 
  559:         <h1 className="mt-3 text-3xl font-black text-slate-950">
  560:           {school.name}
  561:         </h1>
  562: 
  563:         <p className="mt-2 text-slate-600">
  564:           School ID:{" "}
  565:           <span className="font-mono font-bold text-slate-800">
  566:             {school.id}
  567:           </span>
  568:         </p>
  569:       </Card>
  570: 
  571:       <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-3">
  572:         <Metric

  575:             students.length
  576:           }
  577:           description="Active school students"
  578:         />
  579: 
  580:         <Metric
  581:           label="Staff"

  583:             staff.length
  584:           }
  585:           description="Teachers and school admins"
  586:         />
  587:

  590:           value={
  591:             activeMembers.length
  592:           }
  593:           description="All active school members"
  594:         />
  595:       </div>
  596: 
  597:       <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-2">
  598:         <TabButton

  600:             tab === "students"
  601:           }
  602:           onClick={() =>
  603:             setTab(
  604:               "students",
  605:             )
  606:           }
  607:         >
  608:           Students ({students.length})
  609:         </TabButton>
  610: 
  611:         <TabButton
  612:           active={
  613:             tab === "staff"
  614:           }
  615:           onClick={() =>
  616:             setTab(
  617:               "staff",
  618:             )
  619:           }
  620:         >
  621:           Staff ({staff.length})
  622:         </TabButton>
  623: 
  624:         <TabButton
  625:           active={
  626:             tab ===
  627:             "invitations"
  628:           }
  629:           onClick={() =>
  630:             setTab(

  632:             )
  633:           }

  135: function formatMessageContent(content: string) {
  136:   return content.split("\n").map((line, index) => {
  137:     const trimmed = line.trim();
  138: 
  139:     if (!trimmed) {
  140:       return <div key={`space-${index}`} className="h-3" />;
  141:     }

  143:     if (trimmed.startsWith("## ")) {
  144:       return (
  145:         <h3
  146:           key={`heading-${index}`}

  148:         >
  149:           {trimmed.slice(3)}
  150:         </h3>
  151:       );
  152:     }
  153: 
  154:     if (trimmed.startsWith("**") && trimmed.endsWith("**")) {
  155:       return (
  156:         <p key={`bold-${index}`} className="font-bold text-slate-900">
  157:           {trimmed.slice(2, -2)}
  158:         </p>
  159:       );
  160:     }
  161: 
  162:     if (/^[-â€¢]\s/.test(trimmed)) {
  163:       return (
  164:         <p

  166:           className="pl-4 text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700"

  169:         </p>

  172:

  174:       <p key={`line-${index}`} className="text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
  175:         {trimmed}

  589: export default function ResourceBuilderForm({
  590:   resourceType,
  591:   initialValues = {},
  592:   prefillVersion = 0,
  593: }: ResourceBuilderFormProps) {
  594:   const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(DEFAULT_FORM);
  595: 
  596:   const [resource, setResource] = useState<GeneratedTeachingResource | null>(
  597:     null,
  598:   );
  599: 
  600:   const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  601: 
  602:   const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  603:   const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState(false);
  604: 
  605:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  606: 
  607:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  608: 
  609:   const abortControllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  610: 
  611:   const previewRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  612: 
  613:   const resolvedResourceType = normaliseResourceType(resourceType);
  614: 
  615:   const resourceLabel = RESOURCE_LABELS[resolvedResourceType];
  616: 
  617:   useEffect(() => {
  618:     void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
  619:       setForm({
  620:         ...DEFAULT_FORM,
  621:         ...initialValues,
  622:         duration: initialValues.duration ?? DEFAULT_FORM.duration,
  623:         difficulty: initialValues.difficulty ?? DEFAULT_FORM.difficulty,
  624:       });
  625: 
  626:       setResource(null);
  627:       setError(null);
  628:       setSuccess(null);
  629:       setIsSaved(false);
  630:     });
  631:   }, [resolvedResourceType, initialValues, prefillVersion]);
  632: 
  633:   useEffect(() => {
  634:     return () => {
  635:       abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  636:     };
  637:   }, []);
  638: 
  639:   function updateField<K extends keyof FormState>(
  640:     field: K,
  641:     value: FormState[K],
  642:   ) {
  643:     setForm((current) => ({
  644:       ...current,
  645:       [field]: value,
  646:     }));
  647: 
  648:     setError(null);
  649:     setSuccess(null);
  650:   }
  651: 
  652:   function validateForm(): string | null {
  653:     if (form.topic.trim().length < 2) {
  654:       return "Enter a topic with at least two characters.";
  655:     }
  656: 
  657:     const duration = Number(form.duration);
  658: 
  659:     if (!Number.isInteger(duration) || duration < 5 || duration > 180) {
  660:       return "Select a valid duration.";
  661:     }
  662: 
  663:     return null;
  664:   }
  665: 
  666:   async function generateResource() {
  667:     const validationError = validateForm();
  668: 
  669:     if (validationError) {
  670:       setError(validationError);
  671:       return;
  672:     }
  673: 
  674:     abortControllerRef.current?.abort();
  675: 
  676:     const controller = new AbortController();
  677:     abortControllerRef.current = controller;
  678: 
  679:     setIsGenerating(true);
  680:     setError(null);
  681:     setSuccess(null);
  682:     setIsSaved(false);
  683: 
  684:     try {
  685:       const response = await fetch("/api/teacher/assistant", {
  686:         method: "POST",
  687:         headers: {
  688:           "Content-Type": "application/json",
  689:         },
  690:         signal: controller.signal,
  691:         body: JSON.stringify({
  692:           resourceType: resolvedResourceType,
  693:           topic: form.topic.trim(),
  694:           yearGroup: form.yearGroup,
  695:           examBoard: form.examBoard,
  696:           duration: Number(form.duration),
  697:           difficulty: form.difficulty,
  698:           objectives: form.objectives.trim(),
  699:           additionalNotes: form.additionalNotes.trim(),
  700:         }),
  701:       });
  702: 
  703:       const data = (await response.json()) as GenerateResourceResponse;
  704: 
  705:       if (!response.ok) {
  706:         throw new Error(data.error || "The resource could not be generated.");
  707:       }
  708: 
  709:       if (!data.resource) {
  710:         throw new Error("The server did not return a resource.");
  711:       }
  712: 
  713:       setResource(data.resource);
  714: 
  715:       window.setTimeout(() => {
  716:         previewRef.current?.scrollIntoView({
  717:           behavior: "smooth",
  718:           block: "start",
  719:         });
  720:       }, 100);
  721:     } catch (caughtError) {
  722:       if (
  723:         caughtError instanceof DOMException &&
  724:         caughtError.name === "AbortError"
  725:       ) {
  726:         return;
  727:       }
  728: 
  729:       setError(
  730:         caughtError instanceof Error
  731:           ? caughtError.message
  732:           : "The resource could not be generated.",
  733:       );
  734:     } finally {
  735:       setIsGenerating(false);
  736:     }
  737:   }
  738:

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import Link from "next/link";
    4: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
    5: import {
    6:   AlertTriangle,
    7:   ArrowUpRight,
    8:   BarChart3,
    9:   Target,
   10:   Users,
   11: } from "lucide-react";
   12: 
   13: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
   14: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
   15: import { getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio } from "@/services/analytics/teacherAnalyticsService";
   16: import type { TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio } from "@/types/teacherAnalytics";
   17: 
   18: export default function TeacherAnalyticsSnapshot() {
   19:   const { user, profile } = useAuth();
   20: 
   21:   const [portfolio, setPortfolio] =
   22:     useState<TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio | null>(null);
   23: 
   24:   useEffect(() => {
   25:     let cancelled = false;
   26: 
   27:     async function load() {
   28:       if (
   29:         !user?.uid ||
   30:         (profile?.role !== "teacher" && profile?.role !== "admin")
   31:       ) {
   32:         return;
   33:       }
   34: 
   35:       try {
   36:         const result = await getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(user.uid);
   37: 
   38:         if (!cancelled) setPortfolio(result);
   39:       } catch (error) {
   40:         console.error("Unable to load teacher analytics snapshot:", error);
   41:       }
   42:     }
   43: 
   44:     void load();
   45: 
   46:     return () => {
   47:       cancelled = true;
   48:     };
   49:   }, [profile?.role, user?.uid]);
   50: 
   51:   const totals = useMemo(() => {
   52:     if (!portfolio) return null;
   53: 
   54:     const students = portfolio.classes.flatMap((classItem) => classItem.students);
   55: 
   56:     const targetRows = students.filter(
   57:       (student) => student.targetGrade !== null && student.gradeGap !== null,
   58:     );
   59: 
   60:     const onTarget = targetRows.filter(
   61:       (student) => (student.gradeGap ?? -99) >= 0,
   62:     ).length;
   63: 
   64:     return {
   65:       highPriority: students.filter(
   66:         (student) => student.interventionPriority === "high",
   67:       ).length,
   68:       targetsMissing: students.filter(
   69:         (student) => student.targetGrade === null,
   70:       ).length,
   71:       onTargetPercentage:
   72:         targetRows.length > 0
   73:           ? Math.round((onTarget / targetRows.length) * 100)
   74:           : 0,
   75:     };
   76:   }, [portfolio]);
   77: 
   78:   if (!portfolio || !totals) return null;
   79: 
   80:   return (
   81:     <Card className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200">
   82:       <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-700 via-teal-700 to-cyan-700 p-6 text-white">
   83:         <div className="flex flex-col gap-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
   84:           <div>
   85:             <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   86:               <BarChart3 className="h-5 w-5" />
   87:               <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-white/80">
   88:                 Class intelligence
   89:               </p>
   90:             </div>
   91: 
   92:             <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black">
   93:               Attainment and intervention overview
   94:             </h2>
   95:           </div>
   96: 
   97:           <Link
   98:             href="/teacher/analytics"
   99:             className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-white px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-black text-teal-800 hover:bg-slate-100"
  100:           >
  101:             Open analytics
  102:             <ArrowUpRight className="h-4 w-4" />
  103:           </Link>
  104:         </div>
  105:       </div>
  106: 
  107:       <div className="grid gap-4 p-6 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
  108:         <Metric
  109:           label="Classes"
  110:           value={String(portfolio.classCount)}
  111:           icon={<BarChart3 className="h-5 w-5" />}
  112:         />
  113:         <Metric
  114:           label="Students"
  115:           value={String(portfolio.uniqueStudentCount)}
  116:           icon={<Users className="h-5 w-5" />}
  117:         />
  118:         <Metric
  119:           label="On / above target"
  120:           value={`${totals.onTargetPercentage}%`}
  121:           icon={<Target className="h-5 w-5" />}
  122:         />
  123:         <Metric
  124:           label="High priority"
  125:           value={String(totals.highPriority)}
  126:           detail={`${totals.targetsMissing} target grades not set`}
  127:           icon={<AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5" />}
  128:         />
  129:       </div>
  130:     </Card>
  131:   );
  132: }
  133: 
  134: function Metric({
  135:   label,

  139: }: {

  141:   value: string;

  160:           {icon}
  161:         </div>

   17: 
   18: function cleanLabel(value: string): string {
   19:   return value
   20:     .replace(/[-_]/g, " ")
   21:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
   22:     .trim();
   23: }
   24: 
   25: function searchText(questionSet: SavedExamQuestionSet): string {
   26:   const content = questionSet.content;
   27: 
   28:   return [
   29:     questionSet.id,
   30:     questionSet.title,
   31:     content.title,
   32:     content.description,
   33:     content.topic,
   34:     content.qualification,
   35:     content.examBoard,
   36:   ]
   37:     .filter(Boolean)
   38:     .join(" ")
   39:     .toLowerCase();
   40: }
   41: 
   42: export default function ExamPaperAssignmentSelector({
   43:   selectedResource,
   44:   onSelect,
   45: }: Props) {
   46:   const { user } = useAuth();
   47: 
   48:   const [questionSets, setQuestionSets] =
   49:     useState<SavedExamQuestionSet[]>([]);
   50: 
   51:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   52:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
   53:   const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
   54: 
   55:   useEffect(() => {
   56:     let cancelled = false;
   57: 
   58:     async function loadQuestionSets() {
   59:       if (!user?.uid) {
   60:         if (!cancelled) {
   61:           setQuestionSets([]);
   62:           setLoading(false);
   63:         }
   64: 
   65:         return;
   66:       }
   67: 
   68:       try {
   69:         setLoading(true);
   70:         setError("");
   71: 
   72:         const loaded =
   73:           await getTeacherExamQuestionSets(
   74:             user.uid,
   75:           );
   76: 
   77:         if (cancelled) return;
   78: 
   79:         setQuestionSets(
   80:           [...loaded].sort((a, b) =>
   81:             a.title.localeCompare(
   82:               b.title,
   83:             ),
   84:           ),
   85:         );
   86:       } catch (caughtError) {
   87:         console.error(
   88:           "Unable to load saved exam papers:",
   89:           caughtError,
   90:         );
   91: 
   92:         if (!cancelled) {
   93:           setQuestionSets([]);
   94:           setError(
   95:             caughtError instanceof Error
   96:               ? caughtError.message
   97:               : "The Question Bank could not be loaded.",
   98:           );
   99:         }
  100:       } finally {
  101:         if (!cancelled) {
  102:           setLoading(false);
  103:         }
  104:       }
  105:     }
  106: 
  107:     void loadQuestionSets();
  108: 
  109:     return () => {
  110:       cancelled = true;
  111:     };
  112:   }, [user?.uid]);
  113: 
  114:   const filtered = useMemo(() => {
  115:     const term =
  116:       search.trim().toLowerCase();
  117: 
  118:     if (!term) {
  119:       return questionSets;
  120:     }
  121: 
  122:     return questionSets.filter(
  123:       (questionSet) =>
  124:         searchText(
  125:           questionSet,
  126:         ).includes(term),
  127:     );
  128:   }, [questionSets, search]);
  129: 
  130:   return (
  131:     <section className="mt-8 rounded-3xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/50 p-5 sm:p-6">

  137:         Choose the exact exam paper

  139:

  160:             }
  161:             placeholder="Paper, topic, exam board..."

  169:         >
  170:           Open Question Bank

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
    4: import toast from "react-hot-toast";
    5: 
    6: import { useAuth } from "@/contexts/AuthContext";
    7: import { getTeacherClasses, type TeacherClass } from "@/services/classService";
    8: import { createExamAssignment } from "@/services/examAssignmentService";
    9: import type { SavedExamQuestionSet } from "@/services/examQuestionService";
   10: 
   11: type Props = {
   12:   questionSet: SavedExamQuestionSet;
   13:   onClose: () => void;
   14:   onAssigned?: (assignmentId: string) => void;
   15: };
   16: 
   17: export default function AssignExamModal({
   18:   questionSet,
   19:   onClose,
   20:   onAssigned,
   21: }: Props) {
   22:   const { user } = useAuth();
   23: 
   24:   const [classes, setClasses] = useState<TeacherClass[]>([]);
   25:   const [classId, setClassId] = useState("");
   26:   const [title, setTitle] = useState(questionSet.title);
   27:   const [instructions, setInstructions] = useState(
   28:     "Answer every question. Show working where required.",
   29:   );
   30:   const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState("");
   31:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   32:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
   33: 
   34:   useEffect(() => {
   35:     async function load() {
   36:       if (!user?.uid) {
   37:         return;
   38:       }
   39: 
   40:       try {
   41:         const loaded = await getTeacherClasses(user.uid);
   42: 
   43:         setClasses(loaded.filter((item) => item.status === "active"));
   44:       } catch (error) {
   45:         console.error(error);
   46:         toast.error("Classes could not be loaded.");
   47:       } finally {
   48:         setLoading(false);
   49:       }
   50:     }
   51: 
   52:     void load();
   53:   }, [user?.uid]);
   54: 
   55:   async function assign() {
   56:     if (!user?.uid) {
   57:       toast.error("You must be logged in.");
   58:       return;
   59:     }
   60: 
   61:     const selectedClass = classes.find((item) => item.id === classId);
   62: 
   63:     if (!selectedClass) {
   64:       toast.error("Select a class.");
   65:       return;
   66:     }
   67: 
   68:     if (!dueDate) {
   69:       toast.error("Select a due date.");
   70:       return;
   71:     }
   72: 
   73:     setSaving(true);
   74: 
   75:     try {
   76:       const assignmentId = await createExamAssignment({
   77:         teacherId: user.uid,
   78:         teacherName: user.displayName || "Teacher",
   79:         classId: selectedClass.id,
   80:         className: selectedClass.name,
   81:         studentIds: selectedClass.studentIds,
   82:         questionSetId: questionSet.id,
   83:         questionSetTitle: questionSet.title,
   84:         questionSetSnapshot: questionSet.content,
   85:         title,
   86:         instructions,
   87:         dueDate: new Date(`${dueDate}T23:59:59`),
   88:       });
   89: 
   90:       toast.success("Exam assignment created.");
   91: 
   92:       onAssigned?.(assignmentId);
   93:     } catch (error) {
   94:       console.error(error);
   95:       toast.error(
   96:         error instanceof Error
   97:           ? error.message
   98:           : "Assignment could not be created.",
   99:       );
  100:     } finally {
  101:       setSaving(false);
  102:     }
  103:   }
  104: 
  105:   return (
  106:     <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/60 p-4">
  107:       <div className="w-full max-w-2xl rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
  108:         <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
  109:           <div>
  110:             <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-indigo-600">
  111:               Assign assessment
  112:             </p>
  113: 
  114:             <h2 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">
  115:               {questionSet.title}
  116:             </h2>
  117:           </div>
  118: 
  119:           <button
  120:             type="button"
  121:             onClick={onClose}
  122:             className="rounded-lg border px-3 py-2 font-bold"
  123:           >
  124:             Close
  125:           </button>
  126:         </div>
  127: 
  128:         <div className="mt-6 space-y-5">
  129:           <label className="block">
  130:             <span className="text-sm font-bold">Class</span>
  131: 
  132:             <select
  133:               value={classId}
  134:               onChange={(event) => setClassId(event.target.value)}
  135:               disabled={loading}
  136:               className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3"
  137:             >
  138:               <option value="">Select a class</option>
  139: 
  140:               {classes.map((item) => (
  141:                 <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
  142:                   {item.name} ({item.studentIds.length} students)
  143:                 </option>
  144:               ))}
  145:             </select>
  146:           </label>
  147: 
  148:           <label className="block">
  149:             <span className="text-sm font-bold">Assignment title</span>
  150: 
  151:             <input
  152:               value={title}
  153:               onChange={(event) => setTitle(event.target.value)}
  154:               className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3"
  155:             />
  156:           </label>
  157: 
  158:           <label className="block">
  159:             <span className="text-sm font-bold">Instructions</span>
  160: 
  161:             <textarea
  162:               rows={4}
  163:               value={instructions}
  164:               onChange={(event) => setInstructions(event.target.value)}
  165:               className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border px-4 py-3"
  166:             />
  167:           </label>

  169:           <label className="block">

  177:             />
  178:           </label>

   15: function formatDate(
   16:   value: Date | null,
   17: ): string {
   18:   if (!value) {
   19:     return "Time unavailable";
   20:   }
   21: 
   22:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat(
   23:     "en-GB",
   24:     {
   25:       day: "2-digit",
   26:       month: "short",
   27:       year: "numeric",
   28:       hour: "2-digit",
   29:       minute: "2-digit",
   30:       second: "2-digit",
   31:     },
   32:   ).format(value);
   33: }
   34: 
   35: function incidentLabel(
   36:   incident: ExamIntegrityIncident,
   37: ): string {
   38:   switch (incident.type) {
   39:     case "fullscreen_exit":
   40:       return "Exited fullscreen";
   41: 
   42:     case "fullscreen_restored":
   43:       return "Returned to fullscreen";
   44: 
   45:     case "page_hidden":

   47:

   49:       return "Exam page visible again";
   50: 
   51:     case "integrity_termination":
   52:       return "Exam terminated";
   53: 
   54:     default:
   55:       return incident.type;
   56:   }
   57: }

   78:   return (
   79:     <Card
   80:       className={`overflow-hidden rounded-3xl ${

   85:     >
   86:       <div
   87:         className={`p-6 ${
   88:           submission.integrityTerminated
   89:             ? "bg-red-950 text-white"
   90:             : "bg-slate-950 text-white"
   91:         }`}
   92:       >
   93:         <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   94:           <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5" />
   95: 
   96:           <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-white/70">

   85:   { value: "trace", label: "Trace" },
   86:   { value: "debug", label: "Debug" },
   87:   { value: "design", label: "Design" },
   88:   { value: "evaluate", label: "Evaluate" },
   89:   { value: "discuss", label: "Discuss" },
   90: ];
   91: 
   92: const DIFFICULTY_OPTIONS: {
   93:   value: ExamQuestionDifficulty;
   94:   label: string;
   95: }[] = [
   96:   { value: "foundation", label: "Foundation" },
   97:   { value: "standard", label: "Standard" },
   98:   { value: "higher", label: "Higher" },
   99: ];
  100: 
  101: const DEFAULT_BLUEPRINT_PATTERN = [
  102:   {
  103:     assessmentObjective: "AO1" as const,
  104:     questionType: "multiple-choice" as const,
  105:     commandWord: "identify" as const,
  106:     marks: 1,
  107:   },
  108:   {
  109:     assessmentObjective: "AO1" as const,
  110:     questionType: "conversion" as const,
  111:     commandWord: "calculate" as const,
  112:     marks: 2,
  113:   },
  114:   {
  115:     assessmentObjective: "AO2" as const,
  116:     questionType: "worked-calculation" as const,
  117:     commandWord: "complete" as const,
  118:     marks: 4,
  119:   },
  120:   {
  121:     assessmentObjective: "AO3" as const,
  122:     questionType: "evaluate" as const,
  123:     commandWord: "evaluate" as const,
  124:     marks: 6,
  125:   },
  126: ];
  127: 
  128: function createBlueprintId(): string {
  129:   return `blueprint-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
  130: }
  131: 
  132: function renumber(
  133:   blueprint: AssessmentBlueprintItem[],
  134: ): AssessmentBlueprintItem[] {
  135:   return blueprint.map((item, index) => ({
  136:     ...item,
  137:     questionNumber: index + 1,
  138:   }));
  139: }
  140: 
  141: function commandWordForType(
  142:   questionType: AssessmentQuestionType,
  143: ): ExamQuestionCommandWord {
  144:   const mapping: Record<AssessmentQuestionType, ExamQuestionCommandWord> = {
  145:     "multiple-choice": "identify",
  146:     "state-identify": "state",
  147:     "short-response": "describe",
  148:     definition: "define",
  149:     conversion: "calculate",
  150:     calculation: "calculate",
  151:     "worked-calculation": "complete",
  152:     "complete-table": "complete",
  153:     "trace-table": "trace",
  154:     "truth-table": "complete",
  155:     "code-completion": "complete",
  156:     "code-tracing": "trace",
  157:     debugging: "debug",
  158:     "algorithm-design": "design",
  159:     compare: "compare",
  160:     explain: "explain",
  161:     "scenario-application": "explain",
  162:     "extended-response": "discuss",
  163:     discuss: "discuss",
  164:     evaluate: "evaluate",
  165:   };
  166: 
  167:   return mapping[questionType];
  168: }
  169: 
  170: export function createBalancedBlueprint(
  171:   topic: string,
  172:   defaultDifficulty: ExamQuestionDifficulty,
  173: ): AssessmentBlueprintItem[] {
  174:   const topicFocus = topic.trim() || "Computer Science";
  175: 
  176:   return DEFAULT_BLUEPRINT_PATTERN.map((pattern, index) => ({
  177:     id: createBlueprintId(),
  178:     questionNumber: index + 1,
  179:     assessmentObjective: pattern.assessmentObjective,
  180:     questionType: pattern.questionType,
  181:     commandWord: pattern.commandWord,
  182:     marks: pattern.marks,
  183:     difficulty:
  184:       index === 0
  185:         ? "foundation"
  186:         : index === DEFAULT_BLUEPRINT_PATTERN.length - 1
  187:           ? "higher"
  188:           : defaultDifficulty,
  189:     topicFocus,
  190:   }));
  191: }
  192: 
  193: export default function AssessmentBlueprintBuilder({
  194:   topic,
  195:   defaultDifficulty,
  196:   blueprint,
  197:   disabled = false,
  198:   onChange,
  199: }: Props) {
  200:   const totalMarks = blueprint.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.marks, 0);
  201: 
  202:   const objectiveTotals = blueprint.reduce(
  203:     (totals, item) => {
  204:       totals[item.assessmentObjective] += item.marks;
  205:       return totals;
  206:     },
  207:     {
  208:       AO1: 0,
  209:       AO2: 0,
  210:       AO3: 0,
  211:     },
  212:   );
  213: 
  214:   function updateItem<Key extends keyof AssessmentBlueprintItem>(
  215:     itemId: string,
  216:     key: Key,
  217:     value: AssessmentBlueprintItem[Key],
  218:   ) {
  219:     onChange(
  220:       blueprint.map((item) => {
  221:         if (item.id !== itemId) {
  222:           return item;
  223:         }
  224: 
  225:         if (key === "questionType") {
  226:           const nextType = value as AssessmentQuestionType;
  227: 
  228:           return {
  229:             ...item,
  230:             questionType: nextType,
  231:             commandWord: commandWordForType(nextType),
  232:           };
  233:         }
  234: 
  235:         return {
  236:           ...item,
  237:           [key]: value,
  238:         };
  239:       }),
  240:     );
  241:   }
  242: 
  243:   function addQuestion() {
  244:     const previous = blueprint[blueprint.length - 1];
  245: 
  246:     onChange(
  247:       renumber([
  248:         ...blueprint,
  249:         {
  250:           id: createBlueprintId(),
  251:           questionNumber: blueprint.length + 1,
  252:           assessmentObjective: previous?.assessmentObjective || "AO1",
  253:           questionType: "short-response",
  254:           commandWord: "describe",
  255:           marks: 2,
  256:           difficulty: previous?.difficulty || defaultDifficulty,
  257:           topicFocus:
  258:             previous?.topicFocus || topic.trim() || "Computer Science",
  259:         },
  260:       ]),
  261:     );
  262:   }
  263: 
  264:   function duplicateQuestion(itemId: string) {
  265:     const index = blueprint.findIndex((item) => item.id === itemId);
  266: 
  267:     if (index === -1) {
  268:       return;
  269:     }
  270: 
  271:     const copy = {
  272:       ...blueprint[index],
  273:       id: createBlueprintId(),
  274:     };
  275: 
  276:     onChange(
  277:       renumber([
  278:         ...blueprint.slice(0, index + 1),
  279:         copy,
  280:         ...blueprint.slice(index + 1),
  281:       ]),
  282:     );
  283:   }
  284: 
  285:   function removeQuestion(itemId: string) {
  286:     if (blueprint.length <= 1) {
  287:       return;
  288:     }
  289: 
  290:     onChange(renumber(blueprint.filter((item) => item.id !== itemId)));
  291:   }
  292: 
  293:   function moveQuestion(itemId: string, direction: -1 | 1) {
  294:     const index = blueprint.findIndex((item) => item.id === itemId);
  295: 
  296:     const target = index + direction;
  297: 
  298:     if (index < 0 || target < 0 || target >= blueprint.length) {
  299:       return;
  300:     }
  301: 
  302:     const next = [...blueprint];
  303:     const [moved] = next.splice(index, 1);
  304:     next.splice(target, 0, moved);
  305: 
  306:     onChange(renumber(next));
  307:   }
  308: 
  309:   function percentage(value: number): number {
  310:     return totalMarks === 0 ? 0 : Math.round((value / totalMarks) * 100);
  311:   }
  312: 
  313:   return (
  314:     <section className="space-y-6">
  315:       <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 p-5 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
  316:         <div>
  317:           <p className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-indigo-700">
  318:             Assessment blueprint
  319:           </p>
  320: 
  321:           <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-6 text-indigo-900">
  322:             Choose the assessment objective, question type, command word, marks,
  323:             difficulty and topic focus for every question.
  324:           </p>
  325:         </div>
  326: 
  327:         <button
  328:           type="button"
  329:           onClick={() =>
  330:             onChange(createBalancedBlueprint(topic, defaultDifficulty))
  331:           }
  332:           disabled={disabled}
  333:           className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-indigo-300 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-indigo-800 transition hover:bg-indigo-100 disabled:opacity-50"
  334:         >
  335:           <RefreshCcw className="h-4 w-4" />
  336:           Balanced blueprint
  337:         </button>
  338:       </div>
  339: 
  340:       <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
  341:         <SummaryCard label="Questions" value={String(blueprint.length)} />
  342:         <SummaryCard label="Total marks" value={String(totalMarks)} />
  343:         <SummaryCard
  344:           label="AO1"
  345:           value={`${percentage(objectiveTotals.AO1)}%`}
  346:         />
  347:         <SummaryCard
  348:           label="AO2 / AO3"
  349:           value={`${percentage(objectiveTotals.AO2)}% / ${percentage(objectiveTotals.AO3)}%`}
  350:         />
  351:       </div>
  352: 
  353:       <div className="space-y-4">
  354:         {blueprint.map((item, index) => (
  355:           <article
  356:             key={item.id}
  357:             className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5"
  358:           >
  359:             <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
  360:               <div>
  361:                 <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-indigo-600">
  362:                   Question {item.questionNumber}
  363:                 </p>
  364: 
  365:                 <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
  366:                   Configure this question before generation.
  367:                 </p>
  368:               </div>
  369: 
  370:               <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
  371:                 <button
  372:                   type="button"
  373:                   disabled={disabled || index === 0}
  374:                   onClick={() => moveQuestion(item.id, -1)}
  375:                   className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 p-2 text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-30"
  376:                   aria-label={`Move question ${item.questionNumber} up`}
  377:                 >
  378:                   <ArrowUp className="h-4 w-4" />
  379:                 </button>
  380: 
  381:                 <button
  382:                   type="button"
  383:                   disabled={disabled || index === blueprint.length - 1}
  384:                   onClick={() => moveQuestion(item.id, 1)}
  385:                   className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 p-2 text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-30"
  386:                   aria-label={`Move question ${item.questionNumber} down`}
  387:                 >
  388:                   <ArrowDown className="h-4 w-4" />
  389:                 </button>
  390: 
  391:                 <button
  392:                   type="button"
  393:                   disabled={disabled}
  394:                   onClick={() => duplicateQuestion(item.id)}
  395:                   className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 p-2 text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50 disabled:opacity-30"
  396:                   aria-label={`Duplicate question ${item.questionNumber}`}
  397:                 >
  398:                   <Copy className="h-4 w-4" />
  399:                 </button>
  400: 
  401:                 <button
  402:                   type="button"
  403:                   disabled={disabled || blueprint.length <= 1}
  404:                   onClick={() => removeQuestion(item.id)}
  405:                   className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 p-2 text-red-600 transition hover:bg-red-50 disabled:opacity-30"
  406:                   aria-label={`Delete question ${item.questionNumber}`}
  407:                 >

  421:                   disabled={disabled}
  422:                   onChange={(event) =>
  423:                     updateItem(
  424:                       item.id,
  425:                       "assessmentObjective",
  426:                       event.target.value as AssessmentObjective,

  428:                   }

  430:                 >
  431:                   {OBJECTIVE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
  432:                     <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>
  433:                       {option.label}

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import Link from "next/link";
    4: import { ArrowRight, Search } from "lucide-react";

    6: 
    7: import Card from "@/components/ui/Card";
    8: import { useTeacherIntelligence } from "@/hooks/useTeacherIntelligence";
    9: import { getPriorityStudents } from "@/services/analytics/teacherIntelligenceIntegrationService";
   10: 
   11: export default function StudentsIntelligencePanel() {
   12:   const { portfolio, loading, error } = useTeacherIntelligence();
   13:   const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
   14: 
   15:   const rows = useMemo(() => {
   16:     if (!portfolio) return [];
   17: 
   18:     const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
   19: 
   20:     return getPriorityStudents(portfolio).filter((student) => {
   21:       if (!query) return true;
   22: 
   23:       return (
   24:         student.studentName.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
   25:         student.studentEmail.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
   26:         student.className.toLowerCase().includes(query)
   27:       );
   28:     });
   29:   }, [portfolio, search]);
   30: 
   31:   if (loading) {
   32:     return (
   33:       <Card className="h-64 animate-pulse rounded-3xl bg-slate-100">

   35:       </Card>
   36:     );
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   if (error || !portfolio) {
   40:     return null;
   41:   }
   42: 
   43:   return (
   44:     <Card className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200">
   45:       <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-slate-200 p-6 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">

   63:           />
   64:         </div>
   65:       </div>
   66:

   30: 
   31: function validateResourceForPublishing(
   32:   resource: GeneratedTeachingResource,
   33: ): string[] {
   34:   const issues: string[] = [];
   35: 
   36:   if (!resource.title?.trim()) {
   37:     issues.push("The resource needs a title.");
   38:   }
   39: 
   40:   if (!resource.topic?.trim()) {
   41:     issues.push("The resource needs a topic.");
   42:   }

   53:     issues.push("Add at least one complete learning objective.");
   54:   }
   55: 
   56:   if (
   57:     !resource.successCriteria ||
   58:     resource.successCriteria.length === 0 ||
   59:     resource.successCriteria.some((criterion) => !criterion.trim())
   60:   ) {
   61:     issues.push("Add at least one complete success criterion.");
   62:   }
   63: 
   64:   if (!resource.sections || resource.sections.length === 0) {
   65:     issues.push("Add at least one lesson section.");
   66:   } else {
   67:     const incompleteSection = resource.sections.some(
   68:       (section) =>
   69:         !section.title?.trim() ||
   70:         !section.teacherInstructions?.trim() ||
   71:         !section.studentTask?.trim(),
   72:     );
   73: 
   74:     if (incompleteSection) {
   75:       issues.push(
   76:         "Every lesson section needs a title, teacher instructions and student task.",
   77:       );
   78:     }
   79:   }
   80: 
   81:   if (
   82:     !resource.assessmentQuestions ||
   83:     resource.assessmentQuestions.length === 0
   84:   ) {
   85:     issues.push("Add at least one assessment question.");
   86:   } else {
   87:     const incompleteQuestion = resource.assessmentQuestions.some(
   88:       (question) =>
   89:         !question.question?.trim() ||
   90:         !question.answer?.trim() ||
   91:         question.marks < 1,
   92:     );
   93: 
   94:     if (incompleteQuestion) {
   95:       issues.push(
   96:         "Every assessment question needs a question, model answer and valid mark value.",
   97:       );
   98:     }
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   return issues;
  102: }

  104: export default function ResourcePublishControls({
  105:   resourceId,
  106:   status,
  107:   content,
  108:   onStatusChange,
  109: }: ResourcePublishControlsProps) {
  110:   const [confirmationAction, setConfirmationAction] =
  111:     useState<ConfirmationAction>(null);
  112: 
  113:   const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);
  114: 
  115:   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  116: 
  117:   const [success, setSuccess] = useState<string | null>(null);
  118: 
  119:   const [validationIssues, setValidationIssues] = useState<string[]>([]);
  120: 
  121:   useEffect(() => {
  122:     if (!success) {
  123:       return;
  124:     }
  125: 
  126:     const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
  127:       setSuccess(null);
  128:     }, 4000);
  129: 
  130:     return () => {
  131:       window.clearTimeout(timer);
  132:     };

  135:   useEffect(() => {
  136:     if (!confirmationAction) {
  137:       return;
  138:     }
  139: 
  140:     function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  141:       if (event.key === "Escape" && !updating) {
  142:         setConfirmationAction(null);
  143:       }
  144:     }
  145: 
  146:     window.addEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  147: 
  148:     return () => {
  149:       window.removeEventListener("keydown", handleKeyDown);
  150:     };
  151:   }, [confirmationAction, updating]);
  152: 
  153:   function openPublishConfirmation() {
  154:     const issues = validateResourceForPublishing(content);
  155: 
  156:     setError(null);
  157:     setSuccess(null);

  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   function openUnpublishConfirmation() {
  163:     setError(null);
  164:     setSuccess(null);
  165:     setValidationIssues([]);
  166:     setConfirmationAction("unpublish");
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   function closeConfirmation() {
  170:     if (updating) {
  171:       return;
  172:     }
  173: 
  174:     setConfirmationAction(null);
  175:     setValidationIssues([]);
  176:   }
  177: 
  178:   async function confirmStatusChange() {
  179:     if (!confirmationAction) {
  180:       return;
  181:     }
  182: 
  183:     if (confirmationAction === "publish" && validationIssues.length > 0) {
  184:       return;
  185:     }

  188:       confirmationAction === "publish" ? "published" : "draft";

  203:       );
  204:

  206:       setValidationIssues([]);
  207:     } catch (caughtError) {

  209: 
  210:       setError(
  211:         caughtError instanceof Error
  212:           ? caughtError.message
  213:           : "The resource status could not be updated.",
  214:       );
  215:     } finally {
  216:       setUpdating(false);
  217:     }
  218:   }
  219: 
  220:   return (

  225:             Archived Â· restore this resource from the Content Hub

  232:           >
  233:             <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
  234:             Publish resource
  235:           </button>

  237:           <button
  238:             type="button"

  241:           >

   26: export default function StudentInterventionHistoryPanel({
   27:   teacherId,

   29: }: {
   30:   teacherId: string;
   31:   studentId: string;
   32: }) {
   33:   const [items, setItems] =
   34:     useState<TeacherInterventionHistoryItem[]>([]);
   35:   const [selectedImpactId, setSelectedImpactId] =
   36:     useState<string | null>(null);
   37:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
   38:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
   39: 
   40:   useEffect(() => {
   41:     let cancelled = false;
   42: 
   43:     async function load() {
   44:       try {
   45:         setLoading(true);
   46:         setError("");
   47: 
   48:         const history =
   49:           await getTeacherStudentInterventionHistory({
   50:             teacherId,
   51:             studentId,
   52:           });
   53: 
   54:         if (!cancelled) {
   55:           setItems(history);
   56: 
   57:           if (
   58:             selectedImpactId &&
   59:             !history.some((item) => item.id === selectedImpactId)
   60:           ) {
   61:             setSelectedImpactId(null);
   62:           }
   63:         }
   64:       } catch (caughtError) {
   65:         console.error(
   66:           "Unable to load intervention history:",
   67:           caughtError,
   68:         );
   69: 
   70:         if (!cancelled) {
   71:           setItems([]);
   72:           setSelectedImpactId(null);
   73:           setError(
   74:             caughtError instanceof Error
   75:               ? caughtError.message
   76:               : "Intervention history could not be loaded.",
   77:           );
   78:         }
   79:       } finally {
   80:         if (!cancelled) {
   81:           setLoading(false);
   82:         }
   83:       }
   84:     }
   85: 
   86:     void load();
   87: 
   88:     return () => {
   89:       cancelled = true;
   90:     };
   91:   }, [studentId, teacherId, selectedImpactId]);
   92: 
   93:   if (loading) {
   94:     return (
   95:       <Card className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200">
   96:         <div className="h-44 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-slate-100" />
   97:       </Card>
   98:     );
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   return (
  102:     <div className="space-y-5">
  103:       <Card className="overflow-hidden rounded-3xl border border-slate-200">
  104:         <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 p-6">

  114:               Support record
  115:             </h2>
  116:           </div>
  117:         </div>
  118: 
  119:         {error ? (
  120:           <div className="p-6 text-sm text-red-700">
  121:             {error}
  122:           </div>

  125:             No interventions have been recorded for this learner yet.
  126:           </div>

  129:             {items.map((item) => {

  132:

  240:     match /studentTargets/{studentId} {
  241:   function signedInForTarget() {
  242:     return request.auth != null;
  243:   }
  244: 
  245:   function isTargetStudent() {
  246:     return signedInForTarget() && request.auth.uid == studentId;
  247:   }
  248: 
  249:   function isTargetAdmin() {
  250:     return signedInForTarget()
  251:       && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.role == "admin";
  252:   }
  253: 
  254:   function teacherOwnsTargetClass(classId) {
  255:     return signedInForTarget()
  256:       && classId is string
  257:       && exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId))
  258:       && get(/databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId)).data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
  259:       && studentId in get(/databases/$(database)/documents/classes/$(classId)).data.studentIds;
  260:   }
  261: 
  262:   allow read: if isTargetStudent()
  263:     || isTargetAdmin()
  264:     || (
  265:       resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
  266:       && teacherOwnsTargetClass(resource.data.classId)
  267:     );
  268: 
  269:   allow create: if isTargetAdmin()
  270:     || (
  271:       request.resource.data.studentId == studentId
  272:       && request.resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
  273:       && teacherOwnsTargetClass(request.resource.data.classId)
  274:     );
  275: 
  276:   allow update: if isTargetAdmin()
  277:     || (
  278:       resource.data.studentId == studentId
  279:       && request.resource.data.studentId == studentId
  280:       && request.resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
  281:       && teacherOwnsTargetClass(request.resource.data.classId)
  282:     );
  283: 
  284:   allow delete: if isTargetAdmin()
  285:     || (
  286:       resource.data.teacherId == request.auth.uid
  287:       && teacherOwnsTargetClass(resource.data.classId)
  288:     );
  289: }

  294:     // ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â‚¬ÂÃ¢â€šÂ¬

  296:   match /users/{userId} {
  297: 
  298:   allow get: if signedIn() &&
  299:     (
  300:       currentUserId() == userId ||
  301:       isAdmin() ||
  302:       (
  303:         isTeacher() &&
  304:         sameSchoolUser(userId)
  305:       )
  306:     );
  307: 
  308:   allow list: if signedIn() &&
  309:     (
  310:       isAdmin() ||
  311:       (
  312:         isTeacher() &&
  313:         currentUserHasSchool() &&
  314:         resource.data.schoolId == currentSchoolId()
  315:       )
  316:     );
  317: 
  318:   allow create: if signedIn() &&
  319:     currentUserId() == userId &&
  320:     request.resource.data.uid == currentUserId() &&
  321:     request.resource.data.role == "student" &&
  322:     request.resource.data.email ==
  323:       request.auth.token.email &&
  324:     (
  325:       !("accountIntent" in request.resource.data) ||
  326:       request.resource.data.accountIntent == "student" ||
  327:       request.resource.data.accountIntent == "teacher"
  328:     ) &&
  329:     (
  330:       !("teacherAccessStatus" in request.resource.data) ||
  331:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "not_submitted" ||
  332:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "pending"
  333:     ) &&
  334:     validQualification(request.resource.data) &&
  335:     validExamBoard(request.resource.data) &&
  336:     validOnboardingStatus(request.resource.data) &&
  337:     validAccountType(request.resource.data) &&
  338:     validPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) &&
  339:     validEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) &&
  340:     validSchoolIdField(request.resource.data) &&
  341:     userAccountType(request.resource.data) == "individual" &&
  342:     userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) == "free" &&
  343:     userSchoolId(request.resource.data) == "";
  344: 
  345:   /*
  346:    * Self-service profile update.
  347:    *
  348:    * This version is intentionally legacy-safe:
  349:    * old accounts that pre-date schoolId/accountType/personalPlan
  350:    * are interpreted as:
  351:    *
  352:    *   schoolId     = ""
  353:    *   accountType  = "individual"
  354:    *   personalPlan = "free"
  355:    *
  356:    * That lets an authenticated teacher move into a school account
  357:    * only when the matching active school membership exists after
  358:    * the same atomic write.
  359:    */
  360:    /*
  361:  * Legacy approved teacher -> school account migration.
  362:  *
  363:  * Older development teacher accounts can pre-date schoolId,
  364:  * accountType and plan fields. This permits only the one-time
  365:  * transition into an active school membership created in the
  366:  * same atomic batch.
  367:  */
  368: allow update: if signedIn() &&
  369:   currentUserId() == userId &&
  370: 
  371:   (
  372:     resource.data.role == "teacher" ||
  373:     resource.data.role == "admin"
  374:   ) &&
  375: 
  376:   request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role &&
  377:   request.resource.data.uid == currentUserId() &&
  378:   request.resource.data.email == resource.data.email &&
  379: 
  380:   (
  381:     !("schoolId" in resource.data) ||
  382:     resource.data.schoolId == null ||
  383:     resource.data.schoolId == ""
  384:   ) &&
  385: 
  386:   request.resource.data.schoolId is string &&
  387:   request.resource.data.schoolId != "" &&
  388: 
  389:   request.resource.data.accountType == "school" &&
  390:   request.resource.data.plan == "school" &&
  391: 
  392:   activeMembershipAfter(
  393:     request.resource.data.schoolId,
  394:     currentUserId()
  395:   ) &&
  396: 
  397:   request.resource.data
  398:     .diff(resource.data)
  399:     .affectedKeys()
  400:     .hasOnly([
  401:       "uid",
  402:       "schoolId",
  403:       "accountType",
  404:       "plan",
  405:       "personalPlan",
  406:       "updatedAt"
  407:     ]);
  408:     
  409:   allow update: if signedIn() &&
  410:     currentUserId() == userId &&
  411:     request.resource.data.uid == currentUserId() &&
  412:     request.resource.data.email == resource.data.email &&
  413:     (
  414:       (
  415:         "role" in resource.data &&
  416:         request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role
  417:       ) ||
  418:       (
  419:         !("role" in resource.data) &&
  420:         request.resource.data.role == "student"
  421:       )
  422:     ) &&
  423:     (
  424:       !("accountIntent" in request.resource.data) ||
  425:       !("accountIntent" in resource.data) ||
  426:       request.resource.data.accountIntent == resource.data.accountIntent ||
  427:       request.resource.data.accountIntent == "student" ||
  428:       request.resource.data.accountIntent == "teacher"
  429:     ) &&
  430:     (
  431:       !("teacherAccessStatus" in request.resource.data) ||
  432:       !("teacherAccessStatus" in resource.data) ||
  433:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus ==
  434:         resource.data.teacherAccessStatus ||
  435:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "not_submitted" ||
  436:       request.resource.data.teacherAccessStatus == "pending"
  437:     ) &&
  438:     validQualification(request.resource.data) &&
  439:     validExamBoard(request.resource.data) &&
  440:     validOnboardingStatus(request.resource.data) &&
  441:     validAccountType(request.resource.data) &&
  442:     validPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) &&
  443:     validEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) &&
  444:     validSchoolIdField(request.resource.data) &&
  445:     request.resource.data
  446:       .diff(resource.data)
  447:       .affectedKeys()
  448:       .hasOnly([
  449:         "uid",
  450:         "name",
  451:         "email",
  452:         "role",
  453:         "accountIntent",
  454:         "teacherAccessStatus",
  455:         "accountType",
  456:         "plan",
  457:         "personalPlan",
  458:         "schoolId",
  459:         "currentCourse",
  460:         "qualification",
  461:         "examBoard",
  462:         "onboardingComplete",
  463:         "xp",
  464:         "streak",
  465:         "badges",
  466:         "completedLessons",
  467:         "completedTopics",
  468:         "completedUnits",
  469:         "completedPapers",
  470:         "classIds",
  471:         "updatedAt"
  472:       ]) &&
  473:     (
  474:       /*
  475:        * Normal update while staying in the same tenant/account state.
  476:        */
  477:       (
  478:         userSchoolId(request.resource.data) ==
  479:           userSchoolId(resource.data) &&
  480:         userAccountType(request.resource.data) ==
  481:           userAccountType(resource.data) &&
  482:         (
  483:           userAccountType(request.resource.data) == "school" ||
  484:           userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) ==
  485:             userPersonalPlan(request.resource.data)
  486:         )
  487:       ) ||
  488: 
  489:       /*
  490:        * Join/create a school.
  491:        *
  492:        * The resulting membership must already exist as ACTIVE
  493:        * after this same atomic write.
  494:        */
  495:       (
  496:         userSchoolId(request.resource.data) != "" &&
  497:         userAccountType(request.resource.data) == "school" &&
  498:         userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) == "school" &&
  499:         activeMembershipAfter(
  500:           userSchoolId(request.resource.data),
  501:           currentUserId()
  502:         )
  503:       ) ||
  504: 
  505:       /*
  506:        * Leave a school.
  507:        *
  508:        * The previous membership must become FORMER in the
  509:        * same atomic operation.
  510:        */
  511:       (
  512:         userSchoolId(request.resource.data) == "" &&
  513:         userAccountType(request.resource.data) == "individual" &&
  514:         userEffectivePlan(request.resource.data) ==
  515:           userPersonalPlan(request.resource.data) &&
  516:         userSchoolId(resource.data) != "" &&
  517:         existsAfter(
  518:           /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(userSchoolId(resource.data))/members/$(currentUserId())
  519:         ) &&
  520:         getAfter(
  521:           /databases/$(database)/documents/schools/$(userSchoolId(resource.data))/members/$(currentUserId())
  522:         ).data.status == "former"
  523:       )
  524:     );
  525: 
  526: 
  527:   /*
  528:    * Teacher may only maintain classIds on a student
  529:    * inside the same school.
  530:    */
  531:   allow update: if isTeacher() &&
  532:     resource.data.role == "student" &&
  533:     request.resource.data.role == resource.data.role &&
  534:     (
  535:       isAdmin() ||
  536:       sameSchoolUser(userId)
  537:     ) &&
  538:     request.resource.data
  539:       .diff(resource.data)
  540:       .affectedKeys()
  541:       .hasOnly([
  542:         "classIds",
  543:         "updatedAt"
  544:       ]);
  545: 
  546:   allow delete: if isAdmin();
  547: }

  701:     match /assignmentProgress/{progressId} {
  702: 
  703:   /*
  704:    * Students can read their own progress.
  705:    * The teacher who owns the corresponding class assignment

  707:    * Admins can read all progress.

  709:    * A missing progress document may still be read directly by

  714:     (

  724:           ) ||
  725:           isAdmin()
  726:         )
  727:       ) ||
  728: 
  729:       /*
  730:        * Allows the app to check a student's own missing document.

  732:       progressId.matches(
  733:         "^.*_" + currentUserId() + "$"
  734:       ) ||
  735: 
  736:       /*
  737:        * A teacher-side analytics loader may directly check an expected
  738:        * progress document before the student has created it. Returning
  739:        * "not found" for a missing document does not expose student data.
  740:        */
  741:       (resource == null && isTeacher())
  742:     );
  743: 
  744:   allow list: if signedIn() &&
  745:     (
  746:       resource.data.studentId == currentUserId() ||

  748:         resource.data.assignmentId
  749:       ) ||
  750:       isAdmin()

  756:     request.resource.data.assignmentId is string &&

  758:       "not_started",
  759:       "in_progress",
  760:       "completed"
  761:     ];
  762: 
  763:   allow update: if signedIn() &&
  764:     resource.data.studentId ==
  765:       currentUserId() &&
  766:     request.resource.data.studentId ==
  767:       resource.data.studentId &&
  768:     request.resource.data.assignmentId ==
  769:       resource.data.assignmentId &&
  770:     request.resource.data.status in [
  771:       "not_started",
  772:       "in_progress",
  773:       "completed"
  774:     ] &&
  775:     request.resource.data

  779:         "status",

  782:         "updatedAt"

  791:  *
  792:  * Assignment identity, student identity, class/teacher ownership
  793:  * and assignment configuration cannot be changed here.
  794:  */

  796: 
  797:   // This must remain the student's own progress document.

  799:   request.resource.data.studentId == resource.data.studentId &&
  800:   request.resource.data.assignmentId == resource.data.assignmentId &&
  801:

  814:     /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
  815:   ).data.studentIds &&
  816:

  819:     get(
  820:       /databases/$(database)/documents/classAssignments/$(resource.data.assignmentId)
  821:     ).data.resourceId &&

  824:   request.resource.data.programmingCode is string &&
  825:   request.resource.data.programmingAttempts is int &&

  827:   request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount is int &&
  828:   request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount >= 0 &&
  829:   request.resource.data.programmingTotalTests is int &&
  830:   request.resource.data.programmingTotalTests >= 0 &&
  831:   request.resource.data.programmingPassedCount <=

FILE: lib\firebaseAdmin.ts
==============================================================================================================
    1: import "server-only";
    2: 
    3: import {
    4:   applicationDefault,
    5:   cert,
    6:   getApps,
    7:   initializeApp,
    8:   type App,
    9: } from "firebase-admin/app";
   10: 
   11: import { getAuth, type Auth } from "firebase-admin/auth";
   12: import {
   13:   getFirestore,
   14:   type Firestore,
   15: } from "firebase-admin/firestore";
   16: 
   17: let cachedApp: App | null = null;
   18: let cachedAuth: Auth | null = null;
   19: let cachedDb: Firestore | null = null;
   20: 
   21: function initialiseFirebaseAdmin(): App {
   22:   if (cachedApp) {
   23:     return cachedApp;
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   const existingApps = getApps();
   27: 
   28:   if (existingApps.length > 0) {
   29:     cachedApp = existingApps[0];
   30:     return cachedApp;
   31:   }
   32: 
   33:   const projectId =
   34:     process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID?.trim();
   35: 
   36:   const clientEmail =
   37:     process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_CLIENT_EMAIL?.trim();
   38: 
   39:   const privateKeyBase64 =
   40:     process.env.FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64?.trim();
   41: 
   42:   if (
   43:     projectId &&
   44:     clientEmail &&
   45:     privateKeyBase64
   46:   ) {
   47:     const privateKey = Buffer.from(
   48:       privateKeyBase64,
   49:       "base64",
   50:     ).toString("utf8");
   51: 
   52:     if (
   53:       !privateKey.includes(
   54:         "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----",
   55:       ) ||
   56:       !privateKey.includes(
   57:         "-----END PRIVATE KEY-----",
   58:       )
   59:     ) {
   60:       throw new Error(
   61:         "FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64 did not decode to a valid PEM private key.",
   62:       );
   63:     }
   64: 
   65:     cachedApp = initializeApp({
   66:       projectId,
   67:       credential: cert({
   68:         projectId,
   69:         clientEmail,
   70:         privateKey,
   71:       }),
   72:     });
   73: 
   74:     return cachedApp;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   if (
   78:     process.env.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
   79:   ) {
   80:     cachedApp = initializeApp({
   81:       credential: applicationDefault(),
   82:       projectId:
   83:         projectId ||
   84:         process.env.GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT ||
   85:         process.env.GCLOUD_PROJECT,
   86:     });
   87: 
   88:     return cachedApp;
   89:   }
   90: 
   91:   throw new Error(
   92:     [
   93:       "Firebase Admin is not configured.",
   94:       "",
   95:       "For local development, set:",
   96:       "GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS",
   97:       "",
   98:       "Or configure these server-only variables:",
   99:       "FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID",
  100:       "FIREBASE_ADMIN_CLIENT_EMAIL",
  101:       "FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64",
  102:       "",
  103:       "Do not prefix Admin variables with NEXT_PUBLIC_.",
  104:     ].join("\n"),
  105:   );
  106: }
  107: 
  108: function getAdminAuth(): Auth {
  109:   if (!cachedAuth) {
  110:     cachedAuth = getAuth(
  111:       initialiseFirebaseAdmin(),
  112:     );
  113:   }
  114: 
  115:   return cachedAuth;
  116: }
  117: 
  118: function getAdminDb(): Firestore {
  119:   if (!cachedDb) {
  120:     cachedDb = getFirestore(
  121:       initialiseFirebaseAdmin(),
  122:     );
  123:   }
  124: 
  125:   return cachedDb;
  126: }
  127: 
  128: /*
  129:  * Lazy proxies are deliberate.
  130:  *
  131:  * API routes can import adminAuth/adminDb during `next build`
  132:  * without immediately initialising Firebase Admin. Credentials
  133:  * are required only when a route actually performs an Admin SDK
  134:  * operation at request time.
  135:  */
  136: export const adminAuth = new Proxy(
  137:   {} as Auth,
  138:   {
  139:     get(_target, property, receiver) {
  140:       return Reflect.get(
  141:         getAdminAuth(),
  142:         property,
  143:         receiver,
  144:       );
  145:     },
  146:   },
  147: );
  148: 
  149: export const adminDb = new Proxy(
  150:   {} as Firestore,
  151:   {
  152:     get(_target, property, receiver) {
  153:       return Reflect.get(
  154:         getAdminDb(),
  155:         property,
  156:         receiver,
  157:       );
  158:     },
  159:   },
  160: );

   81: function priorityRank(
   82:   priority: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow["interventionPriority"],
   83: ): number {
   84:   if (priority === "high") return 4;
   85:   if (priority === "medium") return 3;
   86:   if (priority === "monitor") return 2;
   87:   return 1;
