   90: function studentPriority(
   91:   priority: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow["interventionPriority"],
   92: ): TeacherActionPriority {
   93:   if (
   94:     priority === "high" ||
   95:     priority === "medium" ||
   96:     priority === "monitor"
   97:   ) {
   98:     return priority;
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   return "none";
  102: }
  103: 
  104: function weakestTopicForStudent(
  105:   student: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow,
  106: ): {
  107:   topic: string;
  108:   percentage: number | null;
  109: } {
  110:   const topics = [...student.analytics.topics]
  111:     .filter((topic) => topic.evidenceCount > 0)
  112:     .sort(
  113:       (first, second) =>
  114:         first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
  115:     );
  116: 
  117:   const weakest = topics[0];
  118: 
  119:   return weakest
  120:     ? {
  121:         topic: weakest.topic,
  122:         percentage: weakest.weightedPercentage,
  123:       }
  124:     : {
  125:         topic: "No assessed topic evidence",
  126:         percentage: null,
  127:       };
  128: }
  129: 
  130: function normaliseStudent({
  131:   student,
  132:   classItem,
  133: }: {
  134:   student: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow;
  135:   classItem: TeacherClassAnalytics;
  136: }): TeacherActionStudent {
  137:   const weakest = weakestTopicForStudent(student);
  138: 
  139:   return {
  140:     key: `${classItem.classId}-${student.studentId}`,
  141:     studentId: student.studentId,
  142:     studentName: student.studentName,
  143:     studentEmail: student.studentEmail,
  144:     classId: classItem.classId,
  145:     className: classItem.className,
  146:     workingGrade: student.workingGrade || "â€”",
  147:     targetGrade: student.targetGrade || "Not set",
  148:     gradeGap: student.gradeGap,
  149:     completionRate: student.completionRate,
  150:     trend: student.trend,
  151:     confidence: String(student.confidence),
  152:     priority: studentPriority(student.interventionPriority),
  153:     reasons: student.interventionReasons || [],
  154:     weakestTopic: weakest.topic,
  155:     weakestTopicPercentage: weakest.percentage,
  156:   };
  157: }
  158: 
  159: function classTopics(
  160:   classItem: TeacherClassAnalytics,
  161: ): {
  162:   priority: ClassTopicAnalytics[];
  163:   strongest: ClassTopicAnalytics[];
  164: } {
  165:   const withEvidence = classItem.topicAnalytics.filter(
  166:     (topic) => topic.evidenceCount > 0,
  167:   );
  168: 
  169:   return {
  170:     /*
  171:      * "Priority" must mean that evidence actually needs attention.
  172:      * Secure topics must never be pulled into this list merely to fill
  173:      * four display slots.
  174:      *
  175:      * <50  = priority
  176:      * 50-69 = developing / watch
  177:      * 70+  = secure
  178:      *
  179:      * The action centre includes priority + developing topics (<70).
  180:      */
  181:     priority: [...withEvidence]
  182:       .filter(
  183:         (topic) =>
  184:           topic.weightedPercentage <
  185:           70,
  186:       )
  187:       .sort(
  188:         (first, second) =>
  189:           first.weightedPercentage -
  190:           second.weightedPercentage,
  191:       )
  192:       .slice(0, 4),
  193: 
  194:     strongest: [...withEvidence]
  195:       .filter(
  196:         (topic) =>
  197:           topic.weightedPercentage >=
  198:           70,
  199:       )
  200:       .sort(
  201:         (first, second) =>
  202:           second.weightedPercentage -
  203:           first.weightedPercentage,
  204:       )
  205:       .slice(0, 4),
  206:   };
  207: }
  208: 
  209: function normaliseClass(
  210:   classItem: TeacherClassAnalytics,
  211: ): TeacherActionClass {
  212:   const topics = classTopics(classItem);
  213: 
  214:   return {
  215:     classId: classItem.classId,
  216:     className: classItem.className,
  217:     yearGroup: classItem.yearGroup,
  218:     studentCount: classItem.studentCount,
  219:     studentsWithEvidence: classItem.studentsWithEvidence,
  220:     averageWorkingGrade: classItem.averageWorkingGrade || "â€”",
  221:     averageTargetGrade: classItem.averageTargetGrade || "Not set",
  222:     averageWeightedPercentage: classItem.averageWeightedPercentage,
  223:     averageCompletionRate: classItem.averageCompletionRate,
  224:     onOrAboveTargetPercentage: classItem.onOrAboveTargetPercentage,
  225:     highPriorityCount: classItem.highPriorityCount,
  226:     decliningCount: classItem.decliningCount,
  227:     lowEvidenceCount: classItem.lowEvidenceCount,
  228:     priorityTopics: topics.priority,
  229:     strongestTopics: topics.strongest,
  230:   };
  231: }
  232: 
  233: function aggregateTopics(
  234:   portfolio: TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio,
  235: ): ClassTopicAnalytics[] {
  236:   const groups = new Map<
  237:     string,
  238:     {
  239:       values: number[];
  240:       evidenceCount: number;
  241:       studentCount: number;
  242:     }
  243:   >();
  244: 
  245:   portfolio.classes
  246:     .flatMap((classItem) => classItem.topicAnalytics)
  247:     .forEach((topic) => {
  248:       if (topic.evidenceCount <= 0) return;
  249: 
  250:       const current = groups.get(topic.topic) || {
  251:         values: [],
  252:         evidenceCount: 0,
  253:         studentCount: 0,
  254:       };
  255: 
  256:       current.values.push(topic.weightedPercentage);
  257:       current.evidenceCount += topic.evidenceCount;
  258:       current.studentCount += topic.studentCount;
  259: 
  260:       groups.set(topic.topic, current);
  261:     });
  262: 
  263:   return Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([topic, group]) => {
  264:     const percentage =
  265:       group.values.length > 0
  266:         ? Math.round(
  267:             group.values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0) /
  268:               group.values.length,
  269:           )
  270:         : 0;
  271: 
  272:     return {
  273:       topic,
  274:       weightedPercentage: percentage,
  275:       recentPercentage: percentage,
  276:       evidenceCount: group.evidenceCount,
  277:       studentCount: group.studentCount,
  278:       status:
  279:         percentage >= 70
  280:           ? "secure"
  281:           : percentage >= 50
  282:             ? "developing"
  283:             : "priority",
  284:     };
  285:   });
  286: }
  287: 
  288: export async function getTeacherAnalyticsActionCentre(
  289:   teacherId: string,
  290: ): Promise<TeacherAnalyticsActionCentre> {
  291:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  292: 
  293:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  294:     throw new Error("A teacher account is required.");
  295:   }
  296: 
  297:   const [portfolio, interventions] = await Promise.all([
  298:     getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(cleanedTeacherId),
  299:     getTeacherInterventions(cleanedTeacherId),
  300:   ]);
  301: 
  302:   const allStudentRows = portfolio.classes.flatMap((classItem) =>
  303:     classItem.students.map((student) => ({
  304:       student,
  305:       classItem,
  306:     })),
  307:   );
  308: 
  309:   /*
  310:    * A learner can be in more than one class in the same school.
  311:    * Use the highest-priority class row when calculating unique-student
  312:    * headline metrics, while keeping class-specific rows for action lists.
  313:    */
  314:   const uniqueStudents = new Map<string, TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow>();
  315: 
  316:   allStudentRows.forEach(({ student }) => {
  317:     const current = uniqueStudents.get(student.studentId);
  318: 
  319:     if (
  320:       !current ||
  321:       priorityRank(student.interventionPriority) >
  322:         priorityRank(current.interventionPriority)
  323:     ) {
  324:       uniqueStudents.set(student.studentId, student);
  325:     }
  326:   });
  327: 
  328:   const uniqueRows = Array.from(uniqueStudents.values());
  329: 
  330:   const studentsWithEvidence = uniqueRows.filter(
  331:     (student) => student.workingGrade !== null,
  332:   ).length;
  333: 
  334:   const studentsWithTargets = uniqueRows.filter(
  335:     (student) => student.targetGrade !== null,
  336:   );
  337: 
  338:   const studentsBelowTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  339:     (student) =>
  340:       student.gradeGap !== null && student.gradeGap < 0,
  341:   ).length;
  342: 
  343:   const studentsOnOrAboveTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  344:     (student) =>
  345:       student.gradeGap !== null && student.gradeGap >= 0,
  346:   ).length;
  347: 
  348:   const priorityStudents = allStudentRows
  349:     .map(({ student, classItem }) =>
  350:       normaliseStudent({
  351:         student,
  352:         classItem,
  353:       }),
  354:     )
  355:     .filter(
  356:       (student) =>
  357:         student.priority !== "none" ||
  358:         student.gradeGap === null ||
  359:         student.gradeGap < 0 ||
  360:         student.trend === "declining" ||
  361:         student.completionRate < 80 ||
  362:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  363:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  364:     )
  365:     .sort((first, second) => {
  366:       const priorityDifference =
  367:         priorityRank(second.priority) - priorityRank(first.priority);
  368: 
  369:       if (priorityDifference !== 0) return priorityDifference;
  370: 
  371:       const firstGap = first.gradeGap ?? 0;
  372:       const secondGap = second.gradeGap ?? 0;
  373: 
  374:       if (firstGap !== secondGap) return firstGap - secondGap;
  375: 
  376:       return first.completionRate - second.completionRate;
  377:     });
  378: 
  379:   const classRows = portfolio.classes.map(normaliseClass);
  380:   const allTopics = aggregateTopics(portfolio);
  381: 
  382:   return {
  383:     teacherId: cleanedTeacherId,
  384:     classCount: portfolio.classCount,
  385:     studentCount: portfolio.uniqueStudentCount,
  386:     studentsWithEvidence,
  387:     studentsWithoutEvidence: Math.max(
  388:       0,
  389:       portfolio.uniqueStudentCount - studentsWithEvidence,
  390:     ),
  391:     highPriorityCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  392:       (student) => student.interventionPriority === "high",
  393:     ).length,
  394:     decliningCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  395:       (student) => student.trend === "declining",
  396:     ).length,
  397:     lowEvidenceCount: uniqueRows.filter(
  398:       (student) =>
  399:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  400:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  401:     ).length,
  402:     studentsWithTargets: studentsWithTargets.length,
  403:     studentsBelowTarget,
  404:     studentsOnOrAboveTarget,
  405:     studentsWithoutTargets: Math.max(
  406:       0,
  407:       portfolio.uniqueStudentCount - studentsWithTargets.length,
  408:     ),
  409:     averageCompletionRate:
  410:       uniqueRows.length > 0
  411:         ? Math.round(
  412:             uniqueRows.reduce(
  413:               (total, student) => total + student.completionRate,
  414:               0,
  415:             ) / uniqueRows.length,
  416:           )
  417:         : 0,
  418:     activeInterventions: interventions.filter(
  419:       (intervention) => intervention.status === "active",
  420:     ).length,
  421:     completedInterventions: interventions.filter(
  422:       (intervention) => intervention.status === "completed",
  423:     ).length,
  424:     priorityStudents,
  425:     classes: classRows,
  426:     priorityTopics: [...allTopics]
  427:       .filter(
  428:         (topic) =>
  429:           topic.weightedPercentage <
  430:           70,
  431:       )
  432:       .sort(
  433:         (first, second) =>
  434:           first.weightedPercentage -
  435:           second.weightedPercentage,
  436:       )
  437:       .slice(0, 6),
  438: 
  439:     strongestTopics: [...allTopics]
  440:       .filter(
  441:         (topic) =>
  442:           topic.weightedPercentage >=
  443:           70,
  444:       )
  445:       .sort(
  446:         (first, second) =>
  447:           second.weightedPercentage -
  448:           first.weightedPercentage,
  449:       )
  450:       .slice(0, 6),
  451:   };
  452: }

    1: import type { TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow } from "@/types/teacherAnalytics";

    7: function chooseActionType(
    8:   row: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow,
    9: ): TeacherActionType {
   10:   if (
   11:     row.interventionPriority === "high" ||
   12:     (row.gradeGap !== null && row.gradeGap <= -2)
   13:   ) {
   14:     return "intervention";
   15:   }
   16: 
   17:   if (row.trend === "declining") {
   18:     return "quiz";
   19:   }
   20: 
   21:   const weakestTopic = [...row.analytics.topics].sort(
   22:     (first, second) =>
   23:       first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
   24:   )[0];
   25: 
   26:   if (
   27:     weakestTopic &&
   28:     weakestTopic.weightedPercentage < 50
   29:   ) {
   30:     return "lesson";
   31:   }
   32: 
   33:   if (row.completionRate < 70) {
   34:     return "monitor";
   35:   }
   36: 
   37:   return "monitor";
   38: }
   39: 
   40: export function buildTeacherActionRecommendation(
   41:   row: TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow,
   42: ): TeacherActionRecommendation {
   43:   const weakestTopic = [...row.analytics.topics].sort(
   44:     (first, second) =>
   45:       first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
   46:   )[0];
   47: 
   48:   const focusTopic =
   49:     weakestTopic?.topic || "General Computer Science";
   50: 
   51:   const type = chooseActionType(row);
   52: 
   53:   const targetText = row.targetGrade
   54:     ? `Working at ${row.workingGrade || "â€”"} against target ${row.targetGrade}.`
   55:     : `Working grade ${row.workingGrade || "â€”"}; target grade is not set.`;
   56: 
   57:   const gapText =
   58:     row.gradeGap !== null && row.gradeGap < 0
   59:       ? ` The learner is ${Math.abs(row.gradeGap)} grade step${
   60:           Math.abs(row.gradeGap) === 1 ? "" : "s"
   61:         } below target.`
   62:       : "";
   63: 
   64:   const trendText =
   65:     row.trend === "declining"
   66:       ? " Recent performance is declining."
   67:       : "";
   68: 
   69:   const masteryText = weakestTopic
   70:     ? ` ${focusTopic} is currently the weakest assessed area at ${weakestTopic.weightedPercentage}% mastery.`
   71:     : "";
   72: 
   73:   const reason = `${targetText}${gapText}${trendText}${masteryText}`.trim();
   74: 
   75:   if (type === "intervention") {
   76:     return {
   77:       type,
   78:       title: `Create targeted intervention: ${focusTopic}`,
   79:       reason,
   80:       focusTopic,
   81:       suggestedInstruction:
   82:         `Prioritise ${focusTopic}. Re-teach the misconception, use guided practice, then check understanding with a short reassessment. Review whether the grade gap and mastery score improve afterwards.`,
   83:       priority: row.interventionPriority,
   84:     };
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   if (type === "quiz") {
   88:     return {
   89:       type,
   90:       title: `Reassess ${focusTopic}`,
   91:       reason,
   92:       focusTopic,
   93:       suggestedInstruction:
   94:         `Assign a short retrieval quiz on ${focusTopic}, review incorrect answers and compare the new result with the learner's recent evidence.`,
   95:       priority: row.interventionPriority,
   96:     };
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   if (type === "lesson") {
  100:     return {
  101:       type,
  102:       title: `Assign targeted lesson: ${focusTopic}`,
  103:       reason,
  104:       focusTopic,
  105:       suggestedInstruction:
  106:         `Assign an exact CS Master lesson covering ${focusTopic}. Ask the learner to complete guided practice and the checkpoint before reassessment.`,
  107:       priority: row.interventionPriority,
  108:     };
  109:   }
  110: 
  111:   return {
  112:     type,
  113:     title: "Monitor and review",
  114:     reason,
  115:     focusTopic,
  116:     suggestedInstruction:
  117:       "Continue collecting graded evidence. Review completion, trend and mastery again after the next assessment.",
  118:     priority: row.interventionPriority,
  119:   };
  120: }

  233: function isPlaceholderStudentName(value: string): boolean {
  234:   const normalised = value.trim().toLowerCase();
  235: 
  236:   return (

  244: async function getStudentIdentity(
  245:   studentId: string,
  246:   classItem: TeacherClass,
  247: ): Promise<StudentIdentity> {
  248:   const embedded =
  249:     classItem.students?.find(
  250:       (student) =>
  251:         student.studentId === studentId,
  252:     );
  253: 
  254:   /*
  255:    * Prefer the canonical user profile. Older class records can contain
  256:    * placeholder names such as "Unnamed Student", so the embedded class
  257:    * snapshot is only used as a fallback.
  258:    */
  259:   try {
  260:     const snapshot =
  261:       await getDoc(
  262:         doc(db, "users", studentId),
  263:       );
  264: 
  265:     if (snapshot.exists()) {
  266:       const data = snapshot.data();
  267: 
  268:       const profileName =
  269:         safeString(data.name);
  270: 
  271:       const profileEmail =
  272:         safeString(data.email);
  273: 
  274:       if (
  275:         !isPlaceholderStudentName(
  276:           profileName,
  277:         )
  278:       ) {
  279:         return {
  280:           id: studentId,
  281:           name: profileName,
  282:           email:
  283:             profileEmail ||
  284:             embedded?.email ||
  285:             "",
  286:         };
  287:       }
  288:     }
  289:   } catch {
  290:     /*
  291:      * A teacher may legitimately be denied a direct read of users/{studentId}
  292:      * by tenant rules. Identity is already embedded in the teacher-owned class
  293:      * snapshot, so permission denial is a normal fallback rather than an error.
  294:      */
  295:   }
  296: 
  297:   const embeddedName =
  298:     embedded?.displayName || "";
  299: 
  300:   return {
  301:     id: studentId,
  302:     name:
  303:       !isPlaceholderStudentName(
  304:         embeddedName,
  305:       )
  306:         ? embeddedName
  307:         : "Student",
  308:     email:
  309:       embedded?.email || "",
  310:   };
  311: }
  312: 
  313: /*
  314:  * IMPORTANT:
  315:  *
  316:  * Teacher analytics must NOT call the student-facing
  317:  * getUnifiedStudentAssignments()/getRichStudentAnalytics()
  318:  * pipeline.
  319:  *
  320:  * That pipeline performs direct student-context reads
  321:  * (including "not yet created" result/progress documents).
  322:  * Those are valid for the student, but some are correctly
  323:  * rejected when another account performs the same get.
  324:  *
  325:  * Instead this function reads only teacher-owned collections
  326:  * with queries constrained by teacherId, then filters the
  327:  * current class/student in memory.
  328:  */
  329: async function getTeacherOwnedStudentAnalytics({
  330:   teacherId,
  331:   studentId,
  332:   classItem,
  333: }: {
  334:   teacherId: string;
  335:   studentId: string;
  336:   classItem: TeacherClass;
  337: }): Promise<RichStudentAnalytics> {
  338:   const [
  339:     profileSnapshot,
  340:     quizAssignmentsSnapshot,
  341:     quizResultsSnapshot,
  342:     examAssignmentsSnapshot,
  343:     examSubmissionsSnapshot,
  344:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot,
  345:   ] = await Promise.all([
  346:     /*
  347:      * Student profile reads are optional for teacher analytics.
  348:      * Firestore may correctly deny this direct user-document read while still
  349:      * allowing the teacher to analyse teacher-owned class/assignment evidence.
  350:      * Returning null preserves the class snapshot + target-grade fallback.
  351:      */
  352:     getDoc(
  353:       doc(db, "users", studentId),
  354:     ).catch(() => null),
  355: 
  356:     getDocs(
  357:       query(
  358:         collection(db, "assignments"),
  359:         where(
  360:           "teacherId",
  361:           "==",
  362:           teacherId,
  363:         ),
  364:       ),
  365:     ),
  366: 
  367:     getDocs(
  368:       query(
  369:         collection(
  370:           db,
  371:           "assignmentResults",
  372:         ),
  373:         where(
  374:           "teacherId",
  375:           "==",
  376:           teacherId,
  377:         ),
  378:       ),
  379:     ),
  380: 
  381:     getDocs(
  382:       query(
  383:         collection(
  384:           db,
  385:           "examAssignments",
  386:         ),
  387:         where(
  388:           "teacherId",
  389:           "==",
  390:           teacherId,
  391:         ),
  392:       ),
  393:     ),
  394: 
  395:     getDocs(
  396:       query(
  397:         collection(
  398:           db,
  399:           "examSubmissions",
  400:         ),
  401:         where(
  402:           "teacherId",
  403:           "==",
  404:           teacherId,
  405:         ),
  406:       ),
  407:     ),
  408: 
  409:     getDocs(
  410:       query(
  411:         collection(
  412:           db,
  413:           "classAssignments",
  414:         ),
  415:         where(
  416:           "teacherId",
  417:           "==",
  418:           teacherId,
  419:         ),
  420:       ),
  421:     ),
  422:   ]);
  423: 
  424:   const profile =
  425:     profileSnapshot?.exists()
  426:       ? profileSnapshot.data()
  427:       : {};
  428: 
  429:   const qualification =
  430:     qualificationFromClass(
  431:       classItem,
  432:     );
  433: 
  434:   const storedTarget =
  435:     await getStudentTargetGrade(
  436:       studentId,
  437:     ).catch(() => null);
  438: 
  439:   const targetGrade =
  440:     storedTarget?.qualification ===
  441:     qualification
  442:       ? storedTarget.targetGrade
  443:       : normaliseLegacyTargetGrade(
  444:           profile.targetGrade,
  445:           qualification,
  446:         );
  447: 
  448:   const boundarySet =
  449:     getDefaultBoundarySet(
  450:       qualification,
  451:     );
  452: 
  453:   const quizResultByAssignment =
  454:     new Map<
  455:       string,
  456:       Record<string, unknown>
  457:     >();
  458: 
  459:   for (
  460:     const resultDocument of
  461:     quizResultsSnapshot.docs
  462:   ) {
  463:     const data =
  464:       resultDocument.data();
  465: 
  466:     if (
  467:       safeString(data.studentId) !==
  468:       studentId
  469:     ) {
  470:       continue;
  471:     }
  472: 
  473:     const assignmentId =
  474:       safeString(
  475:         data.assignmentId,
  476:       );
  477: 
  478:     if (assignmentId) {
  479:       quizResultByAssignment.set(
  480:         assignmentId,
  481:         data,
  482:       );
  483:     }
  484:   }
  485: 
  486:   const evidence: AnalyticsEvidence[] =
  487:     [];
  488: 
  489:   /*
  490:    * Question-level written-exam evidence is kept separately from the
  491:    * assessment stream. It is used for topic mastery only.
  492:    */
  493:   const examQuestionEvidence: AnalyticsEvidence[] =
  494:     [];
  495: 
  496:   let totalActivityCount = 0;
  497:   let completedActivityCount = 0;
  498: 
  499:   /*
  500:    * QUIZ / AI QUIZ EVIDENCE
  501:    */
  502:   for (
  503:     const assignmentDocument of
  504:     quizAssignmentsSnapshot.docs
  505:   ) {
  506:     const assignment =
  507:       assignmentDocument.data();
  508: 
  509:     if (
  510:       assignment.type !== "quiz" ||
  511:       safeString(
  512:         assignment.classId,
  513:       ) !== classItem.id ||
  514:       assignment.status ===
  515:         "cancelled"
  516:     ) {
  517:       continue;
  518:     }
  519: 
  520:     totalActivityCount += 1;
  521: 
  522:     const result =
  523:       quizResultByAssignment.get(
  524:         assignmentDocument.id,
  525:       );
  526: 
  527:     const completed =
  528:       result?.status ===
  529:       "completed";
  530: 
  531:     if (completed) {
  532:       completedActivityCount += 1;
  533:     }
  534: 
  535:     const percentage =
  536:       completed
  537:         ? safeNumber(
  538:             result?.percentage,
  539:           )
  540:         : null;
  541: 
  542:     const score =
  543:       completed
  544:         ? safeNumber(
  545:             result?.score,
  546:           )
  547:         : null;
  548: 
  549:     const totalQuestions =
  550:       completed
  551:         ? safeNumber(
  552:             result?.totalQuestions,
  553:           )
  554:         : null;
  555: 
  556:     const resourceType =
  557:       safeString(
  558:         assignment.resourceType,
  559:       );
  560: 
  561:     const evidenceType:
  562:       AnalyticsEvidence["type"] =
  563:         resourceType === "AI Quiz" ||
  564:         resourceType === "ai-quiz"
  565:           ? "ai_quiz"
  566:           : "quiz";
  567: 
  568:     evidence.push({
  569:       id:
  570:         `quiz-${assignmentDocument.id}`,
  571:       type: evidenceType,
  572:       title:
  573:         safeString(
  574:           assignment.title,
  575:           "Assigned quiz",
  576:         ),
  577:       topic:
  578:         safeString(
  579:           assignment.topic,
  580:         ) ||
  581:         safeString(
  582:           assignment.title,
  583:           "Assigned quiz",
  584:         ),
  585:       percentage,
  586:       rawScore: score,
  587:       totalMarks:
  588:         totalQuestions,
  589:       completedAt:
  590:         toDate(
  591:           result?.completedAt as
  592:             FirestoreDate,
  593:         ),
  594:       dueDate:
  595:         toDate(
  596:           assignment.dueDate as
  597:             FirestoreDate,
  598:         ),
  599:       weight:
  600:         ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS[
  601:           evidenceType
  602:         ],
  603:       graded:
  604:         completed &&
  605:         percentage !== null,
  606:       sourceAssignmentId:
  607:         assignmentDocument.id,
  608:       sourceAssessmentId:
  609:         safeString(
  610:           assignment.resourceId,
  611:         ) || null,
  612:       sourceQuestionId: null,
  613:       sourceQuestionNumber: null,
  614:       sourceLabel:
  615:         evidenceType === "ai_quiz"
  616:           ? "Teacher-assigned AI quiz"
  617:           : "Teacher-assigned quiz",
  618:     });
  619:   }
  620: 
  621:   /*
  622:    * WRITTEN EXAM EVIDENCE
  623:    */
  624:   const submissionByAssignment =
  625:     new Map<
  626:       string,
  627:       Record<string, unknown>
  628:     >();
  629: 
  630:   for (
  631:     const submissionDocument of
  632:     examSubmissionsSnapshot.docs
  633:   ) {
  634:     const data =
  635:       submissionDocument.data();
  636: 
  637:     if (
  638:       safeString(data.studentId) !==
  639:       studentId
  640:     ) {
  641:       continue;
  642:     }
  643: 
  644:     const assignmentId =
  645:       safeString(
  646:         data.assignmentId,
  647:       );
  648: 
  649:     if (assignmentId) {
  650:       submissionByAssignment.set(
  651:         assignmentId,
  652:         data,
  653:       );
  654:     }
  655:   }
  656: 
  657:   for (
  658:     const assignmentDocument of
  659:     examAssignmentsSnapshot.docs
  660:   ) {
  661:     const assignment =
  662:       assignmentDocument.data();
  663: 
  664:     const studentIds =
  665:       safeStringArray(
  666:         assignment.studentIds,
  667:       );
  668: 
  669:     if (
  670:       safeString(
  671:         assignment.classId,
  672:       ) !== classItem.id ||
  673:       !studentIds.includes(
  674:         studentId,
  675:       ) ||
  676:       assignment.status ===
  677:         "cancelled"
  678:     ) {
  679:       continue;
  680:     }
  681: 
  682:     totalActivityCount += 1;
  683: 
  684:     const submission =
  685:       submissionByAssignment.get(
  686:         assignmentDocument.id,
  687:       );
  688: 
  689:     const marked =
  690:       submission?.status ===
  691:       "marked";
  692: 
  693:     if (
  694:       submission?.status ===
  695:         "submitted" ||
  696:       submission?.status ===
  697:         "marking" ||
  698:       marked
  699:     ) {
  700:       completedActivityCount += 1;
  701:     }
  702: 
  703:     const percentage =
  704:       marked
  705:         ? safeNumber(
  706:             submission?.percentage,
  707:           )
  708:         : null;
  709: 
  710:     const rawScore =
  711:       marked
  712:         ? safeNumber(
  713:             submission
  714:               ?.totalAwardedMarks,
  715:           )
  716:         : null;
  717: 
  718:     const totalMarks =
  719:       safeNumber(
  720:         assignment.totalMarks,
  721:       ) ??
  722:       safeNumber(
  723:         submission
  724:           ?.totalAvailableMarks,
  725:       );
  726: 
  727:     const questionSetSnapshot =
  728:       assignment.questionSetSnapshot &&
  729:       typeof assignment.questionSetSnapshot ===
  730:         "object"
  731:         ? (assignment.questionSetSnapshot as Record<
  732:             string,
  733:             unknown
  734:           >)
  735:         : {};
  736: 
  737:     const fallbackExamTopic =
  738:       safeString(
  739:         assignment.topic,
  740:       ) ||
  741:       safeString(
  742:         questionSetSnapshot.topic,
  743:       ) ||
  744:       safeString(
  745:         assignment.title,
  746:         "Written assessment",
  747:       );
  748: 
  749:     evidence.push({
  750:       id:
  751:         `exam-${assignmentDocument.id}`,
  752:       type: "written_exam",
  753:       title:
  754:         safeString(
  755:           assignment.title,
  756:           "Written assessment",
  757:         ),
  758:       topic: fallbackExamTopic,
  759:       percentage,
  760:       rawScore,
  761:       totalMarks,
  762:       completedAt:
  763:         toDate(
  764:           (
  765:             submission
  766:               ?.markedAt ??
  767:             submission
  768:               ?.submittedAt
  769:           ) as FirestoreDate,
  770:         ),
  771:       dueDate:
  772:         toDate(
  773:           assignment.dueDate as
  774:             FirestoreDate,
  775:         ),
  776:       weight:
  777:         ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS
  778:           .written_exam,
  779:       graded:
  780:         marked &&
  781:         percentage !== null,
  782:       sourceAssignmentId:
  783:         assignmentDocument.id,
  784:       sourceAssessmentId:
  785:         safeString(
  786:           assignment.questionSetId,
  787:         ) || null,
  788:       sourceQuestionId: null,
  789:       sourceQuestionNumber: null,
  790:       sourceLabel:
  791:         "Teacher-assigned written exam",
  792:     });
  793: 
  794:     /*
  795:      * A marked paper contributes question-level topic evidence.
  796:      * Each question receives only its share of the paper's written-exam
  797:      * weight, so one paper is not treated as several full exams.
  798:      */
  799:     if (marked) {
  800:       const questions =
  801:         safeRecordArray(
  802:           questionSetSnapshot.questions,
  803:         );
  804: 
  805:       const answers =
  806:         safeRecordArray(
  807:           submission?.answers,
  808:         );
  809: 
  810:       const paperMarks =
  811:         totalMarks && totalMarks > 0
  812:           ? totalMarks
  813:           : questions.reduce(
  814:               (sum, question) =>
  815:                 sum +
  816:                 (safeNumber(
  817:                   question.marks,
  818:                 ) || 0),
  819:               0,
  820:             );
  821: 
  822:       for (const question of questions) {
  823:         const questionId =
  824:           safeString(question.id);
  825: 
  826:         if (!questionId) {
  827:           continue;
  828:         }
  829: 
  830:         const answer =
  831:           answers.find(
  832:             (item) =>
  833:               safeString(
  834:                 item.questionId,
  835:               ) === questionId,
  836:           );
  837: 
  838:         const availableMarks =
  839:           safeNumber(question.marks);
  840: 
  841:         const awardedMarks =
  842:           safeNumber(
  843:             answer?.awardedMarks,
  844:           );
  845: 
  846:         if (
  847:           availableMarks === null ||
  848:           availableMarks <= 0 ||
  849:           awardedMarks === null
  850:         ) {
  851:           continue;
  852:         }
  853: 
  854:         const clampedAwardedMarks =
  855:           Math.max(
  856:             0,
  857:             Math.min(
  858:               availableMarks,
  859:               awardedMarks,
  860:             ),
  861:           );
  862: 
  863:         const questionNumber =
  864:           safeNumber(
  865:             question.questionNumber,
  866:           );
  867: 
  868:         const weightShare =
  869:           paperMarks > 0
  870:             ? availableMarks /
  871:               paperMarks
  872:             : 1 /
  873:               Math.max(
  874:                 1,
  875:                 questions.length,
  876:               );
  877: 
  878:         examQuestionEvidence.push({
  879:           id:
  880:             `written-exam-question-${assignmentDocument.id}-${questionId}`,
  881:           type: "written_exam",
  882:           title:
  883:             `${safeString(
  884:               assignment.title,
  885:               "Written assessment",
  886:             )} Â· ${
  887:               questionNumber === null
  888:                 ? "Question"
  889:                 : `Q${questionNumber}`
  890:             }`,
  891:           topic:
  892:             examQuestionTopic(
  893:               question,
  894:               fallbackExamTopic,
  895:             ),
  896:           percentage:
  897:             Math.round(
  898:               (
  899:                 clampedAwardedMarks /
  900:                 availableMarks
  901:               ) * 100,
  902:             ),
  903:           rawScore:
  904:             clampedAwardedMarks,
  905:           totalMarks:
  906:             availableMarks,
  907:           completedAt:
  908:             toDate(
  909:               (
  910:                 submission
  911:                   ?.markedAt ??
  912:                 submission
  913:                   ?.submittedAt
  914:               ) as FirestoreDate,
  915:             ),
  916:           dueDate:
  917:             toDate(
  918:               assignment.dueDate as
  919:                 FirestoreDate,
  920:             ),
  921:           weight:
  922:             ANALYTICS_EVIDENCE_WEIGHTS
  923:               .written_exam *
  924:             weightShare,
  925:           graded: true,
  926:           sourceAssignmentId:
  927:             assignmentDocument.id,
  928:           sourceAssessmentId:
  929:             safeString(
  930:               assignment.questionSetId,
  931:             ) || null,
  932:           sourceQuestionId:
  933:             questionId,
  934:           sourceQuestionNumber:
  935:             questionNumber,
  936:           sourceLabel:
  937:             "Teacher-marked written exam question",
  938:         });
  939:       }
  940:     }
  941:   }
  942: 
  943:   /*
  944:    * RESOURCE / PROGRAMMING ASSIGNMENTS
  945:    *
  946:    * We count teacher-owned assigned resources in completion
  947:    * coverage but do not perform student-context direct reads.
  948:    * Their ungraded status therefore cannot distort the
  949:    * working-grade calculation.
  950:    */
  951:   for (
  952:     const assignmentDocument of
  953:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs
  954:   ) {
  955:     const assignment =
  956:       assignmentDocument.data();
  957: 
  958:     const studentIds =
  959:       safeStringArray(
  960:         assignment.studentIds,
  961:       );
  962: 
  963:     if (
  964:       safeString(
  965:         assignment.classId,
  966:       ) !== classItem.id ||
  967:       !studentIds.includes(
  968:         studentId,
  969:       ) ||
  970:       assignment.status ===
  971:         "cancelled"
  972:     ) {
  973:       continue;
  974:     }
  975: 
  976:     totalActivityCount += 1;
  977:   }
  978: 
  979:   const completionRate =
  980:     totalActivityCount > 0
  981:       ? Math.round(
  982:           (
  983:             completedActivityCount /
  984:             totalActivityCount
  985:           ) * 100,
  986:         )
  987:       : 0;
  988: 
  989:   const grade =
  990:     calculateGradeProgress({
  991:       evidence,
  992:       targetGrade,
  993:       boundarySet,
  994:     });
  995: 
  996:   /*
  997:    * Keep one whole-paper record for grade/trend/confidence, but replace the
  998:    * aggregate exam topic with question-level evidence for mastery when those
  999:    * question marks are available.
 1000:    */
 1001:   const examsWithQuestionEvidence =
 1002:     new Set(
 1003:       examQuestionEvidence
 1004:         .map(
 1005:           (item) =>
 1006:             item.sourceAssignmentId,
 1007:         )
 1008:         .filter(
 1009:           (
 1010:             value,
 1011:           ): value is string =>
 1012:             Boolean(value),
 1013:         ),
 1014:     );
 1015: 
 1016:   const masteryEvidence = [
 1017:     ...evidence.filter((item) => {
 1018:       if (
 1019:         item.type !==
 1020:         "written_exam"
 1021:       ) {
 1022:         return true;
 1023:       }
 1024: 
 1025:       if (
 1026:         !item.sourceAssignmentId
 1027:       ) {
 1028:         return true;
 1029:       }
 1030: 
 1031:       return !examsWithQuestionEvidence.has(
 1032:         item.sourceAssignmentId,
 1033:       );
 1034:     }),
 1035:     ...examQuestionEvidence,
 1036:   ];
 1037: 
 1038:   const topics =
 1039:     buildTopicMastery(
 1040:       masteryEvidence,
 1041:     );
 1042: 
 1043:   const strongestTopics =
 1044:     topics.slice(0, 3);
 1045: 
 1046:   const weakestTopics =
 1047:     [...topics]
 1048:       .sort(
 1049:         (first, second) =>
 1050:           first
 1051:             .weightedPercentage -
 1052:           second
 1053:             .weightedPercentage,
 1054:       )
 1055:       .slice(0, 3);
 1056: 
 1057:   const trendResult =
 1058:     buildTrend(evidence);
 1059: 
 1060:   const confidence =
 1061:     calculateEvidenceConfidence({
 1062:       evidence,
 1063:       totalActivityCount,
 1064:       completedActivityCount,
 1065:     });
 1066: 
 1067:   const interpretation =
 1068:     buildAnalyticsInterpretation({
 1069:       grade,
 1070:       trend: trendResult.trend,
 1071:       strongestTopics,
 1072:       weakestTopics,
 1073:     });
 1074: 
 1075:   return {
 1076:     studentId,
 1077:     qualification,
 1078:     examBoard:
 1079:       safeString(
 1080:         profile.examBoard,
 1081:       ) || null,
 1082:     targetGrade,
 1083:     grade,
 1084:     confidence,
 1085:     trend: trendResult.trend,
 1086:     trendChange:
 1087:       trendResult.change,
 1088:     trendPoints:
 1089:       trendResult.points,
 1090:     topics,
 1091:     strongestTopics,
 1092:     weakestTopics,
 1093:     evidence,
 1094:     masteryEvidence,
 1095:     evidenceSourceCounts:
 1096:       countEvidenceSources(
 1097:         masteryEvidence,
 1098:       ),
 1099:     completedActivityCount,
 1100:     totalActivityCount,
 1101:     completionRate,
 1102:     interpretation,
 1103:   };
 1104: }
 1105: 
 1106: function interventionFor(
 1107:   analytics: RichStudentAnalytics,
 1108: ): {
 1109:   priority:
 1110:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[
 1111:       "interventionPriority"
 1112:     ];
 1113:   reasons: string[];
 1114: } {
 1115:   const reasons: string[] = [];
 1116:   let score = 0;
 1117: 
 1118:   if (
 1119:     analytics.grade.gradeGap !==
 1120:       null &&
 1121:     analytics.grade.gradeGap <= -2
 1122:   ) {
 1123:     reasons.push(
 1124:       "Two or more grade steps below target",
 1125:     );
 1126:     score += 4;
 1127:   } else if (
 1128:     analytics.grade.gradeGap !==
 1129:       null &&
 1130:     analytics.grade.gradeGap < 0
 1131:   ) {
 1132:     reasons.push(
 1133:       "Below target grade",
 1134:     );
 1135:     score += 2;
 1136:   }
 1137: 
 1138:   if (
 1139:     analytics.trend ===
 1140:     "declining"
 1141:   ) {
 1142:     reasons.push(
 1143:       "Recent performance is declining",
 1144:     );
 1145:     score += 3;
 1146:   }
 1147: 
 1148:   if (
 1149:     analytics.confidence.level ===
 1150:       "insufficient" ||
 1151:     analytics.confidence.level ===
 1152:       "low"
 1153:   ) {
 1154:     reasons.push(
 1155:       "Insufficient assessment evidence",
 1156:     );
 1157:     score += 2;
 1158:   }
 1159: 
 1160:   if (
 1161:     analytics.completionRate < 70
 1162:   ) {
 1163:     reasons.push(
 1164:       "Assignment completion is below 70%",
 1165:     );
 1166:     score += 2;
 1167:   }
 1168: 
 1169:   const priorityTopic =
 1170:     analytics.weakestTopics.find(
 1171:       (topic) =>
 1172:         topic.status ===
 1173:         "priority",
 1174:     );
 1175: 
 1176:   if (priorityTopic) {
 1177:     reasons.push(
 1178:       `${priorityTopic.topic} mastery is ${priorityTopic.weightedPercentage}%`,
 1179:     );
 1180:     score += 2;
 1181:   }
 1182: 
 1183:   if (score >= 6) {
 1184:     return {
 1185:       priority: "high",
 1186:       reasons,
 1187:     };
 1188:   }
 1189: 
 1190:   if (score >= 3) {
 1191:     return {
 1192:       priority: "medium",
 1193:       reasons,
 1194:     };
 1195:   }
 1196: 
 1197:   if (score >= 1) {
 1198:     return {
 1199:       priority: "monitor",
 1200:       reasons,
 1201:     };
 1202:   }
 1203: 
 1204:   return {
 1205:     priority: "none",
 1206:     reasons: [],
 1207:   };
 1208: }
 1209: 
 1210: function gradeDistribution(
 1211:   rows:
 1212:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[],
 1213:   qualification:
 1214:     AnalyticsQualification,
 1215: ): GradeDistributionItem[] {
 1216:   const order =
 1217:     [
 1218:       ...getGradeOrder(
 1219:         qualification,
 1220:       ),
 1221:     ].reverse();
 1222: 
 1223:   return order.map((grade) => ({
 1224:     grade,
 1225:     count: rows.filter(
 1226:       (row) =>
 1227:         row.workingGrade === grade,
 1228:     ).length,
 1229:   }));
 1230: }
 1231: 
 1232: function averageGrade(
 1233:   grades:
 1234:     (GradeLabel | null)[],
 1235:   qualification:
 1236:     AnalyticsQualification,
 1237: ): GradeLabel | null {
 1238:   const order =
 1239:     getGradeOrder(
 1240:       qualification,
 1241:     );
 1242: 
 1243:   const indexes =
 1244:     grades
 1245:       .filter(
 1246:         (
 1247:           grade,
 1248:         ): grade is GradeLabel =>
 1249:           grade !== null,
 1250:       )
 1251:       .map((grade) =>
 1252:         order.indexOf(grade),
 1253:       )
 1254:       .filter(
 1255:         (index) =>
 1256:           index >= 0,
 1257:       );
 1258: 
 1259:   if (indexes.length === 0) {
 1260:     return null;
 1261:   }
 1262: 
 1263:   const averageIndex =
 1264:     Math.round(
 1265:       indexes.reduce(
 1266:         (sum, index) =>
 1267:           sum + index,
 1268:         0,
 1269:       ) / indexes.length,
 1270:     );
 1271: 
 1272:   return order[
 1273:     Math.max(
 1274:       0,
 1275:       Math.min(
 1276:         order.length - 1,
 1277:         averageIndex,
 1278:       ),
 1279:     )
 1280:   ];
 1281: }
 1282: 
 1283: function aggregateTopics(
 1284:   rows:
 1285:     TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow[],
 1286: ): ClassTopicAnalytics[] {
 1287:   const groups =
 1288:     new Map<
 1289:       string,
 1290:       {
 1291:         percentages: number[];
 1292:         evidence: number;
 1293:         recent: number[];
 1294:       }
 1295:     >();
 1296: 
 1297:   for (const row of rows) {
 1298:     for (
 1299:       const topic of
 1300:       row.analytics.topics
 1301:     ) {
 1302:       const current =
 1303:         groups.get(
 1304:           topic.topic,
 1305:         ) || {
 1306:           percentages: [],
 1307:           evidence: 0,
 1308:           recent: [],
 1309:         };
 1310: 
 1311:       current.percentages.push(
 1312:         topic.weightedPercentage,
 1313:       );
 1314: 
 1315:       current.recent.push(
 1316:         topic.recentPercentage,
 1317:       );
 1318: 
 1319:       current.evidence +=
 1320:         topic.evidenceCount;
 1321: 
 1322:       groups.set(
 1323:         topic.topic,
 1324:         current,
 1325:       );
 1326:     }
 1327:   }
 1328: 
 1329:   return [
 1330:     ...groups.entries(),
 1331:   ]
 1332:     .map(
 1333:       ([topic, group]) => {
 1334:         const weightedPercentage =
 1335:           Math.round(
 1336:             group.percentages.reduce(
 1337:               (
 1338:                 sum,
 1339:                 value,
 1340:               ) =>
 1341:                 sum + value,
 1342:               0,
 1343:             ) /
 1344:               group
 1345:                 .percentages
 1346:                 .length,
 1347:           );
 1348: 
 1349:         const recentPercentage =
 1350:           Math.round(
 1351:             group.recent.reduce(
 1352:               (
 1353:                 sum,
 1354:                 value,
 1355:               ) =>
 1356:                 sum + value,
 1357:               0,
 1358:             ) /
 1359:               group.recent.length,
 1360:           );
 1361: 
 1362:         return {
 1363:           topic,
 1364:           evidenceCount:
 1365:             group.evidence,
 1366:           studentCount:
 1367:             group
 1368:               .percentages
 1369:               .length,
 1370:           weightedPercentage,
 1371:           recentPercentage,
 1372:           status:
 1373:             weightedPercentage >=
 1374:             70
 1375:               ? "secure"
 1376:               : weightedPercentage >=
 1377:                   50
 1378:                 ? "developing"
 1379:                 : "priority",
 1380:         } satisfies ClassTopicAnalytics;
 1381:       },
 1382:     )
 1383:     .sort(
 1384:       (first, second) =>
 1385:         first
 1386:           .weightedPercentage -
 1387:         second
 1388:           .weightedPercentage,
 1389:     );
 1390: }

 1392: async function buildClassAnalytics(
 1393:   classItem: TeacherClass,
 1394:   teacherId: string,
 1395: ): Promise<TeacherClassAnalytics> {
 1396:   const qualification =
 1397:     qualificationFromClass(
 1398:       classItem,
 1399:     );
 1400: 
 1401:   const studentIds =
 1402:     Array.from(
 1403:       new Set(
 1404:         classItem.studentIds ||
 1405:           [],
 1406:       ),
 1407:     );
 1408: 
 1409:   /*
 1410:    * Every enrolled student gets a row.
 1411:    * We no longer discard a student merely because one
 1412:    * analytics evidence source is unavailable.
 1413:    */
 1414:   const students =
 1415:     await Promise.all(
 1416:       studentIds.map(
 1417:         async (studentId) => {
 1418:           const identity =
 1419:             await getStudentIdentity(
 1420:               studentId,
 1421:               classItem,
 1422:             );
 1423: 
 1424:           const analytics =
 1425:             await getTeacherOwnedStudentAnalytics({
 1426:               teacherId,
 1427:               studentId,
 1428:               classItem,
 1429:             });
 1430: 
 1431:           const intervention =
 1432:             interventionFor(
 1433:               analytics,
 1434:             );
 1435: 
 1436:           return {
 1437:             studentId,
 1438:             studentName:
 1439:               identity.name,
 1440:             studentEmail:
 1441:               identity.email,

 1443:               classItem.id,
 1444:             className:
 1445:               classItem.name,
 1446:             qualification:
 1447:               analytics.qualification,
 1448:             workingGrade:
 1449:               analytics.grade
 1450:                 .workingGrade,
 1451:             targetGrade:
 1452:               analytics.grade
 1453:                 .targetGrade,
 1454:             workingPercentage:
 1455:               analytics.grade
 1456:                 .workingPercentage,
 1457:             gradeGap:
 1458:               analytics.grade
 1459:                 .gradeGap,
 1460:             nextGrade:
 1461:               analytics.grade
 1462:                 .nextGrade,
 1463:             marksToNextGrade:
 1464:               analytics.grade
 1465:                 .marksToNextGrade,
 1466:             trend:
 1467:               analytics.trend,
 1468:             trendChange:
 1469:               analytics.trendChange,
 1470:             confidence:
 1471:               analytics.confidence
 1472:                 .level,
 1473:             completionRate:
 1474:               analytics
 1475:                 .completionRate,
 1476:             interventionPriority:
 1477:               intervention.priority,
 1478:             interventionReasons:
 1479:               intervention.reasons,
 1480:             analytics,
 1481:           } satisfies TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow;
 1482:         },
 1483:       ),
 1484:     );
 1485: 
 1486:   const percentages =
 1487:     students
 1488:       .map(
 1489:         (student) =>
 1490:           student
 1491:             .workingPercentage,
 1492:       )
 1493:       .filter(
 1494:         (
 1495:           value,
 1496:         ): value is number =>
 1497:           value !== null,
 1498:       );
 1499: 
 1500:   const averageWeightedPercentage =
 1501:     percentages.length > 0
 1502:       ? Math.round(
 1503:           percentages.reduce(
 1504:             (
 1505:               sum,
 1506:               value,
 1507:             ) =>
 1508:               sum + value,
 1509:             0,
 1510:           ) /
 1511:             percentages.length,
 1512:         )
 1513:       : null;
 1514: 
 1515:   const studentsWithEvidence =
 1516:     students.filter(
 1517:       (student) =>
 1518:         student
 1519:           .workingGrade !==
 1520:         null,
 1521:     ).length;
 1522: 
 1523:   const targetRows =
 1524:     students.filter(
 1525:       (student) =>
 1526:         student.targetGrade !==
 1527:           null &&
 1528:         student.gradeGap !==
 1529:           null,
 1530:     );
 1531: 
 1532:   const onOrAboveTargetCount =
 1533:     targetRows.filter(
 1534:       (student) =>
 1535:         (
 1536:           student.gradeGap ??
 1537:           -99
 1538:         ) >= 0,
 1539:     ).length;
 1540: 
 1541:   const belowTargetCount =
 1542:     targetRows.filter(
 1543:       (student) =>
 1544:         (
 1545:           student.gradeGap ??
 1546:           0
 1547:         ) < 0,
 1548:     ).length;
 1549: 
 1550:   const targetNotSetCount =
 1551:     students.filter(
 1552:       (student) =>
 1553:         student.targetGrade ===
 1554:         null,
 1555:     ).length;
 1556: 
 1557:   return {
 1558:     classId: classItem.id,
 1559:     className: classItem.name,
 1560:     yearGroup:
 1561:       classItem.yearGroup,
 1562:     qualification,
 1563:     studentCount:
 1564:       studentIds.length,
 1565:     studentsWithEvidence,
 1566:     averageWeightedPercentage,
 1567:     averageWorkingGrade:
 1568:       averageGrade(
 1569:         students.map(
 1570:           (student) =>
 1571:             student
 1572:               .workingGrade,
 1573:         ),
 1574:         qualification,
 1575:       ),
 1576:     averageTargetGrade:
 1577:       averageGrade(
 1578:         students.map(
 1579:           (student) =>
 1580:             student.targetGrade,
 1581:         ),
 1582:         qualification,
 1583:       ),
 1584:     onOrAboveTargetCount,
 1585:     belowTargetCount,
 1586:     targetNotSetCount,
 1587:     onOrAboveTargetPercentage:
 1588:       targetRows.length > 0
 1589:         ? Math.round(
 1590:             (
 1591:               onOrAboveTargetCount /
 1592:               targetRows.length
 1593:             ) * 100,
 1594:           )
 1595:         : 0,
 1596:     averageCompletionRate:
 1597:       students.length > 0
 1598:         ? Math.round(
 1599:             students.reduce(
 1600:               (
 1601:                 sum,
 1602:                 student,
 1603:               ) =>
 1604:                 sum +
 1605:                 student
 1606:                   .completionRate,
 1607:               0,
 1608:             ) /
 1609:               students.length,
 1610:           )
 1611:         : 0,
 1612:     highPriorityCount:
 1613:       students.filter(
 1614:         (student) =>
 1615:           student
 1616:             .interventionPriority ===
 1617:           "high",
 1618:       ).length,
 1619:     decliningCount:
 1620:       students.filter(
 1621:         (student) =>
 1622:           student.trend ===
 1623:           "declining",
 1624:       ).length,
 1625:     lowEvidenceCount:
 1626:       students.filter(
 1627:         (student) =>
 1628:           student.confidence ===
 1629:             "insufficient" ||
 1630:           student.confidence ===
 1631:             "low",
 1632:       ).length,
 1633:     gradeDistribution:
 1634:       gradeDistribution(
 1635:         students,
 1636:         qualification,
 1637:       ),
 1638:     topicAnalytics:
 1639:       aggregateTopics(
 1640:         students,
 1641:       ),
 1642:     students:
 1643:       students.sort(
 1644:         (first, second) =>
 1645:           first.studentName.localeCompare(
 1646:             second.studentName,
 1647:             "en-GB",
 1648:             {
 1649:               sensitivity:
 1650:                 "base",
 1651:             },
 1652:           ),
 1653:       ),
 1654:   };
 1655: }

 1657: export async function getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(
 1658:   teacherId: string,
 1659: ): Promise<TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio> {
 1660:   const cleanedTeacherId =
 1661:     teacherId.trim();
 1662: 
 1663:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
 1664:     throw new Error(
 1665:       "A teacher account is required.",
 1666:     );
 1667:   }
 1668: 
 1669:   const classes =
 1670:     (
 1671:       await getTeacherClasses(
 1672:         cleanedTeacherId,
 1673:       )
 1674:     ).filter(
 1675:       (classItem) =>
 1676:         classItem.status !==
 1677:         "archived",
 1678:     );
 1679: 
 1680:   const classAnalytics =
 1681:     await Promise.all(
 1682:       classes.map(
 1683:         (classItem) =>
 1684:           buildClassAnalytics(
 1685:             classItem,
 1686:             cleanedTeacherId,
 1687:           ),
 1688:       ),
 1689:     );
 1690: 
 1691:   const uniqueStudentIds =
 1692:     new Set(
 1693:       classes.flatMap(
 1694:         (classItem) =>
 1695:           classItem.studentIds ||
 1696:           [],
 1697:       ),
 1698:     );
 1699: 
 1700:   return {
 1701:     teacherId:
 1702:       cleanedTeacherId,
 1703:     classCount:
 1704:       classAnalytics.length,
 1705:     uniqueStudentCount:
 1706:       uniqueStudentIds.size,
 1707:     classes:
 1708:       classAnalytics,
 1709:   };
 1710: }

 1712: export async function getTeacherStudentAnalytics({
 1713:   teacherId,
 1714:   studentId,
 1715: }: {
 1716:   teacherId: string;
 1717:   studentId: string;
 1718: }): Promise<TeacherStudentAnalyticsRow | null> {
 1719:   const portfolio =
 1720:     await getTeacherAnalyticsPortfolio(
 1721:       teacherId,
 1722:     );
 1723: 
 1724:   for (
 1725:     const classItem of
 1726:     portfolio.classes
 1727:   ) {
 1728:     const row =
 1729:       classItem.students.find(
 1730:         (student) =>
 1731:           student.studentId ===
 1732:           studentId,
 1733:       );
 1734: 
 1735:     if (row) {
 1736:       return row;
 1737:     }
 1738:   }
 1739: 
 1740:   return null;
 1741: }

   81:           workingGrade: student.workingGrade || "â€”",

  138: export function buildReportSummary(
  139:   portfolio: TeacherAnalyticsPortfolio,
  140: ): IntelligenceReportSummary {
  141:   const students = portfolio.classes.flatMap(
  142:     (classItem) => classItem.students,
  143:   );
  144: 
  145:   const studentsWithTargets = students.filter(
  146:     (student) => student.targetGrade !== null,
  147:   );
  148: 
  149:   const studentsWithoutTargets =
  150:     students.length - studentsWithTargets.length;
  151: 
  152:   const onOrAboveTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  153:     (student) =>
  154:       student.gradeGap !== null &&
  155:       student.gradeGap >= 0,
  156:   ).length;
  157: 
  158:   const belowTarget = studentsWithTargets.filter(
  159:     (student) =>
  160:       student.gradeGap !== null &&
  161:       student.gradeGap < 0,
  162:   ).length;
  163: 
  164:   const allTopics = portfolio.classes.flatMap(
  165:     (classItem) => classItem.topicAnalytics,
  166:   );
  167: 
  168:   const topicGroups = new Map<
  169:     string,
  170:     { values: number[]; evidence: number; students: number }
  171:   >();
  172: 
  173:   for (const topic of allTopics) {
  174:     const current =
  175:       topicGroups.get(topic.topic) || {
  176:         values: [],
  177:         evidence: 0,
  178:         students: 0,
  179:       };
  180: 
  181:     current.values.push(topic.weightedPercentage);
  182:     current.evidence += topic.evidenceCount;
  183:     current.students += topic.studentCount;
  184: 
  185:     topicGroups.set(topic.topic, current);
  186:   }
  187: 
  188:   const aggregatedTopics: ClassTopicAnalytics[] = [
  189:     ...topicGroups.entries(),
  190:   ].map(([topic, values]) => {
  191:     const percentage =
  192:       values.values.length > 0
  193:         ? Math.round(
  194:             values.values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) /
  195:               values.values.length,
  196:           )
  197:         : 0;
  198: 
  199:     return {
  200:       topic,
  201:       weightedPercentage: percentage,
  202:       recentPercentage: percentage,
  203:       evidenceCount: values.evidence,
  204:       studentCount: values.students,
  205:       status:
  206:         percentage >= 70
  207:           ? "secure"
  208:           : percentage >= 50
  209:             ? "developing"
  210:             : "priority",
  211:     };
  212:   });
  213: 
  214:   const averageCompletionRate =
  215:     students.length > 0
  216:       ? Math.round(
  217:           students.reduce(
  218:             (sum, student) => sum + student.completionRate,
  219:             0,
  220:           ) / students.length,
  221:         )
  222:       : 0;
  223: 
  224:   return {
  225:     classCount: portfolio.classCount,
  226:     studentCount: portfolio.uniqueStudentCount,
  227:     studentsWithTargets: studentsWithTargets.length,
  228:     studentsWithoutTargets,
  229:     onOrAboveTarget,
  230:     belowTarget,
  231:     highPriority: students.filter(
  232:       (student) => student.interventionPriority === "high",
  233:     ).length,
  234:     declining: students.filter(
  235:       (student) => student.trend === "declining",
  236:     ).length,
  237:     lowEvidence: students.filter(
  238:       (student) =>
  239:         student.confidence === "low" ||
  240:         student.confidence === "insufficient",
  241:     ).length,
  242:     averageCompletionRate,
  243:     priorityTopics: [...aggregatedTopics]
  244:       .sort(
  245:         (first, second) =>
  246:           first.weightedPercentage - second.weightedPercentage,
  247:       )
  248:       .slice(0, 6),
  249:     strongestTopics: [...aggregatedTopics]
  250:       .sort(
  251:         (first, second) =>
  252:           second.weightedPercentage - first.weightedPercentage,
  253:       )
  254:       .slice(0, 6),
  255:   };
  256: }

   45:   accountType: RegistrationAccountType,
   46: ): Promise<UserCredential> {
   47:   const cleanedName = name.trim();
   48:   const cleanedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
   49: 
   50:   validateRegistration(
   51:     cleanedName,
   52:     cleanedEmail,
   53:     password,
   54:   );
   55: 
   56:   const userCredential =
   57:     await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(
   58:       auth,
   59:       cleanedEmail,
   60:       password,
   61:     );
   62: 
   63:   try {
   64:     await updateProfile(userCredential.user, {
   65:       displayName: cleanedName,
   66:     });
   67: 
   68:     /*
   69:      * SECURITY:
   70:      *
   71:      * Teacher applicants do NOT receive the teacher role here.
   72:      *
   73:      * They remain at the normal low-privilege student-level role
   74:      * until an administrator approves the teacher request.
   75:      *
   76:      * accountIntent tells the UI which onboarding journey to use.
   77:      */
   78:     await setDoc(
   79:       doc(db, "users", userCredential.user.uid),
   80:       {
   81:         uid: userCredential.user.uid,
   82:         name: cleanedName,
   83:         email: cleanedEmail,
   84: 
   85:         role: "student",
   86: 
   87:         accountIntent: accountType,
   88: 
   89:         teacherAccessStatus:
   90:           accountType === "teacher"
   91:             ? "not_submitted"
   92:             : null,
   93: 
   94:         qualification: null,
   95:         examBoard: null,
   96:         onboardingComplete: false,
   97: 
   98:         createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
   99:         updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  100:       },
  101:     );
  102: 
  103:     return userCredential;
  104:   } catch (error) {
  105:     console.error(
  106:       "Unable to create the account profile:",
  107:       error,
  108:     );
  109: 
  110:     try {
  111:       await deleteUser(userCredential.user);
  112:     } catch (cleanupError) {
  113:       console.error(
  114:         "Unable to remove the incomplete Authentication account:",
  115:         cleanupError,
  116:       );
  117: 
  118:       await signOut(auth);
  119:     }
  120: 
  121:     throw error;
  122:   }
  123: }
  124: 
  125: /*
  126:  * Keep this function because existing parts of CS Master may
  127:  * already import registerStudent().
  128:  */
  129: export async function registerStudent(

   12:   | "student"
   13:   | "teacher";

   15: function normaliseCode(value: string): string {
   16:   return value
   17:     .trim()
   18:     .toUpperCase()
   19:     .replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g, "");
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function generateCode(): string {
   23:   const alphabet =
   24:     "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
   25: 
   26:   let value = "";
   27: 
   28:   for (
   29:     let index = 0;
   30:     index < 8;
   31:     index += 1
   32:   ) {
   33:     value +=
   34:       alphabet[
   35:         Math.floor(
   36:           Math.random() *
   37:             alphabet.length,
   38:         )
   39:       ];
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   return value;
   43: }
   44: 
   45: function timestampToDate(
   46:   value: unknown,
   47: ): Date | null {
   48:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   49:     ? value.toDate()
   50:     : null;
   51: }
   52: 
   53: export async function createSchoolInvite({
   54:   schoolId,
   55:   createdBy,
   56:   role,
   57: }: {
   58:   schoolId: string;
   59:   createdBy: string;
   60:   role: SchoolInviteRole;
   61: }): Promise<string> {
   62:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   63:     schoolId.trim();
   64: 
   65:   const cleanedCreatedBy =
   66:     createdBy.trim();
   67: 
   68:   if (
   69:     !cleanedSchoolId ||
   70:     !cleanedCreatedBy
   71:   ) {
   72:     throw new Error(
   73:       "A valid school and teacher account are required.",
   74:     );
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   /*
   78:    * Do NOT pre-read the randomly generated invite document.
   79:    * Firestore rules correctly deny arbitrary reads of non-existent
   80:    * invite documents, which causes the permissions error before
   81:    * creation. The random 8-character code space is extremely large.
   82:    */
   83:   const code =
   84:     generateCode();
   85: 
   86:   const expiresAt =
   87:     new Date();
   88: 
   89:   expiresAt.setDate(
   90:     expiresAt.getDate() + 14,
   91:   );
   92: 
   93:   const inviteRef =
   94:     doc(
   95:       db,
   96:       "schoolInvites",
   97:       code,
   98:     );
   99: 
  100:   const batch =
  101:     writeBatch(db);
  102: 
  103:   batch.set(
  104:     inviteRef,
  105:     {
  106:       code,
  107:       schoolId:
  108:         cleanedSchoolId,
  109:       role,
  110:       createdBy:
  111:         cleanedCreatedBy,
  112:       status:
  113:         "active",
  114:       expiresAt:
  115:         Timestamp.fromDate(
  116:           expiresAt,
  117:         ),
  118:       usedBy:
  119:         "",
  120:       createdAt:
  121:         serverTimestamp(),
  122:       updatedAt:
  123:         serverTimestamp(),
  124:     },
  125:   );
  126: 
  127:   await batch.commit();
  128: 
  129:   return code;
  130: }
  131: 
  132: export async function acceptSchoolInvite({
  133:   code,
  134:   userId,
  135: }: {
  136:   code: string;
  137:   userId: string;
  138: }): Promise<{
  139:   schoolId: string;
  140:   role: SchoolInviteRole;
  141: }> {
  142:   const cleanedCode =
  143:     normaliseCode(code);
  144: 
  145:   const cleanedUserId =
  146:     userId.trim();
  147: 
  148:   if (
  149:     !cleanedCode ||
  150:     !cleanedUserId
  151:   ) {
  152:     throw new Error(
  153:       "Enter a valid school join code.",
  154:     );
  155:   }
  156: 
  157:   const inviteRef =
  158:     doc(
  159:       db,
  160:       "schoolInvites",
  161:       cleanedCode,
  162:     );
  163: 
  164:   const inviteSnapshot =
  165:     await getDoc(
  166:       inviteRef,
  167:     );
  168: 
  169:   if (
  170:     !inviteSnapshot.exists()
  171:   ) {
  172:     throw new Error(
  173:       "That school join code could not be found.",
  174:     );
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   const invite =
  178:     inviteSnapshot.data();
  179: 
  180:   if (
  181:     invite.status !==
  182:     "active"
  183:   ) {
  184:     throw new Error(
  185:       "This school join code is no longer active.",
  186:     );
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   const expiresAt =
  190:     timestampToDate(
  191:       invite.expiresAt,
  192:     );
  193: 
  194:   if (
  195:     expiresAt &&
  196:     expiresAt.getTime() <
  197:       Date.now()
  198:   ) {
  199:     throw new Error(
  200:       "This school join code has expired.",
  201:     );
  202:   }
  203: 
  204:   const schoolId =
  205:     typeof invite.schoolId ===
  206:     "string"
  207:       ? invite.schoolId.trim()
  208:       : "";
  209: 
  210:   const role:
  211:     SchoolInviteRole =
  212:     invite.role ===
  213:     "teacher"
  214:       ? "teacher"
  215:       : "student";
  216: 
  217:   if (!schoolId) {
  218:     throw new Error(
  219:       "This school invitation is invalid.",
  220:     );
  221:   }
  222: 
  223:   const userRef =
  224:     doc(
  225:       db,
  226:       "users",
  227:       cleanedUserId,
  228:     );
  229: 
  230:   const userSnapshot =
  231:     await getDoc(
  232:       userRef,
  233:     );
  234: 
  235:   if (
  236:     !userSnapshot.exists()
  237:   ) {
  238:     throw new Error(
  239:       "Your CS Master profile could not be found.",
  240:     );
  241:   }
  242: 
  243:   const userData =
  244:     userSnapshot.data();
  245: 
  246:   const existingSchoolId =
  247:     typeof userData.schoolId ===
  248:     "string"
  249:       ? userData.schoolId.trim()
  250:       : "";
  251: 
  252:   if (
  253:     existingSchoolId &&
  254:     existingSchoolId !==
  255:       schoolId
  256:   ) {
  257:     throw new Error(
  258:       "Your account already belongs to another school. Use the school transfer process instead.",
  259:     );
  260:   }
  261: 
  262:   if (
  263:     role === "teacher" &&
  264:     userData.role !==
  265:       "teacher" &&
  266:     userData.role !==
  267:       "admin"
  268:   ) {
  269:     throw new Error(
  270:       "This join code is for an approved teacher account.",
  271:     );
  272:   }
  273: 
  274:   const membershipRef =
  275:     doc(
  276:       db,
  277:       "schools",
  278:       schoolId,
  279:       "members",
  280:       cleanedUserId,
  281:     );
  282: 
  283:   const batch =
  284:     writeBatch(db);
  285: 
  286:   batch.set(
  287:     membershipRef,
  288:     {
  289:       schoolId,
  290:       userId:
  291:         cleanedUserId,
  292:       role,
  293:       status:
  294:         "active",
  295:       inviteId:
  296:         cleanedCode,
  297:       joinedAt:
  298:         serverTimestamp(),
  299:       leftAt:
  300:         null,
  301:       updatedAt:
  302:         serverTimestamp(),
  303:     },
  304:     {
  305:       merge: true,
  306:     },
  307:   );
  308: 
  309:   batch.update(
  310:     userRef,
  311:     {
  312:       schoolId,
  313:       accountType:
  314:         "school",
  315:       plan:
  316:         "school",
  317:       updatedAt:
  318:         serverTimestamp(),
  319:     },
  320:   );
  321: 
  322:   batch.update(
  323:     inviteRef,
  324:     {
  325:       status:
  326:         "used",
  327:       usedBy:
  328:         cleanedUserId,
  329:       updatedAt:
  330:         serverTimestamp(),
  331:     },
  332:   );
  333: 
  334:   await batch.commit();
  335: 
  336:   return {
  337:     schoolId,
  338:     role,
  339:   };

FILE: services\schoolMemberService.ts

    1: import {
    2:   collection,
    3:   doc,
    4:   getDoc,
    5:   getDocs,
    6:   Timestamp,
    7: } from "firebase/firestore";
    8: 
    9: import { db } from "@/lib/firebase";
   10: 
   11: export type SchoolMemberRecord = {
   12:   uid: string;
   13:   name: string;
   14:   email: string;
   15: 
   16:   role: string;
   17:   membershipRole: string;
   18:   status: string;
   19: 
   20:   qualification: string;
   21:   examBoard: string;
   22:   currentCourse: string;
   23: 
   24:   classIds: string[];
   25: 
   26:   joinedAt: Date | null;
   27: };
   28: 
   29: function safeString(
   30:   value: unknown,
   31: ): string {
   32:   return typeof value === "string"
   33:     ? value.trim()
   34:     : "";
   35: }
   36: 
   37: function safeStringArray(
   38:   value: unknown,
   39: ): string[] {
   40:   return Array.isArray(value)
   41:     ? value.filter(
   42:         (item): item is string =>
   43:           typeof item === "string",
   44:       )
   45:     : [];
   46: }
   47: 
   48: function timestampToDate(
   49:   value: unknown,
   50: ): Date | null {
   51:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   52:     ? value.toDate()
   53:     : null;
   54: }
   55: 
   56: /*
   57:  * T1H tenant-safe directory rule:
   58:  *
   59:  * A school membership document is the authoritative proof that a user belongs
   60:  * to the requested school. A direct users/{uid} read is useful enrichment, but
   61:  * it must not be required for the directory to load because Firestore may
   62:  * correctly restrict cross-profile reads.
   63:  *
   64:  * If the user document cannot be read, the service falls back to identity and
   65:  * course fields stored on the school membership document.
   66:  */
   67: export async function getSchoolMembers(
   68:   schoolId: string,
   69: ): Promise<SchoolMemberRecord[]> {
   70:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   71:     schoolId.trim();
   72: 
   73:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
   74:     return [];
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   const membershipSnapshot =
   78:     await getDocs(
   79:       collection(
   80:         db,
   81:         "schools",
   82:         cleanedSchoolId,
   83:         "members",
   84:       ),
   85:     );
   86: 
   87:   const members =
   88:     await Promise.all(
   89:       membershipSnapshot.docs.map(
   90:         async (
   91:           membershipDocument,
   92:         ) => {
   93:           const membership =
   94:             membershipDocument.data();
   95: 
   96:           const userSnapshot =
   97:             await getDoc(
   98:               doc(
   99:                 db,
  100:                 "users",
  101:                 membershipDocument.id,
  102:               ),
  103:             ).catch(() => null);
  104: 
  105:           const user =
  106:             userSnapshot?.exists()
  107:               ? userSnapshot.data()
  108:               : {};
  109: 
  110:           return {
  111:             uid:
  112:               membershipDocument.id,
  113: 
  114:             name:
  115:               safeString(
  116:                 user.name,
  117:               ) ||
  118:               safeString(
  119:                 membership.name,
  120:               ) ||
  121:               safeString(
  122:                 membership.displayName,
  123:               ) ||
  124:               "Unnamed member",
  125: 
  126:             email:
  127:               (
  128:                 safeString(
  129:                   user.email,
  130:                 ) ||
  131:                 safeString(
  132:                   membership.email,
  133:                 )
  134:               ).toLowerCase(),
  135: 
  136:             role:
  137:               safeString(
  138:                 user.role,
  139:               ) ||
  140:               safeString(
  141:                 membership.userRole,
  142:               ),
  143: 
  144:             membershipRole:
  145:               safeString(
  146:                 membership.role,
  147:               ),
  148: 
  149:             status:
  150:               safeString(
  151:                 membership.status,
  152:               ) ||
  153:               "active",
  154: 
  155:             qualification:
  156:               safeString(
  157:                 user.qualification,
  158:               ) ||
  159:               safeString(
  160:                 membership.qualification,
  161:               ),
  162: 
  163:             examBoard:
  164:               safeString(
  165:                 user.examBoard,
  166:               ) ||
  167:               safeString(
  168:                 membership.examBoard,
  169:               ),
  170: 
  171:             currentCourse:
  172:               safeString(
  173:                 user.currentCourse,
  174:               ) ||
  175:               safeString(
  176:                 membership.currentCourse,
  177:               ),
  178: 
  179:             classIds:
  180:               safeStringArray(
  181:                 user.classIds,
  182:               ).length > 0
  183:                 ? safeStringArray(
  184:                     user.classIds,
  185:                   )
  186:                 : safeStringArray(
  187:                     membership.classIds,
  188:                   ),
  189: 
  190:             joinedAt:
  191:               timestampToDate(
  192:                 membership.joinedAt,
  193:               ),
  194:           };
  195:         },
  196:       ),
  197:     );
  198: 
  199:   return members.sort(
  200:     (
  201:       first,
  202:       second,
  203:     ) =>
  204:       first.name.localeCompare(
  205:         second.name,
  206:         "en-GB",
  207:         {
  208:           sensitivity: "base",
  209:         },
  210:       ),
  211:   );
  212: }

   14: export async function assignUserToSchool({
   15:   schoolId,
   16:   userId,
   17:   role,
   18: }: {
   19:   schoolId: string;
   20:   userId: string;
   21:   role: SchoolMemberRole;
   22: }): Promise<void> {
   23:   const cleanedSchoolId = schoolId.trim();
   24:   const cleanedUserId = userId.trim();
   25: 
   26:   if (!cleanedSchoolId || !cleanedUserId) {
   27:     throw new Error("A valid school and user are required.");
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   const schoolRef = doc(db, "schools", cleanedSchoolId);
   31:   const userRef = doc(db, "users", cleanedUserId);
   32: 
   33:   const [schoolSnapshot, userSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
   34:     getDoc(schoolRef),
   35:     getDoc(userRef),
   36:   ]);
   37: 
   38:   if (!schoolSnapshot.exists()) {
   39:     throw new Error("The selected school could not be found.");
   40:   }
   41: 
   42:   if (!userSnapshot.exists()) {
   43:     throw new Error("The selected user account could not be found.");
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   const memberRef = doc(
   47:     db,
   48:     "schools",
   49:     cleanedSchoolId,
   50:     "members",
   51:     cleanedUserId,
   52:   );
   53: 
   54:   const batch = writeBatch(db);
   55: 
   56:   batch.set(
   57:     memberRef,
   58:     {
   59:       schoolId: cleanedSchoolId,
   60:       userId: cleanedUserId,
   61:       role,
   62:       status: "active",
   63:       joinedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   64:       leftAt: null,
   65:       updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   66:     },
   67:     { merge: true },
   68:   );
   69: 
   70:   batch.update(userRef, {
   71:     schoolId: cleanedSchoolId,
   72:     accountType: "school",
   73:     plan: "school",
   74:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
   75:   });
   76: 
   77:   await batch.commit();

   80: export async function removeUserFromSchool({
   81:   schoolId,
   82:   userId,
   83: }: {
   84:   schoolId: string;
   85:   userId: string;
   86: }): Promise<void> {
   87:   const cleanedSchoolId = schoolId.trim();
   88:   const cleanedUserId = userId.trim();
   89: 
   90:   if (!cleanedSchoolId || !cleanedUserId) {
   91:     throw new Error("A valid school and user are required.");
   92:   }
   93: 
   94:   const userRef = doc(db, "users", cleanedUserId);
   95:   const userSnapshot = await getDoc(userRef);
   96: 
   97:   if (!userSnapshot.exists()) {
   98:     throw new Error("The selected user account could not be found.");
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   const userData = userSnapshot.data();

  104:     typeof userData.schoolId === "string" &&

  146:   await batch.commit();

    1: import {
