   18: type FirestoreSchool = {
   19:   name?: unknown;
   20:   slug?: unknown;
   21:   status?: unknown;
   22:   ownerUserId?: unknown;
   23:   createdAt?: Timestamp;
   24:   updatedAt?: Timestamp;
   25: };
   26: 
   27: function safeString(
   28:   value: unknown,
   29: ): string {
   30:   return typeof value === "string"
   31:     ? value.trim()
   32:     : "";
   33: }
   34: 
   35: function safeStatus(
   36:   value: unknown,
   37: ): SchoolStatus {
   38:   return value === "suspended" ||
   39:     value === "archived"
   40:     ? value
   41:     : "active";
   42: }
   43: 
   44: function slugify(
   45:   value: string,
   46: ): string {
   47:   return value
   48:     .toLowerCase()
   49:     .trim()
   50:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
   51:     .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "")
   52:     .slice(0, 60);
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function timestampToDate(
   56:   value: unknown,
   57: ): Date | null {
   58:   return value instanceof Timestamp
   59:     ? value.toDate()
   60:     : null;
   61: }
   62: 
   63: function convertSchool(
   64:   id: string,
   65:   data: FirestoreSchool,
   66: ): School {
   67:   return {
   68:     id,
   69:     name:
   70:       safeString(data.name) ||
   71:       "Unnamed school",
   72:     slug:
   73:       safeString(data.slug),
   74:     status:
   75:       safeStatus(data.status),
   76:     ownerUserId:
   77:       safeString(
   78:         data.ownerUserId,
   79:       ),
   80:     createdAt:
   81:       timestampToDate(
   82:         data.createdAt,
   83:       ),
   84:     updatedAt:
   85:       timestampToDate(
   86:         data.updatedAt,
   87:       ),
   88:   };
   89: }
   90: 
   91: export async function getSchoolById(
   92:   schoolId: string,
   93: ): Promise<School | null> {
   94:   const cleanedSchoolId =
   95:     schoolId.trim();
   96: 
   97:   if (!cleanedSchoolId) {
   98:     return null;
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   const snapshot =
  102:     await getDoc(
  103:       doc(
  104:         db,
  105:         "schools",
  106:         cleanedSchoolId,
  107:       ),
  108:     );
  109: 
  110:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  111:     return null;
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   return convertSchool(
  115:     snapshot.id,
  116:     snapshot.data(),
  117:   );
  118: }

  120: export async function createSchool({
  121:   name,
  122:   ownerUserId,
  123: }: CreateSchoolInput): Promise<string> {
  124:   const cleanedName =
  125:     name
  126:       .trim()
  127:       .replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  128: 
  129:   const cleanedOwnerUserId =
  130:     ownerUserId.trim();
  131: 
  132:   if (!cleanedName) {
  133:     throw new Error(
  134:       "Enter a valid school name.",
  135:     );
  136:   }
  137: 
  138:   if (!cleanedOwnerUserId) {
  139:     throw new Error(
  140:       "A valid school owner account is required.",
  141:     );
  142:   }
  143: 
  144:   /*
  145:    * Read the authenticated teacher profile before creating
  146:    * any tenant records.
  147:    */
  148:   const ownerRef =
  149:     doc(
  150:       db,
  151:       "users",
  152:       cleanedOwnerUserId,
  153:     );
  154: 
  155:   const ownerSnapshot =
  156:     await getDoc(ownerRef);
  157: 
  158:   if (!ownerSnapshot.exists()) {
  159:     throw new Error(
  160:       "The school owner account could not be found.",
  161:     );
  162:   }
  163: 
  164:   const ownerData =
  165:     ownerSnapshot.data();
  166: 
  167:   const ownerRole =
  168:     safeString(
  169:       ownerData.role,
  170:     );
  171: 
  172:   if (
  173:     ownerRole !== "teacher" &&
  174:     ownerRole !== "admin"
  175:   ) {
  176:     throw new Error(
  177:       "Only an approved teacher or administrator can create a school.",
  178:     );
  179:   }
  180: 
  181:   const existingSchoolId =
  182:     safeString(
  183:       ownerData.schoolId,
  184:     );
  185: 
  186:   if (existingSchoolId) {
  187:     throw new Error(
  188:       "This account is already linked to a school.",
  189:     );
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   /*
  193:    * Firestore generates the school ID locally before the
  194:    * batch is committed. This allows all three tenant records
  195:    * to reference exactly the same school ID.
  196:    */
  197:   const schoolRef =
  198:     doc(
  199:       collection(
  200:         db,
  201:         "schools",
  202:       ),
  203:     );
  204: 
  205:   const membershipRef =
  206:     doc(
  207:       db,
  208:       "schools",
  209:       schoolRef.id,
  210:       "members",
  211:       cleanedOwnerUserId,
  212:     );
  213: 
  214:   const batch =
  215:     writeBatch(db);
  216: 
  217:   /*
  218:    * 1. Create the school organisation.
  219:    */
  220:   batch.set(
  221:     schoolRef,
  222:     {
  223:       name:
  224:         cleanedName,
  225: 
  226:       slug:
  227:         `${slugify(
  228:           cleanedName,
  229:         )}-${schoolRef.id.slice(
  230:           0,
  231:           6,
  232:         )}`,
  233: 
  234:       status:
  235:         "active",
  236: 
  237:       ownerUserId:
  238:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  239: 
  240:       createdAt:
  241:         serverTimestamp(),
  242: 
  243:       updatedAt:
  244:         serverTimestamp(),
  245:     },
  246:   );
  247: 
  248:   /*
  249:    * 2. Create the owner's active school-admin membership.
  250:    *
  251:    * Firestore's school creation rule checks this with
  252:    * existsAfter()/getAfter(), so it MUST be part of the
  253:    * same batch as the school creation.
  254:    */
  255:   batch.set(
  256:     membershipRef,
  257:     {
  258:       schoolId:
  259:         schoolRef.id,
  260: 
  261:       userId:
  262:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  263: 
  264:       role:
  265:         "school_admin",
  266: 
  267:       status:
  268:         "active",
  269: 
  270:       joinedAt:
  271:         serverTimestamp(),
  272: 
  273:       leftAt:
  274:         null,
  275: 
  276:       updatedAt:
  277:         serverTimestamp(),
  278:     },
  279:   );
  280: 
  281:   /*
  282:    * 3. Link the teacher profile to the school.
  283:    *
  284:    * IMPORTANT:
  285:    * Some early development/test accounts pre-date the
  286:    * canonical uid field. Firestore's user update rule
  287:    * requires request.resource.data.uid to equal the
  288:    * authenticated user's UID.
  289:    *
  290:    * Writing uid here safely repairs those legacy profiles
  291:    * while performing the school tenancy transition.
  292:    */
  293:   batch.update(
  294:     ownerRef,
  295:     {
  296:       uid:
  297:         cleanedOwnerUserId,
  298: 
  299:       schoolId:
  300:         schoolRef.id,
  301: 
  302:       accountType:
  303:         "school",
  304: 
  305:       plan:
  306:         "school",
  307: 
  308:       updatedAt:
  309:         serverTimestamp(),
  310:     },
  311:   );
  312: 
  313:   /*
  314:    * All three writes must succeed or none of them does.
  315:    */
  316:   await batch.commit();
  317: 
  318:   return schoolRef.id;
  319: }

    1: import type {

    8: const priorityRank: Record<TeacherActionPriority, number> = {
    9:   critical: 0,
   10:   high: 1,
   11:   medium: 2,
   12:   low: 3,
   13: };

   15: function uniqueActions(actions: TeacherActionItem[]): TeacherActionItem[] {
   16:   const seen = new Set<string>();
   17: 
   18:   return actions.filter((action) => {
   19:     const key = `${action.kind}:${action.href}:${action.studentId || ""}:${action.topic || ""}`;
   20: 
   21:     if (seen.has(key)) return false;
   22: 
   23:     seen.add(key);
   24:     return true;
   25:   });
   26: }

   28: export function buildTeacherActionCentre(
   29:   input: TeacherActionCentreInput,
   30: ): TeacherActionCentreSummary {
   31:   const actions: TeacherActionItem[] = [];
   32: 
   33:   if (input.classCount === 0) {
   34:     actions.push({
   35:       id: "create-first-class",
   36:       kind: "class_setup",
   37:       priority: "critical",
   38:       title: "Create your first class",
   39:       description:
   40:         "Teacher intelligence cannot become meaningful until students are organised into a class.",
   41:       href: "/teacher/classes",
   42:       actionLabel: "Open classes",
   43:     });
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   if (input.studentCount === 0 && input.classCount > 0) {
   47:     actions.push({
   48:       id: "add-students",
   49:       kind: "class_setup",
   50:       priority: "critical",
   51:       title: "Add students to your classes",
   52:       description:
   53:         "There are currently no students contributing learning or assessment evidence.",
   54:       href: "/teacher/classes",
   55:       actionLabel: "Manage enrolment",
   56:     });
   57:   }
   58: 
   59:   input.atRiskStudents.forEach((student, index) => {
   60:     const critical = student.averageScore < 30;
   61: 
   62:     actions.push({
   63:       id: `student-support-${student.id}`,
   64:       kind: "student_support",
   65:       priority: critical ? "critical" : "high",
   66:       title: `${student.name} needs targeted support`,
   67:       description:
   68:         student.recommendedAction ||
   69:         `Current average is ${student.averageScore}%. Review the learner's evidence and decide whether an intervention is required.`,
   70:       href: `/teacher/analytics/${encodeURIComponent(student.id)}`,
   71:       actionLabel: "Review student",
   72:       studentId: student.id,
   73:       studentName: student.name,
   74:       topic: student.weakTopic,
   75:       metric: `${student.averageScore}%`,
   76:     });
   77: 
   78:     if (index < 3) {
   79:       actions.push({
   80:         id: `student-intervention-${student.id}`,
   81:         kind: "student_support",
   82:         priority: critical ? "high" : "medium",
   83:         title: `Consider an intervention for ${student.name}`,
   84:         description: `Focus the review on ${
   85:           student.weakTopic || "the learner's weakest recent evidence"
   86:         }.`,
   87:         href:
   88:           `/teacher/interventions?studentId=${encodeURIComponent(student.id)}` +
   89:           `&topic=${encodeURIComponent(
   90:             student.weakTopic || "Recent Quiz Performance",
   91:           )}&source=teacher-dashboard`,
   92:         actionLabel: "Open Intervention Centre",
   93:         studentId: student.id,
   94:         studentName: student.name,
   95:         topic: student.weakTopic,
   96:       });
   97:     }
   98:   });
   99: 
  100:   const assessedTopics = input.classPerformance.filter((topic) =>
  101:     Number.isFinite(topic.averageScore),
  102:   );
  103: 
  104:   const weakestTopic =
  105:     assessedTopics.length > 0
  106:       ? [...assessedTopics].sort(
  107:           (first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore,
  108:         )[0]
  109:       : null;
  110: 
  111:   if (weakestTopic && weakestTopic.averageScore < 50) {
  112:     actions.push({
  113:       id: `reteach-${weakestTopic.id}`,
  114:       kind: "topic_reteach",
  115:       priority: weakestTopic.averageScore < 30 ? "high" : "medium",
  116:       title: `Reteach ${weakestTopic.topic}`,
  117:       description: `Current class performance is ${weakestTopic.averageScore}%. Open the class Knowledge Map before assigning follow-up work.`,
  118:       href: `/teacher/knowledge-map?topic=${encodeURIComponent(
  119:         weakestTopic.topic,
  120:       )}&source=teacher-dashboard`,
  121:       actionLabel: "Open Knowledge Map",
  122:       topic: weakestTopic.topic,
  123:       metric: `${weakestTopic.averageScore}%`,
  124:     });
  125:   }
  126: 
  127:   if (
  128:     input.studentCount > 0 &&
  129:     input.assignmentCount > 0 &&
  130:     input.completionRate < 60
  131:   ) {
  132:     actions.push({
  133:       id: "completion-critical",
  134:       kind: "completion",
  135:       priority: input.completionRate < 40 ? "high" : "medium",
  136:       title: "Assignment completion requires attention",
  137:       description: `Overall completion is ${input.completionRate}%. Review outstanding work before drawing strong attainment conclusions.`,
  138:       href: "/teacher/assignments",
  139:       actionLabel: "Review assignments",
  140:       metric: `${input.completionRate}%`,
  141:     });
  142:   } else if (
  143:     input.studentCount > 0 &&
  144:     input.assignmentCount > 0 &&
  145:     input.completionRate < 80
  146:   ) {
  147:     actions.push({
  148:       id: "completion-monitor",
  149:       kind: "completion",
  150:       priority: "low",
  151:       title: "Monitor assignment completion",
  152:       description: `Completion is currently ${input.completionRate}%. A stronger completion rate will improve the quality of teacher analytics.`,
  153:       href: "/teacher/assignments",
  154:       actionLabel: "View assignments",
  155:       metric: `${input.completionRate}%`,
  156:     });
  157:   }
  158: 
  159:   if (
  160:     input.studentCount > 0 &&
  161:     input.averageScore > 0 &&
  162:     input.averageScore < 50
  163:   ) {
  164:     actions.push({
  165:       id: "class-attainment",
  166:       kind: "evidence",
  167:       priority: input.averageScore < 35 ? "high" : "medium",
  168:       title: "Class attainment is below the review threshold",
  169:       description: `The current dashboard average is ${input.averageScore}%. Use class analytics to separate topic gaps, student priorities and evidence-quality issues.`,
  170:       href: "/teacher/analytics",
  171:       actionLabel: "Open class analytics",
  172:       metric: `${input.averageScore}%`,
  173:     });
  174:   }
  175: 
  176:   if (input.activeAssignmentCount === 0 && input.studentCount > 0) {
  177:     actions.push({
  178:       id: "no-active-assignments",
  179:       kind: "assessment",
  180:       priority: "low",
  181:       title: "No active assignments",
  182:       description:
  183:         "Create a targeted task, quiz or written assessment when you need fresh evidence.",
  184:       href: "/teacher/assignment-wizard",
  185:       actionLabel: "Create assignment",
  186:     });
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   if (input.studentCount > 0 && assessedTopics.length === 0) {
  190:     actions.push({
  191:       id: "limited-topic-evidence",
  192:       kind: "evidence",
  193:       priority: "medium",
  194:       title: "More assessed evidence is needed",
  195:       description:
  196:         "No topic-performance evidence is available yet. Assign assessed work before relying on class-level mastery decisions.",
  197:       href: "/teacher/assignment-wizard",
  198:       actionLabel: "Create assessed work",
  199:     });
  200:   }
  201: 
  202:   const sorted = uniqueActions(actions).sort((first, second) => {
  203:     const difference =
  204:       priorityRank[first.priority] - priorityRank[second.priority];
  205: 
  206:     return difference !== 0
  207:       ? difference
  208:       : first.title.localeCompare(second.title);
  209:   });
  210: 
  211:   const criticalCount = sorted.filter(
  212:     (action) => action.priority === "critical",
  213:   ).length;
  214:   const highCount = sorted.filter(
  215:     (action) => action.priority === "high",
  216:   ).length;
  217:   const mediumCount = sorted.filter(
  218:     (action) => action.priority === "medium",
  219:   ).length;
  220:   const lowCount = sorted.filter(
  221:     (action) => action.priority === "low",
  222:   ).length;
  223: 
  224:   const headline =
  225:     criticalCount > 0
  226:       ? `${criticalCount} urgent action${
  227:           criticalCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  228:         } require teacher attention`
  229:       : highCount > 0
  230:         ? `${highCount} high-priority action${
  231:             highCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  232:           } to review`
  233:         : mediumCount > 0
  234:           ? "Your next teaching actions are ready"
  235:           : sorted.length > 0
  236:             ? "No urgent issues â€” continue monitoring"
  237:             : "No immediate teacher actions detected";
  238: 
  239:   return {
  240:     criticalCount,
  241:     highCount,
  242:     mediumCount,
  243:     lowCount,
  244:     totalCount: sorted.length,
  245:     headline,
  246:     actions: sorted,
  247:   };
  248: }

   47: export async function getTeacherContentLibrary(
   48:   teacherId: string,
   49: ): Promise<TeacherContentItem[]> {
   50:   const id = teacherId.trim();
   51:   if (!id) return [];
   52: 
   53:   const [resources, examSets, quizSnapshot] = await Promise.all([
   54:     getTeacherResources(id),
   55:     getTeacherExamQuestionSets(id),
   56:     getDocs(query(collection(db, "generatedQuizzes"), where("teacherId", "==", id))),
   57:   ]);
   58: 
   59:   const resourceItems: TeacherContentItem[] = resources.map((resource) => ({
   60:     key: `teaching-resource:${resource.id}`,
   61:     id: resource.id,
   62:     teacherId: resource.teacherId,
   63:     kind: "teaching-resource",
   64:     title: resource.title,
   65:     description: resource.content.overview || "",
   66:     topic: resource.topic,
   67:     qualification:
   68:       resource.yearGroup === "A Level" ||
   69:       resource.yearGroup === "Year 12" ||
   70:       resource.yearGroup === "Year 13"
   71:         ? "A_LEVEL"
   72:         : "GCSE",
   73:     examBoard: resource.examBoard,
   74:     yearGroup: resource.yearGroup,
   75:     difficulty: resource.difficulty,
   76:     lifecycle: normaliseLifecycle(resource.status),
   77:     questionCount: resource.content.assessmentQuestions.length,
   78:     totalMarks: resource.content.assessmentQuestions.reduce(
   79:       (total, question) => total + (Number(question.marks) || 0),
   80:       0,
   81:     ),
   82:     createdAt: resource.createdAt,
   83:     updatedAt: resource.updatedAt,
   84:     openHref: `/teacher/resources/${resource.id}`,
   85:     assignHref:
   86:       resource.status === "published"
   87:         ? `/teacher/assignment-wizard?contentType=teaching-resource&contentId=${encodeURIComponent(resource.id)}`
   88:         : null,
   89:   }));
   90: 
   91:   const examItems: TeacherContentItem[] = examSets.map((set) => ({
   92:     key: `exam-paper:${set.id}`,
   93:     id: set.id,
   94:     teacherId: set.teacherId,
   95:     kind: "exam-paper",
   96:     title: set.title,
   97:     description: `${set.questionCount} original exam-style questions worth ${set.totalMarks} marks.`,
   98:     topic: set.topic,
   99:     qualification: set.qualification,
  100:     examBoard: set.examBoard,
  101:     yearGroup: "",
  102:     difficulty: set.difficulty,
  103:     lifecycle: normaliseLifecycle(set.status),
  104:     questionCount: set.questionCount,
  105:     totalMarks: set.totalMarks,
  106:     createdAt: set.createdAt,
  107:     updatedAt: set.updatedAt,
  108:     openHref: `/teacher/question-bank/${set.id}`,
  109:     assignHref:
  110:       set.status === "published"
  111:         ? `/teacher/assignment-wizard?contentType=exam-paper&contentId=${encodeURIComponent(set.id)}`
  112:         : null,
  113:   }));
  114: 
  115:   const quizItems: TeacherContentItem[] = quizSnapshot.docs.map((quizDocument) => {
  116:     const data = quizDocument.data();
  117:     const questions = Array.isArray(data.questions) ? data.questions : [];
  118:     const lifecycle = normaliseLifecycle(data.status);
  119: 
  120:     return {
  121:       key: `ai-quiz:${quizDocument.id}`,
  122:       id: quizDocument.id,
  123:       teacherId: typeof data.teacherId === "string" ? data.teacherId : id,
  124:       kind: "ai-quiz",
  125:       title: typeof data.title === "string" ? data.title : "Untitled Quiz",
  126:       description: typeof data.description === "string" ? data.description : "",
  127:       topic: typeof data.topicId === "string" ? data.topicId : "",
  128:       qualification: typeof data.qualification === "string" ? data.qualification : "GCSE",
  129:       examBoard: typeof data.examBoard === "string" ? data.examBoard : "",
  130:       yearGroup: "",
  131:       difficulty: typeof data.difficulty === "string" ? data.difficulty : "standard",
  132:       lifecycle,
  133:       questionCount:
  134:         typeof data.questionCount === "number" ? data.questionCount : questions.length,
  135:       totalMarks: null,
  136:       createdAt: timestampToDate(data.createdAt),
  137:       updatedAt: timestampToDate(data.updatedAt),
  138:       openHref: `/teacher/quiz-library/${quizDocument.id}`,
  139:       assignHref:
  140:         lifecycle === "published"
  141:           ? `/teacher/assignment-wizard?quizId=${encodeURIComponent(quizDocument.id)}`
  142:           : null,
  143:     };
  144:   });
  145: 
  146:   return [...resourceItems, ...quizItems, ...examItems].sort(
  147:     (a, b) =>
  148:       (b.updatedAt ?? b.createdAt ?? new Date(0)).getTime() -
  149:       (a.updatedAt ?? a.createdAt ?? new Date(0)).getTime(),
  150:   );
  151: }
  152: 
  153: export async function updateTeacherContentLifecycle(
  154:   item: TeacherContentItem,
  155:   lifecycle: TeacherContentLifecycle,
  156: ): Promise<void> {
  157:   if (item.kind === "teaching-resource") {
  158:     await updateTeacherResourceStatus(item.id, lifecycle);
  159:     return;
  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   if (item.kind === "exam-paper") {
  163:     await updateExamQuestionSetStatus(item.id, lifecycle);
  164:     return;
  165:   }
  166: 
  167:   await updateDoc(doc(db, "generatedQuizzes", item.id), {
  168:     status: lifecycle,
  169:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  170:   });
  171: }
  172: 
  173: export async function duplicateTeacherContent(
  174:   item: TeacherContentItem,
  175:   teacherId: string,
  176: ): Promise<string> {
  177:   const id = teacherId.trim();
  178:   if (!id) throw new Error("A teacher account is required.");
  179: 
  180:   if (item.kind === "teaching-resource") {
  181:     return duplicateTeacherResource(item.id, id);
  182:   }
  183: 
  184:   if (item.kind === "exam-paper") {
  185:     return duplicateExamQuestionSet(item.id, id);
  186:   }
  187: 
  188:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
  189:     query(collection(db, "generatedQuizzes"), where("teacherId", "==", id)),
  190:   );
  191:   const source = snapshot.docs.find((docItem) => docItem.id === item.id);
  192:   if (!source) throw new Error("The quiz could not be found in your library.");
  193: 
  194:   const data = source.data();
  195:   const reference = await addDoc(collection(db, "generatedQuizzes"), {
  196:     ...data,
  197:     title: `${item.title} (Copy)`,
  198:     status: "draft",
  199:     createdAt: serverTimestamp(),
  200:     updatedAt: serverTimestamp(),
  201:   });
  202:   return reference.id;
  203: }
  204: 
  205: export async function deleteTeacherContent(item: TeacherContentItem): Promise<void> {
  206:   if (item.lifecycle !== "archived") {
  207:     throw new Error("Archive content before deleting it permanently.");
  208:   }
  209: 
  210:   if (item.kind === "teaching-resource") {
  211:     await deleteTeacherResource(item.id);
  212:     return;
  213:   }
  214: 
  215:   if (item.kind === "exam-paper") {
  216:     await deleteExamQuestionSet(item.id);
  217:     return;
  218:   }
  219: 
  220:   await deleteDoc(doc(db, "generatedQuizzes", item.id));
  221: }

   17: function primaryFocus({
   18:   atRiskCount,
   19:   completionRate,
   20:   averageScore,
   21:   activeAssignmentCount,
   22: }: TeacherDashboardIntegrationInput): TeacherDashboardFocus {
   23:   if (atRiskCount > 0) return "student_support";
   24:   if (completionRate < 70) return "completion";
   25:   if (activeAssignmentCount === 0 || averageScore < 50) return "assessment";
   26:   return "monitoring";
   27: }
   28: 
   29: function headlineForFocus(focus: TeacherDashboardFocus): string {
   30:   if (focus === "student_support") return "Start with learners requiring support";
   31:   if (focus === "completion") return "Start with assignment completion";
   32:   if (focus === "assessment") return "Collect the next useful assessment evidence";
   33:   return "Review current evidence and keep the cycle moving";
   34: }
   35: 
   36: function summaryForFocus(focus: TeacherDashboardFocus): string {
   37:   if (focus === "student_support") {
   38:     return "Review the highest-priority learners first, then move into intervention planning or targeted reassessment.";
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   if (focus === "completion") {
   42:     return "Outstanding work may be weakening the reliability of current attainment conclusions. Review completion before escalating curriculum concerns.";
   43:   }
   44: 
   45:   if (focus === "assessment") {
   46:     return "Use the assessment tools to collect stronger evidence, then return to analytics and reports to interpret the results.";
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   return "The dashboard is in a monitoring state. Use analytics, reports and the assessment centre to maintain the review cycle.";
   50: }
   51: 
   52: export function buildTeacherDashboardIntegration(
   53:   input: TeacherDashboardIntegrationInput,
   54: ): TeacherDashboardIntegration {
   55:   const focus = primaryFocus(input);
   56: 
   57:   const signals: TeacherDashboardSignal[] = [
   58:     {
   59:       id: "support",
   60:       label: "Learners requiring support",
   61:       value: String(input.atRiskCount),
   62:       detail:
   63:         input.atRiskCount > 0
   64:           ? "Open the priority workflow before assigning broad follow-up work."
   65:           : "No current dashboard intervention alerts.",
   66:       focus: "student_support",
   67:       href: "#teacher-actions",
   68:       actionLabel: "Review actions",
   69:       severity: input.atRiskCount > 0 ? "high" : "positive",
   70:     },
   71:     {
   72:       id: "completion",
   73:       label: "Assignment completion",
   74:       value: `${input.completionRate}%`,
   75:       detail:
   76:         input.completionRate < 70
   77:           ? "Completion is low enough to affect confidence in the current evidence picture."
   78:           : "Completion is currently supporting a usable evidence picture.",
   79:       focus: "completion",
   80:       href: "/teacher/assignments",
   81:       actionLabel: "Review assignments",
   82:       severity:
   83:         input.completionRate < 50
   84:           ? "high"
   85:           : input.completionRate < 70
   86:             ? "medium"
   87:             : "positive",
   88:     },
   89:     {
   90:       id: "attainment",
   91:       label: "Current average",
   92:       value: `${input.averageScore}%`,
   93:       detail:
   94:         input.averageScore < 50
   95:           ? "Use class analytics to separate curriculum gaps from individual learner issues."
   96:           : "Review class analytics for topic-level strengths and weaknesses.",
   97:       focus: "monitoring",
   98:       href: "/teacher/analytics",
   99:       actionLabel: "Open analytics",
  100:       severity:
  101:         input.averageScore < 40
  102:           ? "high"
  103:           : input.averageScore < 60
  104:             ? "medium"
  105:             : "positive",
  106:     },
  107:     {
  108:       id: "assessment",
  109:       label: "Active assignments",
  110:       value: String(input.activeAssignmentCount),
  111:       detail: `${input.assignmentCount} total assignment${
  112:         input.assignmentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  113:       } across ${input.classCount} class${
  114:         input.classCount === 1 ? "" : "es"
  115:       } and ${input.studentCount} learner${
  116:         input.studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"
  117:       }.`,
  118:       focus: "assessment",
  119:       href: "#assessment-centre",
  120:       actionLabel: "Assessment centre",
  121:       severity: input.activeAssignmentCount === 0 ? "medium" : "low",
  122:     },
  123:   ];
  124: 
  125:   return {
  126:     headline: headlineForFocus(focus),
  127:     summary: summaryForFocus(focus),
  128:     primaryFocus: focus,
  129:     signals,
  130:   };
  131: }

  150: function safeNumber(value: unknown): number {
  151:   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  152: }
  153: 
  154: function safeString(value: unknown, fallback = ""): string {
  155:   return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() ? value.trim() : fallback;
  156: }
  157: 
  158: function safeStringArray(value: unknown): string[] {
  159:   return Array.isArray(value)
  160:     ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
  161:     : [];
  162: }
  163: 
  164: function formatActivityTime(timestamp?: Timestamp): string {
  165:   if (!timestamp) {
  166:     return "Recently";
  167:   }
  168: 
  169:   const activityDate = timestamp.toDate();
  170: 
  171:   const difference = Date.now() - activityDate.getTime();
  172: 
  173:   const minutes = Math.floor(difference / 60000);
  174: 
  175:   if (minutes < 1) {
  176:     return "Just now";
  177:   }
  178: 
  179:   if (minutes < 60) {
  180:     return `${minutes} minute${minutes === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  181:   }
  182: 
  183:   const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  184: 
  185:   if (hours < 24) {
  186:     return `${hours} hour${hours === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
  190: 
  191:   return `${days} day${days === 1 ? "" : "s"} ago`;
  192: }
  193: 
  194: function isToday(timestamp?: Timestamp): boolean {
  195:   if (!timestamp) {
  196:     return false;
  197:   }
  198: 
  199:   const date = timestamp.toDate();
  200: 
  201:   const today = new Date();
  202: 
  203:   return (
  204:     date.getFullYear() === today.getFullYear() &&
  205:     date.getMonth() === today.getMonth() &&
  206:     date.getDate() === today.getDate()
  207:   );
  208: }
  209: 
  210: function calculateAverage(values: number[]): number {
  211:   if (values.length === 0) {
  212:     return 0;
  213:   }
  214: 
  215:   return Math.round(
  216:     values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length,
  217:   );
  218: }
  219: 
  220: export async function getTeacherDashboardData(
  221:   teacherId: string,
  222: ): Promise<TeacherDashboardData> {
  223:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  224: 
  225:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) {
  226:     return emptyTeacherDashboardData;
  227:   }
  228: 
  229:   const [
  230:     classesSnapshot,
  231:     assignmentsSnapshot,
  232:     assignmentResultsSnapshot,
  233:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot,
  234:     examAssignmentsSnapshot,
  235:     examSubmissionsSnapshot,
  236:   ] = await Promise.all([
  237:     getDocs(
  238:       query(
  239:         collection(db, "classes"),
  240:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  241:       ),
  242:     ),
  243: 
  244:     getDocs(
  245:       query(
  246:         collection(db, "assignments"),
  247:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  248:       ),
  249:     ),
  250: 
  251:     getDocs(
  252:       query(
  253:         collection(db, "assignmentResults"),
  254:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  255:       ),
  256:     ),
  257: 
  258:     getDocs(
  259:       query(
  260:         collection(db, "classAssignments"),
  261:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  262:       ),
  263:     ),
  264: 
  265:     getDocs(
  266:       query(
  267:         collection(db, "examAssignments"),
  268:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  269:       ),
  270:     ),
  271: 
  272:     getDocs(
  273:       query(
  274:         collection(db, "examSubmissions"),
  275:         where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  276:       ),
  277:     ),
  278:   ]);
  279: 
  280:   /*
  281:    * DATA ISOLATION:
  282:    *
  283:    * A teacher's dashboard must be built only from students explicitly
  284:    * enrolled in classes owned by that teacher.
  285:    *
  286:    * Never fall back to every platform student when a teacher has no classes.
  287:    * That would expose another teacher's learners and evidence.
  288:    */
  289:   const teacherStudentIds = new Set<string>();
  290: 
  291:   classesSnapshot.docs.forEach((classDocument) => {
  292:     const data = classDocument.data();
  293: 
  294:     safeStringArray(data.studentIds).forEach((studentId) => {
  295:       teacherStudentIds.add(studentId);
  296:     });
  297:   });
  298: 
  299:   const studentSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  300:     Array.from(teacherStudentIds).map((studentId) =>
  301:       getDoc(doc(db, "users", studentId)),
  302:     ),
  303:   );
  304: 
  305:   const relevantStudents: UserRecord[] = studentSnapshots
  306:     .filter((studentSnapshot) => studentSnapshot.exists())
  307:     .map((studentSnapshot) => {
  308:       const data = studentSnapshot.data();
  309: 
  310:       return {
  311:         id: studentSnapshot.id,
  312:         name: safeString(data.name, "Student"),
  313:         role: safeString(data.role, "student"),
  314:         xp: safeNumber(data.xp),
  315:         streak: safeNumber(data.streak),
  316:         badges: safeStringArray(data.badges),
  317:         completedLessons: safeStringArray(data.completedLessons),
  318:       };
  319:     })
  320:     .filter((student) => student.role === "student");
  321: 
  322:   const relevantStudentIds = new Set(
  323:     relevantStudents.map((student) => student.id),
  324:   );
  325: 
  326:   /*
  327:    * Fetch quiz evidence only from students who belong to this teacher's
  328:    * classes. This avoids downloading platform-wide quiz results and then
  329:    * filtering them in the browser.
  330:    */
  331:   const quizResultSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  332:     Array.from(relevantStudentIds).map((studentId) =>
  333:       getDocs(collection(db, "users", studentId, "quizResults")),
  334:     ),
  335:   );
  336: 
  337:   const quizResultDocuments = quizResultSnapshots.flatMap(
  338:     (snapshot) => snapshot.docs,
  339:   );
  340: 
  341:   const assignments: AssignmentRecord[] = assignmentsSnapshot.docs.map(
  342:     (assignmentDocument) => {
  343:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  344: 
  345:       return {
  346:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  347:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  348:       };
  349:     },
  350:   );
  351: 
  352:   const resourceAssignments: ResourceAssignmentRecord[] =
  353:     resourceAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.map((assignmentDocument) => {
  354:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  355:       const studentIds = safeStringArray(data.studentIds).filter((studentId) =>
  356:         relevantStudentIds.has(studentId),
  357:       );
  358: 
  359:       const storedStudentCount = safeNumber(data.studentCount);
  360:       const storedCompletedCount = safeNumber(data.completedCount);
  361: 
  362:       return {
  363:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  364:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  365:         studentIds,
  366:         studentCount:
  367:           storedStudentCount > 0 ? storedStudentCount : studentIds.length,
  368:         completedCount: Math.min(
  369:           storedCompletedCount,
  370:           storedStudentCount > 0 ? storedStudentCount : studentIds.length,
  371:         ),
  372:       };
  373:     });
  374: 
  375:   /*
  376:    * Resource/lesson assignments store per-student completion in
  377:    * assignmentProgress/{assignmentId}_{studentId}.
  378:    *
  379:    * Read only the expected progress documents for this teacher's own
  380:    * assignments and currently enrolled learners. This keeps the dashboard
  381:    * isolated and lets Completed Today include lesson/resource completions.
  382:    */
  383:   const resourceProgressSnapshots = await Promise.all(
  384:     resourceAssignments.flatMap((assignment) =>
  385:       assignment.studentIds.map((studentId) =>
  386:         getDoc(
  387:           doc(
  388:             db,
  389:             "assignmentProgress",
  390:             `${assignment.id}_${studentId}`,
  391:           ),
  392:         ),
  393:       ),
  394:     ),
  395:   );
  396: 
  397:   const resourceAssignmentProgress: ResourceAssignmentProgressRecord[] =
  398:     resourceProgressSnapshots
  399:       .filter((progressSnapshot) => progressSnapshot.exists())
  400:       .map((progressSnapshot) => {
  401:         const data = progressSnapshot.data();
  402: 
  403:         return {
  404:           id: progressSnapshot.id,
  405:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  406:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  407:           status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  408:           completedAt:
  409:             data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
  410:               ? data.completedAt
  411:               : undefined,
  412:         };
  413:       })
  414:       .filter(
  415:         (progress) =>
  416:           relevantStudentIds.has(progress.studentId) &&
  417:           resourceAssignments.some(
  418:             (assignment) => assignment.id === progress.assignmentId,
  419:           ),
  420:       );
  421: 
  422:   const assignmentResults: AssignmentResultRecord[] =
  423:     assignmentResultsSnapshot.docs
  424:       .map((resultDocument) => {
  425:         const data = resultDocument.data();
  426: 
  427:         return {
  428:           id: resultDocument.id,
  429:           studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  430:           assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  431:           percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  432:           status: safeString(data.status, "completed"),
  433:           completedAt:
  434:             data.completedAt instanceof Timestamp
  435:               ? data.completedAt
  436:               : undefined,
  437:         };
  438:       })
  439:       .filter((result) => relevantStudentIds.has(result.studentId));
  440: 
  441:   const quizResults: QuizResultRecord[] = quizResultDocuments
  442:     .map((resultDocument) => {
  443:       const data = resultDocument.data();
  444: 
  445:       return {
  446:         id: resultDocument.id,
  447:         uid: safeString(data.uid) || resultDocument.ref.parent.parent?.id || "",
  448:         studentName: safeString(data.studentName),
  449:         title: safeString(data.title, "Quiz"),
  450:         topicId: safeString(data.topicId, "Other"),
  451:         scorePercent: safeNumber(data.scorePercent),
  452:         createdAt:
  453:           data.createdAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.createdAt : undefined,
  454:       };
  455:     })
  456:     .filter(
  457:       (result) =>
  458:         Boolean(result.uid) &&
  459:         relevantStudentIds.has(result.uid),
  460:     );
  461: 
  462:   const examAssignments: ExamAssignmentRecord[] =
  463:     examAssignmentsSnapshot.docs.map((assignmentDocument) => {
  464:       const data = assignmentDocument.data();
  465: 
  466:       return {
  467:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  468:         status: safeString(data.status, "active"),
  469:         studentIds: safeStringArray(data.studentIds),
  470:       };
  471:     });
  472: 
  473:   const examAssignmentIdSet = new Set(
  474:     examAssignments.map((assignment) => assignment.id),
  475:   );
  476: 
  477:   const examSubmissions: ExamSubmissionRecord[] = examSubmissionsSnapshot.docs
  478:     .map((submissionDocument) => {
  479:       const data = submissionDocument.data();
  480: 
  481:       return {
  482:         id: submissionDocument.id,
  483:         studentId: safeString(data.studentId),
  484:         studentName: safeString(data.studentName),
  485:         assignmentId: safeString(data.assignmentId),
  486:         status: safeString(data.status, "not_started"),
  487:         percentage: safeNumber(data.percentage),
  488:         topic: safeString(data.topic, "Written assessment"),
  489:         markedAt:
  490:           data.markedAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.markedAt : undefined,
  491:         submittedAt:
  492:           data.submittedAt instanceof Timestamp ? data.submittedAt : undefined,
  493:       };
  494:     })
  495:     .filter(
  496:       (submission) =>
  497:         relevantStudentIds.has(submission.studentId) &&
  498:         examAssignmentIdSet.has(submission.assignmentId),
  499:     );
  500: 
  501:   const markedExamSubmissions = examSubmissions.filter(
  502:     (submission) => submission.status === "marked",
  503:   );
  504: 
  505:   const awaitingMarkingCount = examSubmissions.filter(
  506:     (submission) =>
  507:       submission.status === "submitted" || submission.status === "marking",
  508:   ).length;
  509: 
  510:   const quizScores = quizResults.map((result) => result.scorePercent);
  511: 
  512:   const examScores = markedExamSubmissions.map(
  513:     (submission) => submission.percentage,
  514:   );
  515: 
  516:   const quizAverage = calculateAverage(quizScores);
  517: 
  518:   const examAverage = calculateAverage(examScores);
  519: 
  520:   const averageScore = calculateAverage([...quizScores, ...examScores]);
  521: 
  522:   const lessonsCompleted = relevantStudents.reduce(
  523:     (total, student) => total + student.completedLessons.length,
  524:     0,
  525:   );
  526: 
  527:   const expectedQuizSubmissions = assignments.length * relevantStudents.length;
  528: 
  529:   const expectedResourceCompletions = resourceAssignments.reduce(
  530:     (total, assignment) => total + assignment.studentCount,
  531:     0,
  532:   );
  533: 
  534:   const completedResourceCompletions = resourceAssignments.reduce(
  535:     (total, assignment) => total + assignment.completedCount,
  536:     0,
  537:   );
  538: 
  539:   const expectedExamSubmissions = examAssignments.reduce(
  540:     (total, assignment) =>
  541:       total +
  542:       assignment.studentIds.filter((studentId) =>
  543:         relevantStudentIds.has(studentId),
  544:       ).length,
  545:     0,
  546:   );
  547: 
  548:   const completedAssignmentResults = assignmentResults.filter(
  549:     (result) => result.status === "completed",
  550:   );
  551: 
  552:   const completedExamSubmissions = examSubmissions.filter(
  553:     (submission) => submission.status === "marked",
  554:   );
  555: 
  556:   const expectedSubmissions =
  557:     expectedQuizSubmissions +
  558:     expectedResourceCompletions +
  559:     expectedExamSubmissions;
  560: 
  561:   const completedSubmissions =
  562:     completedAssignmentResults.length +
  563:     completedResourceCompletions +
  564:     completedExamSubmissions.length;
  565: 
  566:   const completionRate =
  567:     expectedSubmissions > 0
  568:       ? Math.min(
  569:           100,
  570:           Math.round((completedSubmissions / expectedSubmissions) * 100),
  571:         )
  572:       : 0;
  573: 
  574:   const completedResourceProgressToday = resourceAssignmentProgress.filter(
  575:     (progress) =>
  576:       progress.status === "completed" &&
  577:       isToday(progress.completedAt),
  578:   ).length;
  579: 
  580:   const completedToday =
  581:     completedAssignmentResults.filter((result) => isToday(result.completedAt))
  582:       .length +
  583:     completedResourceProgressToday +
  584:     completedExamSubmissions.filter((submission) =>
  585:       isToday(submission.markedAt),
  586:     ).length;
  587: 
  588:   const topStudents: TopStudent[] = [...relevantStudents]
  589:     .sort((first, second) => second.xp - first.xp)
  590:     .slice(0, 5)
  591:     .map((student) => ({
  592:       id: student.id,
  593:       name: student.name,
  594:       xp: student.xp,
  595:       streak: student.streak,
  596:       badges: student.badges.length,
  597:     }));
  598: 
  599:   const quizActivities: RecentTeacherActivity[] = quizResults
  600:     .slice(0, 8)
  601:     .map((result) => {
  602:       const matchedStudent = relevantStudents.find(
  603:         (student) => student.id === result.uid,
  604:       );
  605: 
  606:       return {
  607:         id: `quiz-${result.id}`,
  608:         studentName: result.studentName || matchedStudent?.name || "Student",
  609:         activity: `Completed ${result.title}`,
  610:         result: `${result.scorePercent}%`,
  611:         time: formatActivityTime(result.createdAt),
  612:         type: "quiz" as const,
  613:       };
  614:     });
  615: 
  616:   const examActivities: RecentTeacherActivity[] = markedExamSubmissions.map(
  617:     (submission) => {
  618:       const matchedStudent = relevantStudents.find(
  619:         (student) => student.id === submission.studentId,
  620:       );
  621: 
  622:       return {
  623:         id: `exam-${submission.id}`,
  624:         studentName:
  625:           submission.studentName || matchedStudent?.name || "Student",
  626:         activity: "Completed written assessment",
  627:         result: `${submission.percentage}%`,
  628:         time: formatActivityTime(submission.markedAt || submission.submittedAt),
  629:         type: "exam" as const,
  630:       };
  631:     },
  632:   );
  633: 
  634:   const recentActivities = [...quizActivities, ...examActivities].slice(0, 8);
  635: 
  636:   const scoresByStudent = new Map<string, number[]>();
  637: 
  638:   quizResults.forEach((result) => {
  639:     if (!result.uid) {
  640:       return;
  641:     }
  642: 
  643:     const scores = scoresByStudent.get(result.uid) || [];
  644: 
  645:     scores.push(result.scorePercent);
  646: 
  647:     scoresByStudent.set(result.uid, scores);
  648:   });
  649: 
  650:   markedExamSubmissions.forEach((submission) => {
  651:     const scores = scoresByStudent.get(submission.studentId) || [];
  652: 
  653:     scores.push(submission.percentage);
  654: 
  655:     scoresByStudent.set(submission.studentId, scores);
  656:   });
  657: 
  658:   const atRiskStudents: AtRiskStudent[] = relevantStudents
  659:     .map((student) => {
  660:       const scores = scoresByStudent.get(student.id) || [];
  661: 
  662:       return {
  663:         id: student.id,
  664:         name: student.name,
  665:         weakTopic: "Combined Assessment Performance",
  666:         averageScore: calculateAverage(scores),
  667:         recommendedAction:
  668:           "Review quiz and written exam evidence, then assign targeted revision.",
  669:         hasResults: scores.length > 0,
  670:       };
  671:     })
  672:     .filter((student) => student.hasResults && student.averageScore < 50)
  673:     .sort((first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore)
  674:     .slice(0, 5)
  675:     .map((student) => ({
  676:       id: student.id,
  677:       name: student.name,
  678:       weakTopic: student.weakTopic,
  679:       averageScore: student.averageScore,
  680:       recommendedAction: student.recommendedAction,
  681:     }));
  682: 
  683:   const topicGroups = new Map<string, number[]>();
  684: 
  685:   quizResults.forEach((result) => {
  686:     const topic = result.title || result.topicId || "Other";
  687: 
  688:     const scores = topicGroups.get(topic) || [];
  689: 
  690:     scores.push(result.scorePercent);
  691: 
  692:     topicGroups.set(topic, scores);
  693:   });
  694: 
  695:   markedExamSubmissions.forEach((submission) => {
  696:     const topic = submission.topic || "Written assessment";
  697: 
  698:     const scores = topicGroups.get(topic) || [];
  699: 
  700:     scores.push(submission.percentage);
  701: 
  702:     topicGroups.set(topic, scores);
  703:   });
  704: 
  705:   const classPerformance: TopicPerformance[] = Array.from(topicGroups.entries())
  706:     .map(([topic, scores], index) => ({
  707:       id: `topic-${index}`,
  708:       topic,
  709:       averageScore: calculateAverage(scores),
  710:     }))
  711:     .sort((first, second) => second.averageScore - first.averageScore);
  712: 
  713:   return {
  714:     studentCount: relevantStudents.length,
  715:     classCount: classesSnapshot.size,
  716:     assignmentCount:
  717:       assignments.length + resourceAssignments.length + examAssignments.length,
  718:     activeAssignmentCount:
  719:       assignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  720:         .length +
  721:       resourceAssignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  722:         .length +
  723:       examAssignments.filter((assignment) => assignment.status === "active")
  724:         .length,
  725:     examAssignmentCount: examAssignments.length,
  726:     awaitingMarkingCount,
  727:     averageScore,
  728:     quizAverage,
  729:     examAverage,
  730:     completionRate,
  731:     lessonsCompleted,
  732:     completedToday,
  733:     recentActivities,
  734:     atRiskStudents,
  735:     topStudents,
  736:     classPerformance,
  737:   };
  738: }

    1: import type {
    2:   InterventionPlanningGroup,
    3:   InterventionPlanningPriority,
    4:   InterventionPlanningStudent,
    5:   InterventionStrategy,
    6:   TeacherInterventionPlan,
    7: } from "@/types/teacherInterventionPlanning";

    9: function normaliseTopic(value: string): string {
   10:   const cleaned = value.trim();
   11:   return cleaned || "Combined Assessment Performance";
   12: }
   13: 
   14: function average(values: number[]): number {
   15:   if (!values.length) return 0;
   16: 
   17:   return Math.round(
   18:     values.reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0) / values.length,
   19:   );
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function priorityForGroup({
   23:   averageScore,
   24:   lowestScore,
   25:   studentCount,
   26: }: {
   27:   averageScore: number;
   28:   lowestScore: number;
   29:   studentCount: number;
   30: }): InterventionPlanningPriority {
   31:   if (lowestScore < 30 || averageScore < 35 || studentCount >= 4) {
   32:     return "high";
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   if (averageScore < 50 || studentCount >= 2) {
   36:     return "medium";
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   return "monitor";
   40: }
   41: 
   42: function strategyForGroup({
   43:   averageScore,
   44:   lowestScore,
   45:   studentCount,
   46: }: {
   47:   averageScore: number;
   48:   lowestScore: number;
   49:   studentCount: number;
   50: }): InterventionStrategy {
   51:   if (lowestScore < 30 || averageScore < 35) {
   52:     return "reteach_then_reassess";
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   if (averageScore < 50 || studentCount >= 2) {
   56:     return "targeted_practice";
   57:   }
   58: 
   59:   return "monitor_with_evidence";
   60: }
   61: 
   62: function rationaleForGroup({
   63:   topic,
   64:   averageScore,
   65:   lowestScore,
   66:   studentCount,
   67: }: {
   68:   topic: string;
   69:   averageScore: number;
   70:   lowestScore: number;
   71:   studentCount: number;
   72: }): string {
   73:   if (lowestScore < 30) {
   74:     return `${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} need support in ${topic}; the lowest current score is ${lowestScore}%.`;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   if (averageScore < 50) {
   78:     return `${topic} is a shared weakness for ${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"}, with an average of ${averageScore}%.`;
   79:   }
   80: 
   81:   return `${studentCount} learner${studentCount === 1 ? "" : "s"} have been flagged for monitoring in ${topic}.`;
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function evidenceCaution({
   85:   studentCount,
   86:   averageScore,
   87: }: {
   88:   studentCount: number;
   89:   averageScore: number;
   90: }): string {
   91:   if (studentCount === 1) {
   92:     return "This is an individual signal rather than a class-wide pattern. Review the learner's underlying evidence before changing whole-class teaching.";
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   if (studentCount < 3) {
   96:     return "This is a small support cohort. Check whether the weakness is repeated across more than one assessed activity.";
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   if (averageScore < 35) {
  100:     return "The group signal is strong, but the teacher should still review question-level and topic evidence before deciding the intervention.";
  101:   }
  102: 
  103:   return "Use this grouping as a planning aid and confirm it against recent assessment evidence.";
  104: }
  105: 
  106: function stepsForStrategy(
  107:   strategy: InterventionStrategy,
  108:   topic: string,
  109: ) {
  110:   if (strategy === "reteach_then_reassess") {
  111:     return [
  112:       {
  113:         id: "review",
  114:         order: 1,
  115:         label: "Review evidence",
  116:         description: `Check the Knowledge Map and recent assessment evidence for ${topic}.`,
  117:       },
  118:       {
  119:         id: "reteach",
  120:         order: 2,
  121:         label: "Reteach",
  122:         description: `Deliver a focused explanation, worked example or misconception check for ${topic}.`,
  123:       },
  124:       {
  125:         id: "reassess",
  126:         order: 3,
  127:         label: "Reassess",
  128:         description: `Assign a short targeted task or written reassessment on ${topic}.`,
  129:       },
  130:       {
  131:         id: "impact",
  132:         order: 4,
  133:         label: "Review impact",
  134:         description:
  135:           "Use the Intervention Centre to compare new evidence against the baseline.",
  136:       },
  137:     ];
  138:   }
  139: 
  140:   if (strategy === "targeted_practice") {
  141:     return [
  142:       {
  143:         id: "review",
  144:         order: 1,
  145:         label: "Check evidence",
  146:         description: `Confirm the recurring gap in ${topic}.`,
  147:       },
  148:       {
  149:         id: "practice",
  150:         order: 2,
  151:         label: "Targeted practice",
  152:         description: `Assign focused practice that isolates ${topic}.`,
  153:       },
  154:       {
  155:         id: "check",
  156:         order: 3,
  157:         label: "Check improvement",
  158:         description:
  159:           "Review the next graded evidence before escalating support.",
  160:       },
  161:     ];
  162:   }
  163: 
  164:   return [
  165:     {
  166:       id: "monitor",
  167:       order: 1,
  168:       label: "Monitor",
  169:       description: `Collect another piece of assessed evidence for ${topic}.`,
  170:     },
  171:     {
  172:       id: "review",
  173:       order: 2,
  174:       label: "Review trend",
  175:       description:
  176:         "Only create a formal intervention if the weakness is repeated or worsens.",
  177:     },
  178:   ];
  179: }
  180: 
  181: function groupQuery(
  182:   students: InterventionPlanningStudent[],
  183: ): string {
  184:   const ids = students
  185:     .map((student) => student.id)
  186:     .filter(Boolean)
  187:     .join(",");
  188: 
  189:   const names = students
  190:     .map((student) => student.name)
  191:     .filter(Boolean)
  192:     .join(",");
  193: 
  194:   return `studentIds=${encodeURIComponent(ids)}&studentNames=${encodeURIComponent(names)}`;
  195: }
  196: 
  197: export function buildTeacherInterventionPlan(
  198:   students: InterventionPlanningStudent[],
  199: ): TeacherInterventionPlan {
  200:   const grouped = new Map<string, InterventionPlanningStudent[]>();
  201: 
  202:   students.forEach((student) => {
  203:     const topic = normaliseTopic(student.weakTopic);
  204:     const current = grouped.get(topic) || [];
  205: 
  206:     current.push({
  207:       ...student,
  208:       weakTopic: topic,
  209:     });
  210: 
  211:     grouped.set(topic, current);
  212:   });
  213: 
  214:   const groups: InterventionPlanningGroup[] = Array.from(grouped.entries())
  215:     .map(([topic, members]) => {
  216:       const scores = members.map((student) => student.averageScore);
  217:       const averageScore = average(scores);
  218:       const lowestScore = scores.length ? Math.min(...scores) : 0;
  219:       const priority = priorityForGroup({
  220:         averageScore,
  221:         lowestScore,
  222:         studentCount: members.length,
  223:       });
  224:       const strategy = strategyForGroup({
  225:         averageScore,
  226:         lowestScore,
  227:         studentCount: members.length,
  228:       });
  229:       const cohort = groupQuery(members);
  230: 
  231:       return {
  232:         id:
  233:           topic
  234:             .toLowerCase()
  235:             .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
  236:             .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "") || "support-group",
  237:         topic,
  238:         studentCount: members.length,
  239:         students: [...members].sort(
  240:           (first, second) => first.averageScore - second.averageScore,
  241:         ),
  242:         averageScore,
  243:         lowestScore,
  244:         priority,
  245:         strategy,
  246:         rationale: rationaleForGroup({
  247:           topic,
  248:           averageScore,
  249:           lowestScore,
  250:           studentCount: members.length,
  251:         }),
  252:         evidenceCaution: evidenceCaution({
  253:           studentCount: members.length,
  254:           averageScore,
  255:         }),
  256:         steps: stepsForStrategy(strategy, topic),
  257:         knowledgeMapHref:
  258:           `/teacher/knowledge-map?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  259:           `&source=intervention-cohort&${cohort}`,
  260:         assignmentHref:
  261:           `/teacher/assignment-wizard?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  262:           `&source=intervention-cohort&mode=targeted-reassessment&${cohort}`,
  263:         interventionHref:
  264:           `/teacher/interventions?topic=${encodeURIComponent(topic)}` +
  265:           `&source=intervention-cohort&${cohort}`,
  266:       };
  267:     })
  268:     .sort((first, second) => {
  269:       const priorityRank = {
  270:         high: 0,
  271:         medium: 1,
  272:         monitor: 2,
  273:       };
  274: 
  275:       const difference =
  276:         priorityRank[first.priority] - priorityRank[second.priority];
  277: 
  278:       if (difference !== 0) return difference;
  279: 
  280:       if (first.averageScore !== second.averageScore) {
  281:         return first.averageScore - second.averageScore;
  282:       }
  283: 
  284:       return second.studentCount - first.studentCount;
  285:     });
  286: 
  287:   return {
  288:     totalStudentsRequiringSupport: students.length,
  289:     highPriorityGroups: groups.filter((group) => group.priority === "high")
  290:       .length,
  291:     groupedTopics: groups.length,
  292:     averageAtRiskScore: average(
  293:       students.map((student) => student.averageScore),
  294:     ),
  295:     groups,
  296:   };
  297: }

  114:   integrityTerminated?: boolean;
  115:   integrityTerminationReason?: string;
  116: };
  117: 
  118: function convertDate(value: FirestoreDate): Date | null {
  119:   if (!value) return null;
  120:   if (value instanceof Date) return value;
  121:   if (value instanceof Timestamp) return value.toDate();
  122: 
  123:   if (typeof value === "string") {
  124:     const parsed = new Date(value);
  125:     return Number.isNaN(parsed.getTime()) ? null : parsed;
  126:   }
  127: 
  128:   return null;
  129: }
  130: 
  131: function normaliseStatus(value: unknown): QuizAssignmentStatus {
  132:   return value === "closed" || value === "cancelled" ? value : "active";
  133: }
  134: 
  135: function normaliseDeliveryMode(value: unknown): QuizDeliveryMode {
  136:   return value === "assessment" ? "assessment" : "practice";
  137: }
  138: 
  139: function safeNumber(value: unknown): number {
  140:   return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
  141: }
  142: 
  143: function normaliseIncident(
  144:   value: FirestoreIntegrityIncident,
  145: ): TeacherQuizIntegrityIncident {
  146:   const allowedTypes = new Set<QuizIntegrityIncidentType>([
  147:     "fullscreen_exit",
  148:     "fullscreen_restored",
  149:     "page_hidden",
  150:     "page_visible",
  151:     "auto_submit",
  152:   ]);
  153: 
  154:   const type =
  155:     typeof value.type === "string" &&
  156:     allowedTypes.has(value.type as QuizIntegrityIncidentType)
  157:       ? (value.type as QuizIntegrityIncidentType)
  158:       : "page_hidden";
  159: 
  160:   return {
  161:     id: typeof value.id === "string" ? value.id : "incident",
  162:     type,
  163:     occurredAt: convertDate(value.occurredAt as FirestoreDate),
  164:     questionNumber:
  165:       typeof value.questionNumber === "number" &&
  166:       Number.isFinite(value.questionNumber)
  167:         ? value.questionNumber
  168:         : null,
  169:     detail: typeof value.detail === "string" ? value.detail : "Integrity event recorded.",
  170:   };
  171: }
  172: 
  173: function calculateCompletionPercentage(completedCount: number, studentCount: number) {
  174:   return studentCount <= 0 ? 0 : Math.round((completedCount / studentCount) * 100);
  175: }
  176: 
  177: function calculateAveragePercentage(results: FirestoreResult[]) {
  178:   if (results.length === 0) return 0;
  179:   return Math.round(
  180:     results.reduce((sum, result) => sum + safeNumber(result.percentage), 0) /
  181:       results.length,
  182:   );
  183: }
  184: 
  185: async function getQuizAssignmentResults(
  186:   assignmentId: string,
  187:   teacherId: string,
  188: ): Promise<FirestoreResult[]> {
  189:   const cleanedAssignmentId = assignmentId.trim();
  190:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  191: 
  192:   if (!cleanedAssignmentId || !cleanedTeacherId) return [];
  193: 
  194:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
  195:     query(
  196:       collection(db, "assignmentResults"),
  197:       where("assignmentId", "==", cleanedAssignmentId),
  198:       where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId),
  199:     ),
  200:   );
  201: 
  202:   return snapshot.docs
  203:     .map((document) => document.data() as FirestoreResult)
  204:     .filter(
  205:       (result) =>
  206:         result.assignmentType === "quiz" &&
  207:         result.status === "completed" &&
  208:         result.teacherId === cleanedTeacherId &&
  209:         result.assignmentId === cleanedAssignmentId,
  210:     );
  211: }
  212: 
  213: async function getClassInformation(classId: string): Promise<{
  214:   className: string;
  215:   studentIds: string[];
  216: }> {
  217:   const cleanedClassId = classId.trim();
  218: 
  219:   if (!cleanedClassId) {
  220:     return { className: "Unknown class", studentIds: [] };
  221:   }
  222: 
  223:   const snapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "classes", cleanedClassId));
  224: 
  225:   if (!snapshot.exists()) {
  226:     return { className: "Unknown class", studentIds: [] };
  227:   }
  228: 
  229:   const data = snapshot.data();
  230:   const studentIds = Array.isArray(data.studentIds)
  231:     ? data.studentIds.filter(
  232:         (value): value is string => typeof value === "string" && Boolean(value.trim()),
  233:       )
  234:     : [];
  235: 
  236:   return {
  237:     className:
  238:       typeof data.name === "string" && data.name.trim()
  239:         ? data.name
  240:         : "Untitled class",
  241:     studentIds: Array.from(new Set(studentIds.map((id) => id.trim()))),
  242:   };
  243: }
  244: 
  245: export async function getTeacherQuizAssignments(
  246:   teacherId: string,
  247: ): Promise<TeacherQuizAssignmentSummary[]> {
  248:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  249:   if (!cleanedTeacherId) return [];
  250: 
  251:   const assignmentsSnapshot = await getDocs(
  252:     query(collection(db, "assignments"), where("teacherId", "==", cleanedTeacherId)),
  253:   );
  254: 
  255:   const quizDocuments = assignmentsSnapshot.docs.filter((document) => {
  256:     const data = document.data();
  257:     return data.type === "quiz" && data.teacherId === cleanedTeacherId;
  258:   });
  259: 
  260:   const summaries = await Promise.all(
  261:     quizDocuments.map(async (assignmentDocument) => {
  262:       const assignment = assignmentDocument.data() as FirestoreAssignment;
  263:       const classId = assignment.classId || "";
  264:       const [classInformation, results] = await Promise.all([
  265:         getClassInformation(classId),
  266:         getQuizAssignmentResults(assignmentDocument.id, cleanedTeacherId),
  267:       ]);
  268: 
  269:       const completedCount = new Set(
  270:         results.map((result) => result.studentId || "").filter(Boolean),
  271:       ).size;
  272: 
  273:       return {
  274:         id: assignmentDocument.id,
  275:         teacherId: assignment.teacherId || "",
  276:         classId,
  277:         className: classInformation.className,
  278:         title: assignment.title || "Untitled Quiz",
  279:         description: assignment.description || "",
  280:         resourceId: assignment.resourceId || "",
  281:         dueDate: convertDate(assignment.dueDate),
  282:         createdAt: convertDate(assignment.createdAt),
  283:         status: normaliseStatus(assignment.status),
  284:         deliveryMode: normaliseDeliveryMode(assignment.deliveryMode),
  285:         studentCount: classInformation.studentIds.length,
  286:         completedCount,
  287:         completionPercentage: calculateCompletionPercentage(
  288:           completedCount,
  289:           classInformation.studentIds.length,
  290:         ),
  291:         averagePercentage: calculateAveragePercentage(results),
  292:         integrityTerminatedCount: results.filter(
  293:           (result) => result.integrityTerminated === true,
  294:         ).length,
  295:       } satisfies TeacherQuizAssignmentSummary;
  296:     }),
  297:   );
  298: 
  299:   return summaries.sort(
  300:     (a, b) => (b.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0) - (a.createdAt?.getTime() ?? 0),
  301:   );
  302: }
  303: 
  304: export async function getTeacherQuizAssignmentDetail(
  305:   assignmentId: string,
  306:   teacherId: string,
  307: ): Promise<TeacherQuizAssignmentDetail | null> {
  308:   const cleanedAssignmentId = assignmentId.trim();
  309:   const cleanedTeacherId = teacherId.trim();
  310: 
  311:   if (!cleanedAssignmentId || !cleanedTeacherId) return null;
  312: 
  313:   const assignmentSnapshot = await getDoc(
  314:     doc(db, "assignments", cleanedAssignmentId),
  315:   );
  316: 
  317:   if (!assignmentSnapshot.exists()) return null;
  318: 
  319:   const assignment = assignmentSnapshot.data() as FirestoreAssignment;
  320: 
  321:   if (assignment.type !== "quiz" || assignment.teacherId !== cleanedTeacherId) {
  322:     return null;
  323:   }
  324: 
  325:   const classId = assignment.classId || "";
  326:   const [classInformation, results] = await Promise.all([
  327:     getClassInformation(classId),
  328:     getQuizAssignmentResults(cleanedAssignmentId, cleanedTeacherId),
  329:   ]);
  330: 
  331:   const resultByStudentId = new Map<string, FirestoreResult>();
  332:   results.forEach((result) => {
  333:     if (result.studentId) resultByStudentId.set(result.studentId, result);
  334:   });
  335: 
  336:   const students = await Promise.all(
  337:     classInformation.studentIds.map(async (studentId) => {
  338:       const profileSnapshot = await getDoc(doc(db, "users", studentId));
  339:       const profile = profileSnapshot.exists() ? profileSnapshot.data() : null;
  340:       const result = resultByStudentId.get(studentId);
  341: 
  342:       return {
  343:         studentId,
  344:         studentName:
  345:           typeof profile?.name === "string" && profile.name.trim()
  346:             ? profile.name
  347:             : "Student",
  348:         studentEmail:
  349:           typeof profile?.email === "string" && profile.email.trim()
  350:             ? profile.email
  351:             : "No email available",
  352:         status: result ? "completed" : "not_started",
  353:         score: safeNumber(result?.score),
  354:         totalQuestions: safeNumber(result?.totalQuestions),
  355:         percentage: safeNumber(result?.percentage),
  356: 
  357:         /*
  358:          * Integrity-terminated assessments never surface XP in the markbook.
  359:          * This also corrects older records created before the zero-XP rule
  360:          * was enforced at write time.
  361:          */
  362:         earnedXP:
  363:           result?.integrityTerminated === true
  364:             ? 0
  365:             : safeNumber(result?.earnedXP),
  366: 
  367:         timeTakenSeconds: safeNumber(result?.timeTakenSeconds),
  368:         completedAt: convertDate(result?.completedAt),
  369:         deliveryMode: normaliseDeliveryMode(result?.deliveryMode ?? assignment.deliveryMode),
  370:         integritySessionStartedAt: convertDate(result?.integritySessionStartedAt),
  371:         integrityIncidents: Array.isArray(result?.integrityIncidents)
  372:           ? result.integrityIncidents.map(normaliseIncident)
  373:           : [],
  374:         integrityTerminated: result?.integrityTerminated === true,
  375:         integrityTerminationReason:
  376:           typeof result?.integrityTerminationReason === "string"
  377:             ? result.integrityTerminationReason
  378:             : "",
  379:       } satisfies TeacherQuizStudentResult;
  380:     }),
  381:   );
  382: 
  383:   students.sort((a, b) => a.studentName.localeCompare(b.studentName));
  384: 
  385:   const completedCount = students.filter((student) => student.status === "completed").length;
  386:   const studentCount = students.length;
  387: 
  388:   return {
  389:     assignment: {
  390:       id: assignmentSnapshot.id,
  391:       teacherId: assignment.teacherId || "",
  392:       classId,
  393:       className: classInformation.className,
  394:       title: assignment.title || "Untitled Quiz",
  395:       description: assignment.description || "",
  396:       resourceId: assignment.resourceId || "",
  397:       dueDate: convertDate(assignment.dueDate),
  398:       createdAt: convertDate(assignment.createdAt),
  399:       status: normaliseStatus(assignment.status),
  400:       deliveryMode: normaliseDeliveryMode(assignment.deliveryMode),
  401:       studentCount,
  402:       completedCount,
  403:       completionPercentage: calculateCompletionPercentage(completedCount, studentCount),
  404:       averagePercentage: calculateAveragePercentage(results),
  405:       integrityTerminatedCount: students.filter((student) => student.integrityTerminated).length,
  406:     },
  407:     students,
  408:   };
  409: }

   24: type ExistingTeacherRequest = {
   25:   id: string;
   26:   status:
   27:     | "pending"
   28:     | "approved"
   29:     | "rejected";
   30: };

   32: async function findExistingRequest(
   33:   userId: string,
   34: ): Promise<ExistingTeacherRequest | null> {
   35:   const snapshot = await getDocs(
   36:     query(
   37:       collection(
   38:         db,
   39:         "teacherRequests",
   40:       ),
   41:       where(
   42:         "userId",
   43:         "==",
   44:         userId,
   45:       ),
   46:       limit(10),
   47:     ),
   48:   );
   49: 
   50:   if (snapshot.empty) {
   51:     return null;
   52:   }
   53: 
   54:   const requests =
   55:     snapshot.docs.map(
   56:       (requestDocument) => {
   57:         const data =
   58:           requestDocument.data();
   59: 
   60:         const status =
   61:           data.status === "approved" ||
   62:           data.status === "rejected"
   63:             ? data.status
   64:             : "pending";
   65: 
   66:         return {
   67:           id: requestDocument.id,
   68:           status,
   69:         } satisfies ExistingTeacherRequest;
   70:       },
   71:     );
   72: 
   73:   return (
   74:     requests.find(
   75:       (request) =>
   76:         request.status === "pending",
   77:     ) ||
   78:     requests.find(
   79:       (request) =>
   80:         request.status === "approved",
   81:     ) ||
   82:     requests[0] ||
   83:     null
   84:   );
   85: }

   87: export async function createTeacherRequest({
   88:   userId,
   89:   name,
   90:   email,
   91:   schoolName,
   92:   jobTitle,
   93:   message,
   94: }: CreateTeacherRequestInput): Promise<string> {
   95:   const cleanedUserId =
   96:     userId.trim();
   97: 
   98:   const cleanedName =
   99:     name.trim();
  100: 
  101:   const cleanedEmail =
  102:     email.trim().toLowerCase();
  103: 
  104:   const cleanedSchool =
  105:     schoolName.trim();
  106: 
  107:   const cleanedJobTitle =
  108:     jobTitle.trim();
  109: 
  110:   if (
  111:     !cleanedUserId ||
  112:     !cleanedName ||
  113:     !cleanedSchool ||
  114:     !cleanedJobTitle
  115:   ) {
  116:     throw new Error(
  117:       "Please complete all required fields.",
  118:     );
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   const existing =
  122:     await findExistingRequest(
  123:       cleanedUserId,
  124:     );
  125: 
  126:   if (
  127:     existing?.status === "pending"
  128:   ) {
  129:     await setDoc(
  130:       doc(
  131:         db,
  132:         "users",
  133:         cleanedUserId,
  134:       ),
  135:       {
  136:         accountIntent: "teacher",
  137:         teacherAccessStatus:
  138:           "pending",
  139:         updatedAt:
  140:           serverTimestamp(),
  141:       },
  142:       {
  143:         merge: true,
  144:       },
  145:     );
  146: 
  147:     return existing.id;
  148:   }
  149: 
  150:   if (
  151:     existing?.status === "approved"
  152:   ) {
  153:     throw new Error(
  154:       "Teacher access has already been approved for this account.",
  155:     );
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   const requestReference =
  159:     await addDoc(
  160:       collection(
  161:         db,
  162:         "teacherRequests",
  163:       ),
  164:       {
  165:         userId: cleanedUserId,
  166:         name: cleanedName,
  167:         email: cleanedEmail,
  168:         schoolName:
  169:           cleanedSchool,
  170:         jobTitle:
  171:           cleanedJobTitle,
  172:         message:
  173:           message.trim(),
  174: 
  175:         status: "pending",
  176: 
  177:         createdAt:
  178:           serverTimestamp(),
  179: 
  180:         updatedAt:
  181:           serverTimestamp(),
  182:       },
  183:     );
  184: 
  185:   await setDoc(
  186:     doc(
  187:       db,
  188:       "users",
  189:       cleanedUserId,
  190:     ),
  191:     {
  192:       accountIntent: "teacher",
  193: 
  194:       teacherAccessStatus:
  195:         "pending",
  196: 
  197:       updatedAt:
  198:         serverTimestamp(),
  199:     },
  200:     {
  201:       merge: true,
  202:     },
  203:   );
  204: 
  205:   return requestReference.id;
  206: }
